en.title: Sambalagi HPAL Project Reaches Major Milestone with Autoclave Arrival, Strengthening the Future of Sustainable Downstreaming
en.subtitle: PT Vale, a member of Mining Industry Indonesia (“MIND ID”), together with its partners GEM Co., Ltd. and EcoPro, marked an important step forward in the development of sustainable nickel downstreaming with the arrival of an autoclave, a key piece of equipment for the High-Pressure Acid Leaching (“HPAL”) Project in Sambalagi, Bungku Pesisir, Morowali, Central Sulawesi, on Wednesday, 22 July 2026. This milestone represents substantial progress in the construction of the low-carbon nickel-processing facility, which forms part of the Indonesia Growth Project (“IGP”) Morowali.
en.body:
Morowali, 22 July 2026 —  Indonesia’s efforts to strengthen domestic nickel downstreaming and build a sustainable battery-industry supply chain have achieved another significant milestone. PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale”), a member of Mining Industry Indonesia (“MIND ID”), together with its partners GEM Co., Ltd. and EcoPro, marked an important step forward in the development of sustainable nickel downstreaming with the arrival of an autoclave, a key piece of equipment for the High-Pressure Acid Leaching (“HPAL”) Project in Sambalagi, Bungku Pesisir, Morowali, Central Sulawesi, on Wednesday, 22 July 2026. This milestone represents substantial progress in the construction of the low-carbon nickel-processing facility, which forms part of the Indonesia Growth Project (“IGP”) Morowali.

As a National Strategic Project (“PSN”), the Sambalagi HPAL Project constitutes an important component of the Government’s agenda to accelerate nickel downstreaming and develop Indonesia’s electric-vehicle ecosystem. Its PSN status was established under Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs Regulations No. 9 of 2022 and No. 21 of 2022, which designated PT Vale’s integrated mining development in the Bahodopi Block and its associated nickel-
processing facilities as a National Strategic Project. Integrated with the Bahodopi Block mine, the HPAL project is being developed through PT Bahodopi Nickel Smelting Indonesia (“BNSI”), a joint venture between PT Vale, GEM Co., Ltd. and EcoPro. Located within the Indonesia Green Industrial Park (“IGIP”) in Morowali, Central Sulawesi, the project is designed to support the development of a globally competitive downstream nickel industry while contributing to the transition towards a low-carbon economy.

The arrival of the autoclave represents a strategic milestone in the project’s construction phase. As a core component of HPAL technology, the autoclave lies at the heart of the process used to treat limonite ore through a combination of high temperature, high pressure and sulphuric acid, enabling nickel and cobalt to be extracted efficiently.

The resulting product is Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate (“MHP”), an intermediate material that serves as an essential feedstock in the electric-vehicle battery supply chain.

The Sambalagi HPAL facility is designed to produce approximately 90,000 tonnes of contained nickel per year in the form of MHP, supported by an annual feedstock supply of approximately 10.4 million tonnes of limonite ore sourced from PT Vale’s mining area in Bahodopi. The plant is being constructed across three production lines—Lines A, B and C—with the first mechanical completion milestone targeted for the end of 2026.

President Director and Chief Executive Officer of PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, Bernardus Irmanto, said the arrival of the autoclave symbolised tangible progress in the project while reaffirming the Company’s commitment to advancing sustainable mineral downstreaming.

“The arrival of this autoclave marks an important milestone for the Sambalagi HPAL Project. As the heart of the HPAL process, the autoclave will enable limonite ore to be transformed into a high-value-added product that supports the global electric-vehicle supply chain. This milestone reflects the commitment of PT Vale and its partners to developing a competitive nickel-processing industry founded on the principles of sustainability and occupational safety, while delivering long-term benefits for Indonesia and the communities surrounding our operations,” he said.

As part of its commitment to more sustainable operations, the Sambalagi HPAL Project incorporates a range of low-carbon solutions into the facility’s design. Its operational electricity requirements will be supported by Waste Heat Recovery Power Generation (“WHRPG”), which captures residual heat from the production process and converts it into electricity more efficiently. The development of solar power generation is also planned as part of broader efforts to increase the use of clean energy within the industrial estate.

In addition to the processing facility, the project includes the development of supporting infrastructure, including a logistics jetty, utility facilities, worker accommodation and various social facilities required to support long-term operations.

Sustainable Downstreaming Strengthens National Industrial Sovereignty

Minister of Investment and Downstreaming and Head of the Indonesia Investment Coordinating Board (“BKPM”), Rosan Perkasa Roeslani, emphasised that the development of the Sambalagi HPAL facility reflected a new direction for Indonesia’s downstreaming agenda—one that not only seeks to increase the value added of mineral resources, but also  establishes new standards for international collaboration, sustainability and development that  delivers tangible benefits for communities.

“Sambalagi HPAL is setting a new benchmark today, rather than merely following existing standards. This project is clear evidence that cross-border collaboration between Indonesia, South Korea and China can proceed in alignment with our national interests: strengthening sovereignty over our natural resources, creating employment and improving public welfare,” Rosan said.

According to Rosan, the arrival of the autoclave symbolised a much broader journey. It represented not merely the construction of an industrial facility, but a tangible step towards establishing an integrated and sustainable downstream ecosystem that would strengthen Indonesia’s future competitiveness.

“Today, we are indeed welcoming the arrival of the autoclave at Sambalagi HPAL. However, what we are truly building is not merely an industrial facility. We are building a comprehensive downstream ecosystem and a better future for the people of Central Sulawesi and Indonesia. This is the true meaning of downstreaming: creating value, creating opportunity and creating hope,” he added.

Rosan also commended the development of the area for extending beyond the construction of industrial facilities to include supporting amenities such as sports facilities, recreational spaces and other social infrastructure that can benefit surrounding communities. He said this approach reflected the development of an inclusive industrial estate focused on improving quality of life.

Furthermore, he noted that the commitment demonstrated by PT Vale and its partners to developing a low-carbon industrial estate was aligned with the Government of Indonesia’s Net Zero Emissions agenda. This would ensure that current development not only generated economic benefits, but also safeguarded environmental sustainability for future generations.

Regional Government Supports the Development of a Sustainable Industrial Estate

Echoing the remarks of Minister of Investment and Downstreaming, Head of BKPM and Chief Executive Officer of Danantara Indonesia Rosan Perkasa Roeslani, Deputy Governor of Central Sulawesi Reny Arniwaty Lamadjido also expressed her appreciation for the development of Sambalagi HPAL.

She noted that the project not only promoted economic growth through downstreaming, but also gave due attention to social considerations. In her view, the development of an industrial estate should generate benefits that can be experienced directly by surrounding communities.

“We appreciate the commitment of PT Vale and its partners, who are not only developing an industrial estate, but also creating opportunities for local micro, small and medium enterprises to grow and providing communities with access to the facilities that have been developed. This is the kind of approach we expect, where economic growth progresses alongside improvements in people’s quality of life,” she said.

Meanwhile, Morowali Regent Iksan Baharudin Abdul Rauf welcomed the progress achieved in the construction of the Sambalagi HPAL Project, describing it as an important driver of regional economic growth and a development that further reinforces Morowali’s position as a national centre for mineral downstreaming.

“The Morowali Regency Government welcomes the progress of the Sambalagi HPAL Project as part of the effort to stimulate regional economic growth through industrial downstreaming.

We believe that investments of this nature will create more employment opportunities, stimulate local businesses and generate a broader multiplier effect for regional development,” Iksan said.

He emphasised that the Morowali Regency Government remained committed to fostering a conducive investment climate and strengthening collaboration with all stakeholders to ensure that the development of the industrial estate delivered optimal benefits for local communities.

“The successful development of an industrial estate requires close collaboration between government, business and communities. The Morowali Regency Government therefore stands ready to continue working in synergy with PT Vale and all partners to support the development of a competitive and sustainable industrial estate capable of creating prosperity for the people of Morowali,” he added.

The arrival of the autoclave provides an important foundation for the installation of major equipment, commissioning and, ultimately, the commencement of operations at the Sambalagi HPAL facility.

Through this project, PT Vale and its partners, through PT BNSI, continue to strengthen their role in supporting Indonesia’s national downstreaming agenda, increasing the value added of the country’s mineral resources and reinforcing Indonesia’s position as a strategic participant in the global battery-industry supply chain and the energy transition.

id.title: Proyek HPAL Sambalagi Capai Tonggak Penting dengan Kedatangan Autoclave, Perkuat Masa Depan Hilirisasi Berkelanjutan
id.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), anggota Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID) bersama mitranya GEM Co. Ltd., dan Ecopro kembali mencatat tonggak penting dalam pengembangan hilirisasi nikel berkelanjutan melalui kedatangan autoclave, peralatan utama untuk proyek High Pressure Acid Leaching (HPAL) di Sambalagi, Bungku Pesisir, Morowali, Sulawesi Tengah pada Rabu (22/7/2026). Momentum ini menandai kemajuan signifikan dalam pembangunan fasilitas pengolahan nikel berkarbon rendah yang menjadi bagian dari Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali.
id.body:
Morowali, 22 Juli 2026 — Upaya memperkuat hilirisasi nikel nasional dan membangun rantai pasok industri baterai berkelanjutan kembali mencatat kemajuan penting. PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), anggota Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID) bersama mitranya GEM Co. Ltd., dan Ecopro kembali mencatat tonggak penting dalam pengembangan hilirisasi nikel berkelanjutan melalui kedatangan autoclave, peralatan utama untuk proyek High Pressure Acid Leaching (HPAL) di Sambalagi, Bungku Pesisir, Morowali, Sulawesi Tengah pada Rabu (22/7/2026). Momentum ini menandai kemajuan signifikan dalam pembangunan fasilitas pengolahan nikel berkarbon rendah yang menjadi bagian dari Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali.

Sebagai Proyek Strategis Nasional (PSN), Proyek HPAL Sambalagi menjadi bagian penting dari agenda pemerintah dalam mempercepat hilirisasi nikel dan pengembangan ekosistem kendaraan listrik nasional. Status tersebut ditetapkan melalui Permenko Perekonomian No. 9 Tahun 2022 dan No. 21 Tahun 2022 yang menetapkan mega-proyek integrasi tambang PT Vale di Blok Bahodopi dan fasilitas pengolahan nikel sebagai PSN. Proyek HPAL terintegrasi dengan tambang Blok Bahodopi ini dikembangkan melalui PT Bahodopi Nickel Smelting Indonesia (BNSI), perusahaan patungan antara PT Vale, GEM Co., Ltd., dan EcoPro. Berlokasi di kawasan Indonesia Green Industrial Park (IGIP), Morowali, Sulawesi Tengah, proyek ini dirancang untuk mendukung pengembangan industri hilir nikel yang berdaya saing global sekaligus mendukung transisi menuju ekonomi rendah karbon. 
 

Kedatangan autoclave merupakan milestone strategis dalam tahapan konstruksi proyek. Sebagai peralatan utama dalam teknologi HPAL, autoclave berperan sebagai inti proses pengolahan bijih limonit melalui kombinasi suhu tinggi, tekanan tinggi, dan asam sulfat untuk mengekstraksi nikel dan kobalt secara efisien.

Hasil pengolahan tersebut berupa Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate (MHP), material antara yang menjadi bahan baku penting dalam rantai pasok industri baterai kendaraan listrik. Fasilitas HPAL Sambalagi dirancang memiliki kapasitas produksi sekitar 90.000 ton kandungan nikel per tahun dalam bentuk MHP, dengan pasokan bahan baku sekitar 10,4 juta ton bijih limonit per tahun yang berasal dari area pertambangan PT Vale di Bahodopi. Pabrik dibangun dalam tiga jalur produksi (Line A, B, dan C) sebagai bagian dari pengembangan fasilitas yang ditargetkan mencapai first mechanical completion pada akhir 2026.

Presiden Direktur & Chief Executive Officer PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, Bernardus Irmanto, mengatakan bahwa kedatangan autoclave menjadi simbol kemajuan nyata proyek sekaligus mempertegas komitmen perusahaan dalam menghadirkan hilirisasi mineral yang berkelanjutan.  

"Kedatangan autoclave ini merupakan tonggak penting dalam Proyek HPAL Sambalagi. Sebagai jantung dari proses HPAL, autoclave akan memungkinkan pengolahan bijih limonit menjadi produk bernilai tambah tinggi yang mendukung rantai pasok global kendaraan listrik. Momentum ini mencerminkan komitmen PT Vale bersama para mitra untuk menghadirkan industri pengolahan nikel yang berdaya saing, mengedepankan prinsip keberlanjutan, keselamatan kerja, serta memberikan manfaat jangka panjang  bagi Indonesia dan masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasi," tuturnya.

Sebagai bagian dari komitmen terhadap operasi yang lebih berkelanjutan, Proyek HPAL Sambalagi juga mengintegrasikan berbagai solusi rendah karbon dalam desain fasilitasnya. Kebutuhan listrik operasional akan didukung oleh Waste Heat Recovery Power Generation (WHRPG) yang memanfaatkan panas sisa proses produksi untuk menghasilkan listrik secara lebih efisien. Selain itu, pengembangan pembangkit listrik tenaga surya juga direncanakan 
sebagai bagian dari upaya meningkatkan pemanfaatan energi bersih di kawasan industri.

Selain membangun fasilitas pengolahan, proyek ini turut mengembangkan infrastruktur pendukung seperti dermaga logistik, fasilitas utilitas, kawasan hunian pekerja, serta berbagai fasilitas sosial yang akan menunjang operasional jangka panjang.

Hilirisasi Berkelanjutan Perkuat Kedaulatan Industri Nasional

Menteri Investasi dan Hilirisasi/Kepala Badan Koordinasi Penanaman Modal (BKPM), Rosan Perkasa Roeslani, menegaskan bahwa pembangunan HPAL Sambalagi mencerminkan arah baru hilirisasi Indonesia yang tidak hanya berorientasi pada peningkatan nilai tambah mineral, tetapi juga menetapkan standar baru dalam kolaborasi internasional, keberlanjutan, dan pembangunan yang memberikan manfaat nyata bagi masyarakat.

“HPAL Sambalagi hari ini menempatkan standar baru, bukan sekadar mengikuti standar yang sudah ada. Proyek ini adalah bukti nyata bahwa kolaborasi lintas negara—Indonesia, Korea Selatan, dan Tiongkok—dapat berjalan selaras dengan kepentingan nasional kita, yaitu membangun kedaulatan sumber daya, membuka lapangan kerja, dan meningkatkan kesejahteraan masyarakat,” ujar Rosan.

Menurut Rosan, kedatangan autoclave merupakan simbol dari perjalanan yang lebih besar. Bukan hanya pembangunan sebuah fasilitas industri, tetapi langkah nyata dalam membangun ekosistem hilirisasi yang terintegrasi dan berkelanjutan untuk memperkuat daya saing Indonesia di masa depan.

“Hari ini kita memang menyambut kedatangan autoclave di HPAL Sambalagi. Namun yang sesungguhnya sedang kita bangun bukan hanya sebuah fasilitas industri. Kita sedang membangun ekosistem hilirisasi yang lengkap dan masa depan yang lebih baik bagi masyarakat Sulawesi Tengah dan Indonesia. Inilah makna sesungguhnya dari hilirisasi: menciptakan nilai, menciptakan kesempatan, dan menciptakan harapan,” tambahnya.

Rosan juga mengapresiasi pengembangan kawasan yang tidak hanya berfokus pada pembangunan fasilitas industri, tetapi turut menyediakan berbagai fasilitas penunjang seperti sarana olahraga, ruang rekreasi, dan fasilitas sosial lainnya yang dapat memberikan manfaat bagi masyarakat sekitar. Menurutnya, pendekatan tersebut mencerminkan pembangunan kawasan industri yang inklusif dan berorientasi pada peningkatan kualitas hidup.

Lebih lanjut, ia menilai komitmen PT Vale bersama para mitra dalam mengembangkan kawasan industri rendah karbon sejalan dengan agenda Pemerintah Indonesia untuk mencapai Net Zero Emissions, sehingga pembangunan yang dilakukan hari ini tidak hanya memberikan manfaat ekonomi, tetapi juga menjaga keberlanjutan lingkungan bagi generasi mendatang.

Pemerintah Daerah Dukung Pengembangan Kawasan Industri Berkelanjutan

Senada dengan Menteri Investasi dan Hilirisasi/Kepala BKPM sekaligus Chief Executive Officer Danantara Indonesia, Rosan Perkasa Roeslani, Wakil Gubernur Sulawesi Tengah, Reny Arniwaty Lamadjido turut mengapresiasi pengembangan HPAL Sambalagi yang dinilai tidak hanya mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi melalui hilirisasi, tetapi juga memberikan perhatian terhadap aspek sosial. Menurutnya, pengembangan kawasan industri seyogianya mampu menghadirkan manfaat yang dapat dirasakan langsung oleh masyarakat sekitar.

“Kami mengapresiasi komitmen PT Vale dan para mitra yang tidak hanya membangun kawasan industri, tetapi juga memberikan ruang bagi UMKM lokal untuk berkembang serta membuka akses bagi masyarakat terhadap berbagai fasilitas yang telah dibangun. Pendekatan seperti inilah yang kami harapkan, di mana pertumbuhan ekonomi berjalan 
seiring dengan peningkatan kualitas hidup masyarakat,” ujarnya.

Sementara itu Bupati Morowali, Iksan Baharudin Abdul Rauf, menyampaikan apresiasinya atas kemajuan pembangunan Proyek HPAL Sambalagi yang dinilai menjadi salah satu penggerak penting pertumbuhan ekonomi daerah sekaligus memperkuat posisi Morowali sebagai pusat hilirisasi mineral nasional.

“Pemerintah Kabupaten Morowali menyambut baik perkembangan Proyek HPAL Sambalagi sebagai bagian dari upaya mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi daerah melalui hilirisasi industri. Kami meyakini kehadiran investasi seperti ini akan membuka lebih banyak peluang kerja, menggerakkan sektor usaha lokal, serta memberikan multiplier effect bagi pembangunan daerah,” ujar Iksan.

Ia menegaskan bahwa Pemerintah Kabupaten Morowali berkomitmen untuk terus mendukung iklim investasi yang kondusif serta memperkuat kolaborasi dengan seluruh pemangku kepentingan agar pembangunan kawasan industri dapat memberikan manfaat yang optimal bagi masyarakat.

“Keberhasilan pembangunan kawasan industri membutuhkan kolaborasi yang erat antara pemerintah, dunia usaha, dan masyarakat. Karena itu, Pemerintah Kabupaten Morowali siap terus bersinergi dengan PT Vale dan seluruh mitra untuk mendukung pengembangan kawasan industri yang berdaya saing, berkelanjutan, dan mampu menciptakan kesejahteraan bagi masyarakat Morowali,” tambahnya.

Kedatangan autoclave ini menjadi fondasi penting menuju tahapan pemasangan peralatan utama, commissioning, hingga operasional fasilitas HPAL Sambalagi. Melalui proyek ini, PT Vale bersama mitranya melalui PT BNSI terus memperkuat perannya dalam mendukung agenda hilirisasi nasional, meningkatkan nilai tambah sumber daya mineral Indonesia, sekaligus memperkokoh posisi Indonesia sebagai pemain strategis dalam rantai pasok global industri baterai dan transisi energi.

en.title: Building Value Through Sustainable Mining Practices: Investment Minister Praises PTVI’s ESG Approach in Morowali
en.subtitle: As Indonesia accelerates its downstream mineral processing agenda, Minister of Investment and Downstream Industries/Head of BKPM and CEO of Danantara Indonesia, Rosan P. Roeslani, emphasized the importance of balancing industrial growth with environmental sustainability. Roeslani delivered the message during a visit to PT Vale Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali on Wednesday (July 22), following the arrival ceremony of an autoclave—the key processing unit for the High Pressure Acid Leaching (HPAL) project at the Sambalagi facility.
en.body:
Morowali, July 22, 2026 – As Indonesia accelerates its downstream mineral processing agenda, Minister of Investment and Downstream Industries/Head of BKPM and CEO of Danantara Indonesia, Rosan P. Roeslani, emphasized the importance of balancing industrial growth with environmental sustainability.

Roeslani delivered the message during a visit to PT Vale Indonesia’s (PTVI) Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali on Wednesday (July 22), following the arrival ceremony of an autoclave—the key processing unit for the High Pressure Acid Leaching (HPAL) project at the Sambalagi facility.

During the visit, Roeslani was accompanied by several Danantara executives, including Febriany Eddy, Managing Director of Danantara Asset Management. The delegation was welcomed by PTVI Chief Executive Officer Bernardus Irmanto, Chief Project Officer Muhammad Asril, and other members of PTVI’s management team.

The visit provided an opportunity to review progress on the strategic project and observe several sustainability initiatives implemented by PTVI as part of its operations. Among the sites visited was the company’s nursery facility, which supports post-mining land rehabilitation and reclamation programs.

At the nursery, Bernardus Irmanto outlined PTVI’s environmental management efforts, including nursery development, land rehabilitation and reclamation, sediment pond management, and a range of biodiversity and environmental conservation programs. The presentation highlighted the company’s commitment to ensuring that operational activities are conducted in parallel with environmental stewardship.

Set within PTVI’s operational area, the nursery serves as a tangible example of that commitment. More than a seedling production center, it reflects the company’s long-term strategy of integrating Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles throughout its business lifecycle. Through these initiatives, PTVI aims to balance industrial development, environmental protection, and community empowerment.

Roeslani commended the company’s efforts.

“I am delighted to have the opportunity to visit PTVI’s operations in Morowali. What stands out most to me is the strong commitment to sustainability and the balance maintained between environmental and social considerations. We have seen the nursery facilities and the implementation of international-standard mining best practices. My hope is that these efforts will continue to be upheld,” said Roeslani.

His remarks reflect the growing focus on the quality of investment entering Indonesia. As the country advances its downstream processing strategy to create greater domestic value, sustainability has become a critical foundation for ensuring that economic growth remains inclusive and responsible.

Roeslani stressed that a strong industry is one that grows alongside the communities and environments in which it operates.

“Equally important is maintaining alignment between business objectives, ESG principles, and the interests of surrounding communities. By doing so, investment can deliver sustainable benefits—not only for the company, but also for the region and its people,” he added.

In addition to the nursery visit, the delegation toured the project’s jetty, one of the key infrastructure assets supporting operational activities.

The group also had the opportunity to observe PTVI’s mining operations from the air.

The aerial overview demonstrated how production activities are carried out in parallel with responsible mining practices, including mine area management, environmental restoration, and protection efforts. This approach forms part of PTVI’s broader commitment to supporting Indonesia’s downstream industrialization agenda—not only by creating economic value, but also by delivering long-term benefits for communities and the environment.

Separately, PTVI President Commissioner Fauzambi Syahrul Multhazar also expressed his appreciation for the progress of the Morowali project. According to him, the project demonstrates a high level of readiness in both planning and execution while aligning closely with the government’s downstream industrial development strategy.

“In my view, this project has been well prepared, well planned, and will be executed effectively. It is also fully aligned with the government’s downstream processing agenda. Morowali, in my opinion, serves as an excellent pilot project,” he said.

For PTVI, downstream processing is about more than developing mineral-processing facilities. It is about creating a lasting development legacy—one that balances economic growth, environmental sustainability, and community well-being for generations to come.

id.title: Membangun Nilai Tambah Melalui Praktik Pertambangan Berkelanjutan, Menteri Investasi Apresiasi Praktik ESG PT Vale di Morowali
id.subtitle: Menteri Investasi dan Hilirisasi/Kepala BKPM sekaligus CEO Danantara Indonesia, Rosan P. Roeslani menegaskan pentingnya menjaga keseimbangan antara pertumbuhan industri dan keberlanjutan lingkungan. Pesan tersebut ia sampaikan saat mengunjungi PT Vale Indonesia (PT Vale) Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali, Rabu (22/7/2026), usai menghadiri seremoni kedatangan autoclave, peralatan utama proyek High Pressure Acid Leaching (HPAL) di kawasan pabrik Sambalagi.
id.body:
Morowali, 22 Juli 2026 – Di tengah percepatan agenda hilirisasi nasional, Menteri Investasi dan Hilirisasi/Kepala BKPM sekaligus CEO Danantara Indonesia, Rosan P. Roeslani menegaskan pentingnya menjaga keseimbangan antara pertumbuhan industri dan keberlanjutan lingkungan. Pesan tersebut ia sampaikan saat mengunjungi PT Vale Indonesia (PT Vale) Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali, Rabu (22/7/2026), usai menghadiri seremoni kedatangan autoclave, peralatan utama proyek High Pressure Acid Leaching (HPAL) di kawasan pabrik Sambalagi.

Dalam kunjungan tersebut, Rosan didampingi sejumlah jajaran Danantara, termasuk Managing Director Danantara Asset Management, Febriany Eddy. Kehadiran rombongan disambut langsung oleh Chief Executive Officer (CEO) PT Vale, Bernardus Irmanto, Chief Project Officer (CPO) PT Vale, Muhammad Asril, beserta jajaran manajemen PT Vale lainnya.

Rosan meninjau langsung perkembangan proyek strategis tersebut sekaligus berbagai inisiatif keberlanjutan yang diterapkan PT Vale dalam operasionalnya. Salah satu lokasi yang menjadi perhatian adalah fasilitas nursery atau pusat pembibitan tanaman yang mendukung program rehabilitasi dan reklamasi lahan pascatambang.

Di lokasi tersebut, CEO PT Vale Indonesia, Bernardus Irmanto, memaparkan berbagai upaya pengelolaan lingkungan yang dijalankan perusahaan, mulai dari pengembangan nursery, rehabilitasi dan reklamasi lahan, pengelolaan sediment pond, hingga berbagai program pelestarian lingkungan lainnya. Penjelasan tersebut memberikan gambaran menyeluruh mengenai komitmen perusahaan dalam memastikan kegiatan operasional berjalan seiring dengan upaya perlindungan lingkungan.

Di tengah hamparan area operasional PT Vale, fasilitas nursery menjadi representasi nyata dari komitmen tersebut. Lebih dari sekadar sarana pembibitan, fasilitas ini merupakan bagian dari pendekatan jangka panjang perusahaan dalam mengintegrasikan prinsip lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola perusahaan (Environmental, Social, and Governance atau ESG) ke dalam seluruh siklus bisnisnya. Melalui berbagai inisiatif tersebut, PT Vale berupaya menjaga keseimbangan antara pertumbuhan industri, pelestarian lingkungan, dan pemberdayaan masyarakat.

Apresiasi terhadap upaya tersebut disampaikan langsung oleh Rosan. "Saya sangat senang dan berbahagia dapat melihat langsung lokasi PT Vale di Morowali. Hal yang paling saya perhatikan adalah bagaimana aspek sustainability yang menjaga keseimbangan antara lingkungan dan sosial sangat diperhatikan di sini. Kita melihat adanya fasilitas pembibitan, serta penerapan best mining practices dengan standar internasional. Harapannya, hal tersebut dapat terus dijaga," ujar Rosan.

Apresiasi tersebut mencerminkan meningkatnya perhatian terhadap kualitas investasi yang masuk ke Indonesia. Di tengah dorongan hilirisasi untuk menciptakan nilai tambah di dalam negeri, aspek keberlanjutan menjadi fondasi penting agar pertumbuhan ekonomi dapat berlangsung secara inklusif dan bertanggung jawab.

Rosan menekankan bahwa industri yang kuat adalah industri yang mampu bertumbuh bersama lingkungan dan masyarakat di sekitarnya.

"Yang tidak kalah penting adalah bagaimana kita menjaga keselarasan dari segi bisnis itu sendiri, baik dari aspek ESG maupun dari sisi masyarakat di sekitarnya. Dengan begitu, investasi yang masuk dapat memberikan manfaat yang berkelanjutan, bukan hanya bagi perusahaan tetapi juga bagi daerah dan masyarakat," tambahnya.

Selain mengunjungi nursery, rombongan menuju jetty yang menjadi salah satu infrastruktur strategis penunjang operasional proyek.

Rombongan juga berkesempatan melihat secara langsung aktivitas penambangan PT Vale dari udara.

Dari pengamatan tersebut, terlihat bagaimana kegiatan produksi dijalankan bersamaan dengan penerapan prinsip pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab, mulai dari pengelolaan area tambang hingga upaya pemulihan dan perlindungan lingkungan. Pendekatan ini menjadi bagian dari komitmen PT Vale dalam mendukung agenda hilirisasi nasional yang tidak hanya menciptakan nilai tambah ekonomi, tetapi juga memastikan manfaat yang berkelanjutan bagi masyarakat dan lingkungan.

Apresiasi terhadap proyek PT Vale di Morowali juga disampaikan secara terpisah oleh Komisaris Utama PT Vale Indonesia, Fauzambi Syahrul Multhazar. Menurutnya, proyek ini menunjukkan kesiapan yang matang, baik dari sisi perencanaan maupun pelaksanaan, serta selaras dengan arah kebijakan hilirisasi yang tengah didorong pemerintah.

"Saya menilai proyek ini dipersiapkan dengan baik, direncanakan dengan baik, dan akan dieksekusi dengan baik. Tentunya, proyek ini juga berjalan seiring dengan arah hilirisasi pemerintah. Morowali, menurut saya, menjadi pilot project yang baik," ujarnya.

Bagi PT Vale, hilirisasi bukan semata membangun industri pengolahan mineral, melainkan juga membangun warisan pembangunan yang mampu memberikan keseimbangan antara pertumbuhan ekonomi, keberlanjutan lingkungan, dan kesejahteraan masyarakat untuk jangka panjang.

en.title: Águas Claras Mine Hosts XTERRA Brazil for the Second Time
en.subtitle: Vale-sponsored event brings trail running, mountain biking, duathlon and a night race to Águas Claras Mine in Nova Lima, July 24–26
en.body:
Sponsored by Vale, the event brings together athletes of all levels from July 24 to 26 at the Águas Claras Mine (MAC), in Nova Lima.

For the second consecutive year, XTERRA Brazil will hold a stage at the Águas Claras Mine (MAC), in Nova Lima, on July 25 and 26. During the adventure sports event, the site — normally under restricted access — will be opened to the public to welcome professional and amateur athletes, families, and visitors. The initiative is part of Vale's MAC Future Use project, which converts the former mining area into a space dedicated to sports, leisure, tourism, and community life.

Set in an area surrounded by preserved vegetation, trails, and natural landscapes, the event reinforces the potential of the Águas Claras Mine as a new destination for leisure, tourism, and outdoor sports.

The schedule includes categories for different types of participants. Confirmed events include Elite Sprint Duathlon and Open Sprint Duathlon, Trail Run (10km and 21km), Mountain Bike (MTB) with Short and Long courses, as well as the Open Trail, a 5km night run, and the traditional XTERRA Kids races for children.

Among the new features of the 2026 edition is the Sprint Duathlon, in Elite and Open categories, with R$20,000 in prize money. Mountain biking now offers two course options, expanding opportunities for athletes of different experience levels. The Open Trail, meanwhile, offers a new way to experience the Águas Claras Mine, with a night race amid the region's natural scenery.

Sport Drives New Use for the Territory

 

The Águas Claras Mine is home to the Jambreiro Forest, a 912-hectare nature reserve of preserved Atlantic Forest transitioning into Cerrado vegetation.

Hosting XTERRA demonstrates, in practice, the potential of the Águas Claras Mine as a people-focused territory. By hosting a large-scale sporting event, the area comes to represent a new way of thinking about post-mining spaces, balancing environmental preservation with sport, leisure, tourism, and community life.

"XTERRA allows athletes, visitors, and the community itself to experience the Águas Claras Mine from a new perspective. The event reinforces Vale's commitment to building a positive legacy for this territory. Beyond hosting a competition, we're showing the potential of a post-mining area to generate environmental, social, and economic benefits for the region," says Bernardo Moretzsohn, Future Use Manager.

The competition also boosts the local economy, impacting hotels, restaurants, retail, transportation, and service providers in Nova Lima and Belo Horizonte. It also expands community access to a space undergoing transformation, encouraging income generation, local hiring, and public participation in shaping the area's future.

Event Info
XTERRA Brazil 2026 – Águas Claras Mine
Date: July 25–26, 2026
Location: Águas Claras Mine (MAC) – Nova Lima (MG)

Categories & Start Times

Saturday – July 25

Trail Run 21K – 21 km — Start: 8:00 AM
Trail Run 10K – 10 km — Start: 8:00 AM
Elite Sprint Duathlon – 5km trail run, ~30km bike, 10km trail run — Start: 10:00 AM (elite in lead pack)
Open Sprint Duathlon – 5km trail run, ~30km bike, 10km trail run — Start: 10:00 AM
XTERRA Kids – races from 50m to 800m — Start: 4:00 PM
Open Trail 5K – 5km night run — Start: 6:00 PM

Sunday – July 26

MTB XCM Long – 60 km — Start: 8:30 AM
MTB XCM Short – 40 km — Start: 9:00 AM

Registration: https://www.ticketsports.com.br/e/xterra-mina-de-aguas-claras-2026-85122

en.title: Vale Run debuts in Rio de Janeiro with free registration
en.subtitle: Vale Run Arrives in Rio de Janeiro: Free Registration Opens July 23 for Copacabana Race with 4,000 Spots
en.body:
• The event will take place on the Copacabana waterfront with 5km and 10km races, plus a kids' circuit.
  • Registration opens this Thursday (23) and 4,000 athletes are expected.

Registration for the Rio de Janeiro leg of the 2026 Vale Run Circuit will open this Thursday, July 23, starting at 12 p.m., at vale.com/corridavale. Free to enter, the event will offer 4,000 spots and will take place on August 23 on the Copacabana waterfront. Held since 2024 in several cities across the country, the Vale Run Circuit will hold a stage in the city of Rio for the first time.

The schedule kicks off at 7 a.m. with the start of the 5km and 10km races. At 9 a.m. it will be the turn of the 1km kids' circuit, aimed at children and designed to encourage physical activity and family bonding through sport from an early age.

In the 5km distance, there will be an exclusive category for people with disabilities, aimed at broadening access to the race and providing a more inclusive sporting experience.

"Rio de Janeiro is the city that hosts Vale's headquarters and where we support several sports projects for children and teenagers. This year, we're bringing a stage of the Vale Run Circuit to the city for the first time, as an opportunity to promote health, well-being, and community connection in one of the city's most iconic settings. We want participants to exercise, have fun, and feel motivated to adopt healthier habits, coming together in a space for athletes of all ages and profiles," says Flávia Dutra, Vale's Benefits and Well-Being Manager.

The start will take place near Posto 2 on Copacabana Beach, where there will be an interactive space for the whole family, featuring recreational activities and educational initiatives focused on sport and sustainable mining.

The 2026 Vale Run Circuit has already passed through four cities in the states of Pará, Espírito Santo, and Maranhão. In August, there will be two more stages in Minas Gerais, in addition to the Rio de Janeiro race. The event is sponsored by Vale through the Federal Sports Incentive Law.

Vale in sports
Vale believes in sport as a tool for social transformation, and has invested in sports initiatives for more than 15 years as a result. The leading supporter of national sports via the incentive law, Vale has invested more than R$560 million over the past five years. For the company, sport has been a strategic vector for engaging with society, promoting social development, strengthening its brand, and connecting with key audiences.

SERVICE INFO:
2026 Vale Run Circuit – Rio de Janeiro Stage
Registration: free, starting at 12 p.m. on July 23
Race date: Sunday, August 23, 2026
Location: Copacabana waterfront, in front of Posto 2
Address: Avenida Atlântica, s/nº – Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro
Times: 7 a.m. for the 5km and 10km races; 9 a.m. for the kids' circuit
Events: 5km and 10km races, and 1km kids' circuit
Disability categories in the 5km: wheelchair users, intellectual disabilities, visual impairments, and other disabilities – participatory

Information and registration: vale.com/corridavale

The 2026 Vale Run Circuit has already passed through four cities in the states of Pará, Espírito Santo, and Maranhão. In August, there will be two more stages in Minas Gerais, in addition to the Rio de Janeiro race. The event is sponsored by Vale through the Federal Sports Incentive Law.

Vale in sports
Vale believes in sport as a tool for social transformation, and has invested in sports initiatives for more than 15 years as a result. The leading supporter of national sports via the incentive law, Vale has invested more than R$560 million over the past five years. For the company, sport has been a strategic vector for engaging with society, promoting social development, strengthening its brand, and connecting with key audiences.

en.title: Vale and Wabtec sign agreement to enhance operational safety on the EFC and EFVM railways with advanced signaling technology
en.subtitle: Wabtec's PTC System Strengthens Vale's Rail Safety on Carajás and Vitória to Minas Lines Through 2031
en.body:
Adoption of the PTC system boosts predictability and reliability in railway operations.


       View of km 45 in Bacabeira (MA), where cargo is transported along the Carajás Railroad (EFC), operated by Vale. 
                                                                               Photo: Cristiano Oliveira

Vale is advancing its innovation and logistics efficiency strategy by adopting an advanced operational safety system for its rail transport. The company announced an agreement with Wabtec (NYSE:WAB) to implement the Positive Train Control (PTC) solution in railway management, raising operational safety standards on the Carajás Railroad (EFC) and the Vitória to Minas Railroad (EFVM).

Vale is advancing its innovation and logistics efficiency strategy by adopting an advanced operational safety system for its rail transport. The company announced an agreement with Wabtec (NYSE:WAB) to implement the Positive Train Control (PTC) solution in railway management, raising operational safety standards on the Carajás Railroad (EFC) and the Vitória to Minas Railroad (EFVM).
The PTC system increases predictability and reliability in railway operations through advanced data transmission and monitoring technology. This solution enables real-time management of operations, automatic intervention in risk conditions, and mitigation of critical operational events. The project, with an investment of approximately R$1 billion, will be implemented in phases through 2031 and includes integration with onboard systems and existing infrastructure, ensuring an efficient and safe transition to the new operational standard.

The Vitória to Minas Railroad and the Carajás Railroad, operated by Vale, are already among the safest railways in Brazil, according to ANTT (Brazil's National Land Transport Agency) criteria, and are the only two regular passenger train lines in the country.

"The continuous strengthening of our safety culture and operational excellence is one of the pillars of Vale's future strategy. The adoption of this cutting-edge technology for railway management reinforces our commitment to using innovation as a lever for an increasingly safe, modern, and efficient operation across our integrated logistics chain," says Carlos Medeiros, Vale's Executive Vice President of Operations.

"The implementation of PTC in Vale's operations represents a significant milestone for the advancement of railway safety in Brazil. This project reinforces our commitment to purposeful innovation, driving digital transformation in railways and contributing to safer, more efficient operations," says Danilo Miyasato, President and Regional Leader of Wabtec LATAM.

The technology to be implemented will be Wabtec's I-ETMS (Interoperable Electronic Train Management System), developed by Wabtec and widely recognized in the global market as a benchmark for PTC systems in world-class asset operations.

About Vale
Vale is a global mining company that exists to improve life and transform the future together. Headquartered in Brazil and operating around the world, it is one of the largest global producers of iron ore, copper, and nickel. Its operations include extensive logistics systems integrated with its mines, including railways, maritime terminals, and ports. Vale's ambition is to lead value generation in mining ethically and sustainably. The company also aims to be a leader in steelmaking decarbonization, with competitive iron ore costs, a customer focus and adaptable portfolio, while accelerating growth in copper and increasing operational efficiency in nickel.

About Wabtec
Wabtec Corporation is revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations. The company is a global leader in providing equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail industries, as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. For 155 years, Wabtec has led the rail industry and envisions contributing to a more efficient rail system in the United States and around the world. Visit Wabtec's website at www.wabteccorp.com.

en.title: PTVI Earns Green and Smart Port Initiatives ASRI 2026 Recognition for Sustainable and Digitally Enabled Operations at Balantang Port
en.subtitle: In recognition of its success in integrating environmentally responsible initiatives with digitally enabled operations, Balantang Port has been awarded a Four-Star Rating (Level III) in the 2025 Green and Smart Port Assessment—the first time the facility has achieved this distinction.
en.body:
As part of PT Vale Indonesia Tbk’s (PTVI) commitment to responsible and sustainable mining, the Company continues to advance environmental and operational excellence across its value chain, including nickel logistics and shipping activities. A key focus of these efforts is Balantang Port, a dedicated terminal that supports the handling of logistics and the shipment of nickel products.

In recognition of its success in integrating environmentally responsible initiatives with digitally enabled operations, Balantang Port has been awarded a Four-Star Rating (Level III) in the 2025 Green and Smart Port Assessment—the first time the facility has achieved this distinction.

The Green and Smart Port Initiatives ASRI 2026 Award is the result of a strategic collaboration between Indonesia’s Coordinating Ministry for Food Affairs and IDSurvey to accelerate the transformation of port management practices across the country. The award was presented directly by Indonesia’s Minister of Marine Affairs and Fisheries, Sakti Wahyu Trenggono, to PTVI’s Head of Energy & Logistics Operations, Dahlan, during an official ceremony held in Gresik, East Java, on 15 July 2026.

The event was also attended by several senior government officials, including Coordinating Minister for Food Affairs Zulkifli Hasan, Minister of Transportation Dudy Purwagandhi, Minister of Environment Mohammad Jumhur Hidayat, Minister of Trade Budi Santoso, and Minister of Villages and Development of Disadvantaged Regions Yandri Susanto, who jointly recognized companies demonstrating excellence in green and smart port development.

In his keynote remarks, Zulkifli Hasan highlighted the Indonesian government’s ambition to modernize national port infrastructure while ensuring environmental stewardship.

“The President has directed that Indonesia’s ports become more efficient, modern, and environmentally responsible. Advanced ports must not only strengthen national logistics performance but also uphold sustainability principles,” he said.

According to Dahlan, Balantang Port has implemented a broad range of green and smart port initiatives encompassing management systems, environmental performance, and digital transformation.

“These efforts reflect our commitment to responsible mining practices while supporting the development of more environmentally friendly and technology-driven port operations,” said Dahlan.

The assessment was conducted based on the Green Port Guidelines 3.0/2023, Indonesia’s benchmark framework for sustainable port management and performance evaluation. The framework allocates 80 percent of its assessment score to environmental sustainability criteria (Green Port) and 20 percent to technology and digitalization criteria (Smart Port).

For PTVI, participation in the assessment represents an important opportunity to demonstrate the Company’s commitment to high standards of port governance, safety, operational excellence, and accountability.

“This process has also provided valuable opportunities to benchmark our performance and share best practices while measuring the effectiveness of the green and smart port principles we have implemented over the years,” Dahlan added.

Looking ahead, PTVI remains committed to further strengthening the implementation of green port principles at Balantang Port. The Company expects these initiatives to deliver not only greater operational efficiency but also long-term benefits for the environment and surrounding communities.

Beyond the award itself, the recognition acknowledges the port’s ongoing efforts to advance sustainable management practices, including biodiversity conservation, the adoption of renewable energy solutions, and the integration of real-time operational systems.

The achievement also reflects PTVI’s CARES values, particularly Excellence, which encourages continuous improvement through collaboration, innovation, and process simplification to support sustainable growth.

Dahlan concluded:
“For us, there is no future without mining, and there can be no mining without caring about the future."

id.title: Terapkan Pelabuhan Ramah Lingkungan dan Berbasis Digital di Balantang, PTVI Raih Penghargaan Green and Smart Port Initiatives ASRI 2026
id.subtitle: Sebagai bagian dari komitmen PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PTVI) dalam menerapkan praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab dan berkelanjutan, berbagai upaya terus dilakukan di seluruh lini operasional, termasuk dalam rantai logistik dan pengiriman produk nikel. Sadar akan hal itu, salah satu fokus Perusahaan adalah pengelolaan Pelabuhan Balantang, yang berfungsi sebagai terminal khusus untuk mendukung kegiatan bongkar muat logistik dan pengapalan produk nikel.
id.body:
Sebagai bagian dari komitmen PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PTVI) dalam menerapkan praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab dan berkelanjutan, berbagai upaya terus dilakukan di seluruh lini operasional, termasuk dalam rantai logistik dan pengiriman produk nikel. Sadar akan hal itu, salah satu fokus Perusahaan adalah pengelolaan Pelabuhan Balantang, yang berfungsi sebagai terminal khusus untuk mendukung kegiatan bongkar muat logistik dan pengapalan produk nikel.

Berkat keberhasilannya mengintegrasikan inovasi ramah lingkungan dengan sistem operasional berbasis digital, Pelabuhan Balantang untuk pertama kalinya meraih predikat bintang empat atau setara Level III dalam Asesmen Green and Smart Port 2025.

Penghargaan Green and Smart Port Initiatives ASRI 2026 merupakan hasil kolaborasi strategis antara Kementerian Koordinator Bidang Pangan dan IDSurvey dalam mendorong transformasi pengelolaan pelabuhan di Indonesia. Penghargaan tersebut diserahkan langsung oleh Menteri Kelautan dan Perikanan Republik Indonesia Sakti Wahyu Trenggono kepada Head of Energy & Logistics Operations PTVI Dahlan, dalam seremoni yang digelar di Gresik, Jawa Timur, Rabu (15/7/2026).

Selain Sakti Wahyu, hadir pula Menteri Koordinator Bidang Pangan Zulkifli Hasan, Menteri Perhubungan Dudy Purwagandhi, Menteri Lingkungan Hidup Mohammad Jumhur Hidayat, Menteri Perdagangan Budi Santoso, serta Menteri Desa dan Pembangunan daerah Tertinggal Yandri Susanto, turut hadir dan juga memberikan penghargaan kepada para perusahaan yang menerima green & smart port 2026.

“Bapak Presiden mengarahkan agar pelabuhan-pelabuhan di Indonesia menjadi lebih efisien, modern, sekaligus mampu menjaga kelestarian lingkungan. Pelabuhan yang maju harus mampu mendukung kelancaran logistik nasional sekaligus menerapkan prinsip keberlanjutan,” ujar Zulkifli Hasan saat memberikan sambutan dalam acara tersebut.

Sementara Dahlan menjelaskan, Pelabuhan Balantang telah mengimplementasikan berbagai inisiatif green and smart port, yang mencakup aspek manajemen, lingkungan, dan digitalisasi.

“Seluruh upaya Perusahaan merupakan bagian dari komitmen kami dalam menjalankan praktik pertambangan yang baik sekaligus mendukung transformasi pelabuhan yang lebih ramah lingkungan dan berbasis teknologi,” terang Dahlan.

Penilaian dilakukan berdasarkan implementasi Green Port Guidelines 3.0/2023, yang menjadi acuan standardisasi dan asesmen pengelolaan pelabuhan berkelanjutan di Indonesia. Pedoman tersebut mengintegrasikan aspek pelabuhan ramah lingkungan (Green Port) dengan bobot penilaian 80 persen dan pelabuhan cerdas berbasis teknologi (Smart Port) sebesar 20 persen.

Bagi PTVI, partisipasi dalam asesmen ini menjadi langkah strategis untuk menunjukkan komitmen perusahaan dalam menerapkan tata kelola pelabuhan yang berstandar tinggi, aman, dan bertanggung jawab.

“Partisipasi ini juga menjadi kesempatan berharga bagi kami untuk berbagi praktik terbaik sekaligus mengukur sejauh mana implementasi prinsip green dan smart port yang telah kami jalankan selama ini,” tambah Dahlan.

Ke depan, PTVI berkomitmen untuk terus meningkatkan implementasi konsep green port di Pelabuhan Balantang. Perusahaan berharap berbagai inisiatif yang dijalankan tidak hanya memberikan manfaat bagi efektivitas operasional, tetapi juga menciptakan dampak positif bagi lingkungan dan masyarakat sekitar.

Lebih dari sekadar penghargaan, pengakuan ini menjadi apresiasi atas upaya pelabuhan dalam menghadirkan pengelolaan yang berkelanjutan, mulai dari konservasi keanekaragaman hayati, pemanfaatan energi baru terbarukan, hingga integrasi sistem operasional secara real-time.

Pencapaian tersebut juga sejalan dengan nilai CARES PTVI, khususnya Excellence, yang mendorong perusahaan untuk terus menghadirkan keunggulan melalui sinergi, inovasi, dan penyederhanaan proses guna mendukung pertumbuhan yang berkelanjutan.

“Karena bagi kami, tidak ada masa depan tanpa pertambangan, dan tidak ada pertambangan tanpa memikirkan masa depan,” tutup Dahlan.

en.title: Vale Celebrates Mariana's Anniversary with Immersive Experience and Free Cultural Programming
en.subtitle: Free events on July 17–18 at Praça Gomes Freire celebrate the history and cultural heritage of Mariana, Minas Gerais
en.body:
The public will be able to take part in an immersive experience through the municipality's cultural 
and historical heritage sites. Credit: Otávio Honoratto


As part of the celebrations for Mariana's 330th anniversary, Vale is promoting a special program at Praça Gomes Freire on July 17 and 18, featuring free activities for the public focused on celebrating the city's culture, memory, and historical heritage. On Friday (17th), activities run from 4 PM to 10 PM, and on Saturday (18th), from 10 AM to 6 PM.

The initiative reinforces the company's commitment to preserving Mariana's identity and invites residents and visitors to learn about projects and actions developed in partnership with the community.

The highlight of the program is the "Our Heritage" Immersive Experience, a sensory journey that celebrates the history, culture, and heritage assets of the municipality. The experience offers content that complements the "Our Heritage" web series and reveals unique aspects of Mariana's historical and cultural legacy.
 


Credit: Otávio Honoratto


Visitors will also be able to tour the Dam Decharacterization Program booth, where they can access information about ongoing projects and their progress, including the distribution of social giveaways.

The event will also feature a fair showcasing local producers, associations, and projects supported by Vale — a space dedicated to promoting the work of partner institutions that contribute to the social, cultural, and economic development of the region.

Visitors can also register to tour the company's local operations and learn more about the "Our Heritage" web series, a production that highlights initiatives dedicated to preserving the municipality's historical and cultural heritage.

"Our Heritage" Web Series
Launched by Vale, the "Our Heritage" web series presents stories, people, and initiatives that help preserve Mariana's rich historical and cultural heritage.

Across four episodes, the production highlights iconic sites in the city, such as the Mariana Museum, the School of Traditional Crafts, the Church of São Francisco de Assis, and the Mariana Railway Station, always through the perspective of the people who keep the memory and relevance of this heritage alive for the community.

Watch the episodes at www.vale.com/mariana

"Our Heritage" Immersive Experience and Cultural Programming

When:
July 17 (Friday) – 4 PM to 10 PM
July 18 (Saturday) – 10 AM to 6 PM

Location: Praça Gomes Freire, Mariana (MG)
Free admission

en.title: PT Vale Partners with Yonif 869 Taawu to Advance Sustainable Agriculture and Strengthen Food Security
en.subtitle: Under its Sustainable Environmentally Friendly Agriculture Program (PSLRB), PT Vale has launched an intensive training program on organic agricultural ecosystem management involving 30 soldiers from Yonif 869 Taawu. The training is scheduled to run for five days in IGP Pomalaa, Kolaka Regency.
en.body:
PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), through its Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, is reaffirming its commitment to supporting Indonesia’s food security agenda. Under its Sustainable Environmentally Friendly Agriculture Program (PSLRB), the company has launched an intensive training program on organic agricultural ecosystem management involving 30 soldiers from Yonif 869 Taawu. The training is scheduled to run for five days.

This collaboration represents a strategic effort to strengthen partnerships between the company, local communities, regional government, and the Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI) in Kolaka Regency, Southeast Sulawesi. Through this initiative, participating soldiers are expected to become champions of sustainable agriculture, both within their military unit and in future assignments across other regions.

Transforming Mindsets and Building Agricultural Knowledge from the Ground Up

Although most participants began the program with little to no prior agricultural experience, they demonstrated remarkable enthusiasm and engagement throughout the training.

Koko Komamin, an Organic Agriculture Consultant from Aliksa Organic SRI Consultant, explained that the first day of the program focused on helping participants identify some of the key challenges associated with modern agricultural practices.

Among the issues highlighted were the heavy reliance on synthetic fertilizers and chemical pesticides, which can contribute to declining productivity and increasing vulnerability to pest infestations over time.

“We are encouraging participants to shift their perspective toward soil ecology,” said Koko Komamin. “They are learning to understand the physical, biological, and chemical properties of soil in a comprehensive way. By maximizing the use of organic matter, soils can naturally provide many of the nutrients plants need, reducing dependence on external agricultural inputs.”

Over the five-day program, participants will receive a combination of theoretical and practical instruction. Following foundational lessons on soil ecology, soldiers will take part in hands-on training in organic crop cultivation. The program will conclude with a collaborative discussion aimed at developing long-term action plans that can be implemented within Yonif 869 Taawu.

Strengthening Partnerships for Food Security and Sustainable Development

Charles Cristian, Senior Coordinator of External Relations at PT Vale IGP Pomalaa, noted that the involvement of Yonif 869 Taawu adds a valuable new partner to the company’s network of stakeholders working to advance sustainable regional development in Kolaka.

According to Charles, the collaboration offers mutual benefits. While the military unit continues to fulfill its primary responsibility of maintaining security and stability, its personnel are also being equipped to contribute actively to community empowerment and sustainable development initiatives.

“This is a very positive step, with PT Vale acting as a catalyst and motivator for our colleagues in the military,” Charles said. “While their role is traditionally associated with defense and security, through the PSLRB program we are channeling that same dedication and discipline toward strengthening food security and supporting national food resilience.”

Through this pilot initiative, PT Vale hopes the participating soldiers will gain the knowledge and practical skills needed to apply organic farming methods independently. In the long term, the company expects the program to generate lasting economic, social, and environmental benefits for the soldiers, their unit, and the broader community.

id.title: Wujudkan Ketahanan Pangan, PT Vale Gandeng Yonif 869 Taawu dalam Pelatihan Pertanian Sehat Ramah Lingkungan
id.subtitle: Melalui program Pertanian Sehat Ramah Lingkungan Berkelanjutan (PSLRB), PT Vale menyelenggarakan pelatihan pengolahan ekosistem pertanian organik yang melibatkan 30 prajurit dari kesatuan Yonif 869 Taawu. Pelatihan intensif ini direncanakan berlangsung selama lima hari di IGP Pomalaa, Kabupaten Kolaka .
id.body:
PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa menunjukkan komitmen nyata dalam mendukung kedaulatan pangan nasional. Melalui program Pertanian Sehat Ramah Lingkungan Berkelanjutan (PSLRB), PT Vale menyelenggarakan pelatihan pengolahan ekosistem pertanian organik yang melibatkan 30 prajurit dari kesatuan Yonif 869 Taawu. Pelatihan intensif ini direncanakan berlangsung selama lima hari.

Kolaborasi ini menjadi langkah strategis untuk memperkuat sinergi antara perusahaan, masyarakat, pemerintah daerah, dan unsur TNI di wilayah Kabupaten Kolaka. Melalui pembekalan ini, para prajurit TNI diharapkan dapat menjadi motor penggerak sektor pertanian ramah lingkungan, baik di lingkungan kesatuan maupun saat bertugas di tempat lain di masa depan.

Mengubah Pola Pikir, Memulai Pertanian dari Nol

Meskipun para prajurit Yonif 869 Taawu memulai pengetahuan mereka dari nol di bidang pertanian, antusiasme dan respons positif ditunjukkan secara luar biasa sepanjang kegiatan berlangsung.

Konsultan Pertanian Organik dari Aliksa Organik SRI Consultant, Koko Komamin, menjelaskan bahwa pada hari pertama pelatihan, para peserta diajak untuk mengidentifikasi berbagai benang kusut dalam dunia pertanian modern.

Masalah utama yang disorot meliputi tingginya ketergantungan pada pupuk kimia dan pestisida buatan yang justru memicu penurunan produktivitas serta peningkatan intensitas serangan hama tanaman.

"Kami mencoba membongkar kebekuan pikiran para prajurit agar beralih ke konsep ekologi tanah. Mereka diajak memahami secara mendalam sifat fisik, biologi, dan kimia tanah. Dengan mengoptimalkan bahan organik di dalam tanah, nutrisi tanaman sebenarnya sudah tersedia secara mandiri tanpa harus terus-menerus mendatangkan input dari luar," ujar Koko Komamin.

Selama lima hari, materi pelatihan akan disampaikan secara komprehensif. Selain teori ekologi tanah di awal, para prajurit akan dibekali dengan praktik budidaya tanaman organik. Di akhir rangkaian acara, akan diadakan sesi diskusi untuk merencanakan aksi nyata jangka panjang yang dapat diterapkan di kesatuan Yonif 869 Taawu.

Sinergi untuk Stabilitas dan Kedaulatan Pangan

Sementara itu, Senior Coordinator External Relation PT Vale IGP Pomalaa, Charles Cristian, mengungkapkan bahwa kehadiran Yonif 869 Taawu memperkaya jajaran mitra strategis perusahaan di Kolaka dalam mendorong keberlanjutan wilayah.

Kolaborasi ini dinilai saling menguntungkan (win-win solution). Selain menjalankan fungsi utamanya menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas wilayah, kehadiran tim keamanan TNI kini juga ikut berkontribusi aktif dalam program pemberdayaan masyarakat.

"Ini adalah langkah yang sangat baik di mana PT Vale berperan sebagai motivator bagi teman-teman TNI. Jika selama ini urusan utama mereka identik dengan persenjataan, melalui pelatihan PSLRB ini kita bersama-sama mengalihkan energi untuk memperkuat ketahanan pangan dan kedaulatan pangan bangsa," kata Charles.

Melalui program percontohan ini, PT Vale berharap para prajurit mampu memahami sekaligus mengaplikasikan ilmu pertanian organik secara mandiri di lapangan, sehingga dapat membawa dampak ekonomi dan lingkungan yang berkelanjutan bagi diri sendiri, kesatuan, maupun masyarakat luas.

en.title: Preserving Tradition, Creating Opportunities: PT Vale-Supported MSME Products Showcased at the 2026 National PKK Movement Day and Dekranas Anniversary
en.subtitle: PT Vale once again demonstrated its commitment to supporting micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) while preserving local culture through its participation in the 54th National Family Welfare Movement Day (HKG PKK) and the 46th Anniversary of the National Crafts Council (Dekranas) held in Makassar. During the exhibition at Trans Studio Mall Makassar from July 9–11, 2026, PT Vale showcased a range of products from its assisted MSMEs, including Teduhu woven crafts from Nuha Village and Sampa Konao crafts from Matano Village.
en.body:
PT Vale once again demonstrated its commitment to supporting micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) while preserving local culture through its participation in the 54th National Family Welfare Movement Day (HKG PKK) and the 46th Anniversary of the National Crafts Council (Dekranas) held in Makassar. During the exhibition at Trans Studio Mall Makassar from July 9–11, 2026, PT Vale showcased a range of products from its assisted MSMEs, including Teduhu woven crafts from Nuha Village and Sampa Konao crafts from Matano Village.

This participation reflects PT Vale’s commitment to promoting community economic independence while introducing the cultural richness of East Luwu to a broader audience.

According to Endra Kusuma, Head of External Relations Regional and Growth at PT Vale, national events such as HKG PKK and the Dekranas Anniversary provide valuable opportunities for assisted MSMEs to expand their market reach and enhance their competitiveness.

“We want the communities we support to become more economically independent, build sustainable businesses, and gain greater recognition for their products—not only at the regional level but also nationally,” said Endra.

PT Vale’s support for MSMEs goes beyond product promotion. Through its Community Development and Empowerment Program (PPM), the company provides comprehensive assistance ranging from business infrastructure support and business management training to marketing, product development, and branding strategies. These programs involve experienced trainers and experts who help entrepreneurs improve product quality and strengthen their competitiveness.

In addition, PT Vale continues to create promotional opportunities through participation in various exhibitions, including events organized in collaboration with Indonesia’s Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM). The company also operates an MSME Gallery, serving as a permanent showcase for products developed by its assisted enterprises.

One of the standout products featured at the exhibition was Teduhu weaving, a traditional craft that carries significant cultural value but faces challenges related to the declining number of artisans.

“There used to be many artisans practicing this craft, but their numbers have decreased as fewer young people are interested in learning it. That is why we provide training for younger generations to ensure these skills remain alive and are not lost,” Endra explained.

These efforts have begun to yield positive results. Several assisted MSMEs have participated in provincial and national-level exhibitions, including events in Jakarta. Today, around five to ten assisted MSMEs have successfully expanded their market reach across the province, with the food and beverage sector continuing to be the largest contributor.

To further promote local products, PT Vale also utilizes products made by its assisted MSMEs as official souvenirs for guests and business partners. This initiative is expected to increase product exposure while opening up new market opportunities for MSME entrepreneurs in East Luwu.

Beyond supporting the exhibition, PT Vale also participated in the “Jalan Sehat Anti Mager” (Anti-Sedentary Healthy Walk) held on Saturday, July 11, as part of the 2026 National HKG PKK and Dekranas Anniversary celebrations. The company’s involvement reflects its commitment to strengthening collaboration with various stakeholders to support community empowerment, cultural preservation, and inclusive economic growth.

id.title: Melestarikan Tradisi, Membuka Peluang: Produk UMKM Binaan PTVI Tampil di HKG PKK Nasional dan HUT Dekranas 2026
id.subtitle: PT Vale kembali mendukung pengembangan UMKM sekaligus pelestarian budaya lokal melalui partisipasinya dalam Hari Kesatuan Gerak (HKG) PKK Nasional ke-54 dan Hari Ulang Tahun (HUT) Dekranas ke-46 yang digelar di Makassar. Selama pameran pada 9–11 Juli 2026 di Trans Studio Mall Makassar, PT Vale memperkenalkan berbagai produk unggulan dari UMKM binaan, termasuk anyaman Teduhu dari Desa Nuha dan Sampa Konao dari Desa Matano.
id.body:
PT Vale kembali mendukung pengembangan UMKM sekaligus pelestarian budaya lokal melalui partisipasinya dalam Hari Kesatuan Gerak (HKG) PKK Nasional ke-54 dan Hari Ulang Tahun (HUT) Dekranas ke-46 yang digelar di Makassar. Selama pameran pada 9–11 Juli 2026 di Trans Studio Mall Makassar, PT Vale memperkenalkan berbagai produk unggulan dari UMKM binaan, termasuk anyaman Teduhu dari Desa Nuha dan Sampa Konao dari Desa Matano.

Partisipasi ini menjadi bagian dari komitmen PT Vale dalam mendukung kemandirian ekonomi masyarakat sekaligus membantu memperkenalkan kekayaan budaya Luwu Timur ke khalayak yang lebih luas.

Menurut Head of External Relations Regional and Growth PT Vale, Endra Kusuma, ajang nasional seperti HKG PKK dan HUT Dekranas menjadi kesempatan penting bagi UMKM binaan untuk memperluas pasar dan meningkatkan daya saing.

"Kami ingin masyarakat binaan semakin mandiri secara ekonomi, memiliki usaha yang berkelanjutan, dan produk-produknya semakin dikenal, tidak hanya di tingkat daerah tetapi juga nasional," ujar Endra.


Dukungan PT Vale terhadap UMKM tidak berhenti pada promosi produk. Melalui Program Pengembangan dan Pemberdayaan Masyarakat (PPM), PT Vale juga memberikan pendampingan yang mencakup penyediaan sarana usaha, pelatihan manajemen bisnis, pemasaran, pengembangan produk, hingga strategi branding. Berbagai pelatihan tersebut menghadirkan narasumber berpengalaman untuk membantu para pelaku usaha meningkatkan kualitas dan daya saing produknya.

Selain itu, PT Vale terus membuka akses promosi melalui berbagai pameran, termasuk kegiatan bersama Kementerian ESDM, serta menghadirkan UMKM Gallery sebagai etalase permanen bagi produk-produk binaan.
Salah satu produk yang mendapat perhatian dalam pameran ini adalah anyaman Teduhu, yang memiliki nilai budaya tinggi sekaligus menghadapi tantangan regenerasi pengrajin.

"Dulu pengrajinnya cukup banyak, tetapi sekarang mulai berkurang karena generasi muda kurang tertarik. Karena itu kami mengadakan pelatihan bagi anak-anak muda agar keterampilan ini tetap hidup dan tidak hilang," jelas Endra.

Upaya tersebut mulai menunjukkan hasil positif. Beberapa UMKM binaan kini telah mengikuti berbagai pameran tingkat provinsi hingga nasional, termasuk di Jakarta. Saat ini, sekitar lima hingga sepuluh UMKM binaan telah berhasil memperluas jangkauan pemasaran mereka ke tingkat provinsi, dengan sektor makanan dan minuman masih menjadi penyumbang terbesar.

Untuk membantu memperkenalkan produk lokal lebih luas lagi, PT Vale juga memanfaatkan produk UMKM binaan sebagai suvenir bagi tamu dan mitra perusahaan. Langkah ini diharapkan dapat meningkatkan eksposur produk sekaligus membuka peluang pasar baru bagi pelaku UMKM di Luwu Timur.

Tak hanya mendukung pameran, PT Vale turut berpartisipasi dalam kegiatan Jalan Sehat Anti Mager yang menjadi bagian dari rangkaian HKG PKK Nasional dan HUT Dekranas 2026 pada Sabtu (11/7). Keterlibatan ini mencerminkan komitmen PT Vale dalam memperkuat kolaborasi dengan berbagai pemangku kepentingan untuk mendorong pemberdayaan masyarakat, pelestarian budaya, dan pertumbuhan ekonomi yang inklusif.

en.title: Vale Launches First-Ever R&D&I Report and Details How Innovation Is Already Transforming the Mining Chain
en.subtitle: With US$685 million invested and 45 AI solutions in use, Vale details how technology, automation and circularity are redefining mining
en.body:
Publication consolidates more than 350 projects and showcases applications of AI, automation, circularity, and decarbonization.
 


Vale has launched its first Research, Development & Innovation (R&D&I) Report, a publication that consolidates investments, governance, partnerships, and applied cases in the transformation of mining. More than just a compilation of technological initiatives, the report shows how R&D&I has become part of the company's strategy to address industry challenges such as operating more safely and efficiently, reducing environmental impacts, and expanding mining's contribution to the energy transition.

In 2025, Vale invested US$685 million (approximately R$3.78 billion) in R&D&I and maintained a portfolio of more than 350 projects. The agenda is supported by 16 proprietary innovation hubs and reinforces ties with academia, with more than R$38.4 million in scholarships linked to R&D&I projects developed at universities and research institutes, and more than R$10 million in research infrastructure.

The report starts from a central premise: the Mining of the Future will be defined by an entire chain transformed by science, data, automation, artificial intelligence, circularity, and lower-emission solutions. This chain begins with mineral research and exploration, moves through autonomous mines, digital plants, railways, ports, and shipping, and reaches steel industry clients with products and industrial models aimed at reducing emissions.

"Building the Mining of the Future requires discipline, continuous learning and the courage to innovate responsibly. The report shows that we are doing this consistently, integrating technical knowledge, field execution and a culture that always puts life first," says Paulo Celso Pires, Vale's Director of Technology and Innovation.

Artificial Intelligence in Practice: 45 Applied Solutions from Mine to Logistics
 


One of the report's highlights is the advance of artificial intelligence in industrial environments. Vale already has more than 45 AI solutions applied across its value chain, used in mining, plants, pelletizing, railways, ports, shipping, asset monitoring, mineral exploration, and corporate areas.

These technologies support decision-making and help solve concrete operational problems: forecasting weather conditions, supporting mining decisions, monitoring critical assets, optimizing maritime fleets, reducing input consumption, improving logistics predictability, and expanding safety. Examples include MinAInteligente, with AI applied to mine efficiency and predictability; SabIA, generative AI for searching technical mineral exploration information; PelotAInteligente, focused on optimizing pelletizing and reducing natural gas consumption; and VESO, a simulator that combines production, costs, and emissions to support decarbonization decisions.

Automation, Safety, and the Future of Work
 


The automation agenda reinforces that the Mining of the Future goes beyond technological evolution and also involves new skills, operating models, and ways of working. More than 90 autonomous pieces of equipment are operating in Brazil, including off-road trucks, drill rigs, and yard machines. The technology allows activities to be conducted from safer, more connected, and data-driven environments.
This movement is also linked to shaping the future workforce. Around 300 jobs have undergone transformation, with employees trained for new roles or to work differently, interacting with autonomous vehicles and machines.

 


Capanema Mine – MG. Credit: Nayara Leite


Among the most representative examples is the Capanema mine, in Ouro Preto, Minas Gerais, resumed after 22 years of inactivity. The operation was designed in line with the company's new paradigms: 100% autonomous operation, dry mining, no water use in processing, no tailings generation, no dams, and reuse of ore contained in a former waste rock pile.

Generating Value from What Has Already Been Mined
In 2025, Vale produced 26.3 million tonnes of iron ore from circular sources, equivalent to about 8% of total production — more than double what it produced the previous year. The goal is to reach 10% of annual production by 2030.
The Circular Mining Program brings together more than 100 initiatives, including the reuse of waste rock and tailings, sustainable sand production, the block factory at the Pico Mine, and solutions that turn materials previously treated as liabilities into new products or inputs for the production chain.

From Mine to Ship — and to the Customer
 


Innovation in mining also extends beyond the mine itself. In ports, railways, and shipping, Vale develops solutions aimed at safety, logistics efficiency, emissions reduction, and operational predictability. Initiatives include drones for ship mooring at Porto Norte (São Luís, MA), solar panels on Carajás Railroad locomotives, AIFleet, Ecoshipping, and VESO, a simulation tool that combines costs, production, and emissions.
In the steel chain, the company highlights products and solutions aimed at reducing customer emissions. Iron ore briquettes have the potential to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in steelmaking by up to 10%, while Mega Hubs can reduce emissions by up to 70% compared to the traditional route.


The full report can be accessed here.

en.title: Vale amplia parceria com o Rock in Rio em 2026 e patrocina o espetáculo ECCO by LightWire
en.subtitle: Com patrocínio da Vale, nova atração do Rock in Rio 2026 reúne inovação, arte e natureza em uma experiência imersiva.
en.body:
A Vale será a patrocinadora principal do ECCO by LightWire, espetáculo inédito criado exclusivamente para o Rock in Rio 2026. A atração, anunciada pelo festival, será apresentada na Cidade do Rock e propõe uma experiência imersiva em 360°, unindo luz, som, tecnologia, movimento, aromas e natureza em uma narrativa sensorial inspirada na floresta.

Criado pela LightWire, o espetáculo parte da ideia de que a floresta é uma das origens do som. A partir das vibrações da natureza, como o vento, a água, as raízes e o fogo, a experiência convida o público a refletir sobre a relação entre o planeta, a música, a arte e a emoção.

Além do patrocínio ao espetáculo, a Vale também estará presente no festival com um estande imersivo, ampliando a conexão do público com temas como natureza, cultura, inovação e conservação ambiental.

Uma parceria que conecta natureza, cultura e inovação

A presença da Vale em grandes eventos culturais tem buscado ampliar o diálogo com a sociedade a partir de experiências que aproximam o público de temas relevantes para o futuro.

Em 2025, a empresa foi patrocinadora principal do Amazônia Live, movimento de alcance nacional realizado pelo The Town e pelo Rock in Rio. No mesmo ano, a Vale também marcou presença no The Town, em São Paulo, com um estande imersivo dedicado à floresta amazônica.

Inspirada em uma vitória-régia gigante, a estrutura tinha 10 metros de diâmetro e 5 metros de altura, proporcionando ao público uma experiência sensorial que reforçava a conexão entre natureza, cultura e inovação.

Rock in Rio 2026

O Rock in Rio 2026 será realizado na Cidade do Rock, no Parque Olímpico do Rio de Janeiro, nos dias 4, 5, 6, 7, 11, 12 e 13 de setembro.

Acompanhe a gente nas redes sociais da Vale pra não perder nada dessa cobertura!
