en.title: East Luwu Steps Up Anti-Drug Efforts with PT Vale–BNN School Initiative
en.subtitle: The Drug-Free School initiative (Sekolah Bersinar) was introduced by PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) in response to drug abuse concerns shared by local authorities. In collaboration with the South Sulawesi BNN and the Youth Planning Forum (GenRe), the program aims to strengthen awareness among adolescents while building resilience within schools and communities against drug-related threats.
en.body:
Pengedaran dan penyalahgunaan narkoba masih menjadi ancaman serius di Sulawesi Selatan (Sulsel). Data Badan Narkotika Nasional (BNN) 2023-2025 menunjukkan, Sulsel menepati posisi keempat sebagai provinsi dengan tingkat penyalahgunaan dan kasus narkoba tertinggi di Indonesia. Demikian menjadi perhatian Bupati Luwu Timur (Lutim), Irwan Bachri Syam melihat wilayah ini sangat strategis sebagai kawasan industri dan jalur perlintasan yang cukup terbuka.

“Di Lutim, saya bisa bilang dengan garis merah karena area perlintasan, dan industri. Cukup ‘seksi’ untuk aliran pengedaran narkobanya,” ungkap Bachri Syam saat memberikan sambutan di acara Deklarasi Sekolah Bersinar: Bersih dari Narkoba, Kamis (7/5/2/2026).

Sekolah Bersinar adalah program yang diinisiasi oleh PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) untuk menjawab keresahan sama yang dirasakan oleh Bachri Syam. Menggaet BNN Provinsi Sulsel, dan Forum Generasi Berencana (GenRe), program ini bertujuan memberikan edukasi yang kuat kepada remaja sekaligus membangun ketahanan lingkungan sekolah dan masyarakat terhadap ancaman narkoba.

Sebanyak 37 Sekolah Menengah Atas (SMA) se-Luwu Timur terlibat dalam realisasi program ini. Selain memberikan apresiasi kepada sekolah-sekolah yang giat menyuarakan anti narkoba, terdapat pula pemilihan Duta Pelajar Anti Narkoba Tingkat SMA se-Lutim untuk kategori putra dan putri.

Deklarasi yang berlangsung di Aula Dinas Pendidikan Lutim ini, menjadi tonggak awal gerakan bersama lintas sektor dalam menciptakan lingkungan pendidikan yang sehat, aman, dan bebas narkoba. Isi deklarasi anti narkoba pun dibacakan oleh para siswa yang kemudian ditandatangani oleh sejumlah pihak, yaitu PT Vale, Kepala BNN Sulsel, Bupati Lutim, dan sekolah-sekolah di Lutim.

Kepala BNN Sulsel, Agung Prabowo menegaskan dalam sambutannya bahwa deklarasi ini menjadi langkah penting dalam memperkuat gerakan pencegahan berbasis pelajar.

Ia menekankan bahwa narkoba kini hadir dalam berbagai bentuk, termasuk jenis baru seperti zat berbahaya yang disalahgunakan melalui media seperti vape. Oleh karena itu, upaya pencegahan harus semakin adaptif dan menyasar kelompok usia rentan, khususnya 15 hingga 64 tahun.

“Ini adalah tantangan besar. Jika tidak kita hadapi bersama, maka akan merusak generasi penerus bangsa. Sekolah Bersinar membutuhkan penggiat, dan penggiat itu adalah para siswa sendiri,” ujarnya.

Melalui program ini, siswa didorong menjadi agen perubahan sekaligus pelopor gerakan hidup sehat tanpa narkoba. Selain itu, integrasi edukasi anti narkoba melalui program seperti Ananda (Aksi Nasional Anti Narkoba Dimulai dari Anak) dan IKAN (Integrasi Kurikulum Anti Narkoba) diharapkan mampu memperkuat karakter pelajar sejak dini. BNN juga menegaskan bahwa pendekatan penanganan kini tidak hanya berfokus pada penindakan, tetapi juga pemulihan dan pencegahan melalui edukasi serta pendampingan.

Dari sisi pemerintah daerah, Bachri Syam menyebut Lutim telah membentuk berbagai langkah strategis, termasuk pembentukan satuan tugas anti narkoba dan penerbitan kebijakan terpadu pencegahan dan pemberantasan penyalahgunaan serta peredaran gelap narkoba (P4GN). Ia berharap ke depan Lutim dapat memiliki BNN Kabupaten sendiri guna memperkuat koordinasi dan efektivitas program.

“Sekolah Bersinar ini adalah awal. Yang terpenting adalah implementasinya. Kami meminta seluruh pihak, terutama guru dan sekolah, untuk terlibat aktif dalam satgas. Lingkungan sekolah harus benar-benar bersih dari indikasi penyalahgunaan narkoba,” tegasnya. Ia juga mengingatkan para pelajar untuk tidak ragu melaporkan jika menemukan indikasi penyalahgunaan di lingkungan sekitar.

Sekolah Bersinar telah terlaksana sejak tahun lalu, dimulai dari menyeleksi para peserta duta pelajar dan penilaian sejumlah sekolah di Lutim. Dari sekitar 100 peserta yang mengikuti proses seleksi, maka di acara deklarasi ini pula diumumkan Putu Adyana dari SMAN 6 Lutim sebagai Duta Pelajar Anti Narkoba kategori putra, dan Kahirunnisa Mukhtar dari SMAN 1 Lutim untuk kategori putri. Selain itu, terpilih juga tiga kategori lain yaitu best influencer, best personality, dan best advocacy.

Para Duta Pelajar Anti Narkoba terpilih menyampaikan rasa bangga dan komitmen mereka untuk menjalankan program edukasi di sekolah. Mereka merancang berbagai inisiatif kreatif, mulai dari kampanye digital, sosialisasi interaktif, hingga festival edukasi untuk memperluas jangkauan pesan anti narkoba di kalangan generasi muda.

Adapun untuk sekolah-sekolah yang mendapat apreasi sebagai sekolah bersinar, di antaranya SMAN 1 Lutim, SMAN 3 Lutim, SMAN 6 Lutim, SMAN 10 Lutim, dan SMA YPS Sorowako.

“Gerakan ini tidak hanya berhenti di deklarasi dan pemilihan duta. Ini baru awal perjalanan Sekolah Bersinar. Hingga saat ini, tercatat 37 sekolah di Luwu Timur telah membentuk satgas anti narkoba sebagai bagian dari gerakan ini. Ke depan, Perusahaan akan menyasar tingkat SMP,” kata Senior Coordinator PPM Health PT Vale, Baso Haris.

Ia menambahkan bahwa program ini merupakan bagian dari upaya perusahaan dalam menciptakan generasi emas yang sehat secara fisik dan mental. Perusahaan berkomitmen mewujudkan anak-anak tumbuh dalam lingkungan yang berkomitmen terhadap pencegahan narkoba, baik di sekolah, keluarga, maupun masyarakat.

Dengan semangat “Gerak Bersama Bersih dari Narkoba untuk Luwu Timur Juara”, deklarasi ini diharapkan menjadi titik awal penguatan kolaborasi antara pemerintah, dunia usaha, sekolah, dan masyarakat. Lebih dari sekadar seremoni, Sekolah Bersinar diharapkan menjadi budaya yang tumbuh di lingkungan pendidikan, menciptakan generasi muda yang sehat, berkarakter, dan bebas dari narkoba menuju Indonesia Bersinar.

Komitmen ini juga sejalan dengan program Pengembangan dan Pemberdayaan Masyarakat (PPM) PT Vale yang mencakup sektor pendidikan, kesehatan, ekonomi, dan sosial. Melalui pendekatan kolaboratif, perusahaan terus mendorong terciptanya lingkungan yang mendukung gaya hidup sehat sekaligus membangun ketahanan generasi muda terhadap berbagai risiko sosial.

Hingga Triwulan I 2026, sejumlah investasi sosial telah digelontorkan untuk mendukung berbagai program sektor strategis seperti pendidikan, kesehatan, ekonomi, lingkungan, serta sosial budaya.

Di sektor pendidikan, perusahaan menjalankan beragam program seperti penyediaan transportasi sekolah, pemberian beasiswa jenjang S2 dan S3, serta penguatan pendidikan usia dini. Sementara di bidang kesehatan, PT Vale aktif mendukung layanan kesehatan masyarakat, pencegahan stunting, serta kampanye hidup sehat berbasis promotif dan preventif, termasuk melalui implementasi Sekolah Bersinar sebagai bagian dari edukasi pola hidup sehat sejak usia dini.

Selain itu, perusahaan juga mendorong pemberdayaan ekonomi masyarakat melalui pengembangan UMKM, agribisnis, serta program kemandirian desa, sekaligus memperkuat aspek sosial budaya dan lingkungan. Hingga kini, sekitar 80 persen karyawan PT Vale berasal dari talenta lokal Luwu Timur, menunjukkan komitmen perusahaan dalam mendorong kemandirian dan kesejahteraan masyarakat setempat.

Melalui integrasi program Sekolah Bersinar dalam kerangka besar PPM, PT Vale menegaskan bahwa pembangunan berkelanjutan tidak hanya bertumpu pada aspek ekonomi, tetapi juga investasi sosial jangka panjang untuk menciptakan generasi muda yang sehat, tangguh, dan bebas dari narkoba.

en.title: Public Hearing – Baixo João Pereira Dam
en.subtitle: Vale holds public hearing in Congonhas, Minas Gerais on May 7 to present the reconformation project for the Baixo João Pereira dam at the Fábrica mine, Paraopeba Complex.
en.body:
Vale will hold a public hearing at 7 PM on May 7 in Congonhas to present the reconformation project for the Baixo João Pereira dam, located at the Fábrica mine, within the Paraopeba Complex. The meeting will take place at the Escola Municipal Senhor Odorico Martinho da Silva school, in the Pires neighborhood, and the company will offer free transportation to the community.

The public hearing is an open space for listening and social participation. During the event, project details and environmental studies will be presented, along with clarification of questions and recording of suggestions and statements from participants. The event is part of the formal steps of the environmental licensing process, currently under review by the state environmental authority.

The Baixo João Pereira dam underwent a readjustment process to comply with the National Dam Safety Policy. Previously built using the upstream method — now prohibited by law — the structure was reconformed in 2024 to the single-stage method, which offers greater stability and safety. The dam retained its sediment containment function, essential for the environmental protection of the region.

"This structure retains sediments from the operation and prevents material from being carried into nature. The readjustment, with new engineering and without the risks associated with the old model, contributes to the responsible continuation of Fábrica mine's activities and reinforces our commitment to the safety and sustainability of our operation in Congonhas," says Eder Leite, director of Vale's Paraopeba Complex.

Following the change in the structure's construction method, the area was revegetated and integrated into the landscape. The current dam is in compliance with environmental and safety legislation, with more efficient sediment control mechanisms, ensuring greater environmental protection.

Last year, Vale's operations in Minas Gerais generated approximately BRL 3.5 billion in taxes and levies, including CFEM, ICMS, TRFM, and ISS. In Congonhas, the Fábrica mine operation collected more than BRL 33.4 million in Financial Compensation for Mineral Resource Exploitation (CFEM) and approximately BRL 16.5 million in Service Tax (ISS) for the municipality in 2025.

Event Details
Public Hearing – Baixo João Pereira Dam Readjustment Project
Date: May 7 (Thursday)
Time: 7:00 PM
Venue: Escola Municipal Senhor Odorico Martinho da Silva – Rua Anastácio Dantas, 37 – Pires neighborhood, Congonhas
More information: vale.com/audienciabaixojoaopereira
Public contact: Alô Vale – 0800 285 7000

en.title: From Crisis to Relief: PT Vale Responds Swiftly to Severe Windstorms and Flooding Impact in Pomalaa
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), through its Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, has reaffirmed its commitment to local communities by swiftly delivering assistance to residents affected by a recent windstorm and flooding in Pomalaa District, Kolaka Regency.
en.body:
Pomalaa, May 5, 2026 — PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), through its Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, has reaffirmed its commitment to local communities by swiftly delivering assistance to residents affected by a recent windstorm and flooding in Pomalaa District, Kolaka Regency.

On Sunday, May 3, 2026, PT Vale provided direct support to six households impacted by the tornado in Huko-Huko Village. Each family received essential relief packages valued at approximately IDR 1.6 million (around USD 100), comprising 50 kilograms of rice, eggs, tea, cooking oil, and five sarongs. In addition, the Company has allocated building materials assistance worth IDR 5 million (around USD 300) per household, which is currently in the procurement process.

The distribution of aid was witnessed by Huko-Huko Village Head, Sahabuddin, who expressed his appreciation for PT Vale’s prompt response and continued support for the affected community.

“We sincerely appreciate the assistance extended by PT Vale. Their swift response has been invaluable for our residents during this challenging time,” said Sahabuddin.

 

PT Vale’s rapid response also extended to a separate incident when flooding struck Pesouha Village on the evening of Monday, May 4, 2026. Through its Emergency Response team, the Company deployed fire trucks to assist residents in clearing mud from homes, yards, and drainage systems.

Iswan, a resident of Pesouha Village, commended the Company’s immediate action, noting its tangible impact in helping the community navigate the emergency.

“PT Vale responded quickly to support residents affected by the disaster. We truly felt the benefits of their presence,” said Iswan, who also serves as Chairman of the Tamalaki Nibandera community organization.

Adam Chalid, Senior Coordinator for Stakeholder Relations at PT Vale Pomalaa, emphasized that the rapid response reflects the Company’s ongoing commitment to supporting communities, particularly in times of emergency.

“At PT Vale, we remain committed to responding swiftly to the needs of communities around our operational areas. Our engagement extends beyond long-term development initiatives—we also ensure timely support during emergencies as part of our social responsibility and care,” he stated.

This emergency response underscores PT Vale IGP Pomalaa’s continued dedication to supporting surrounding communities, not only through sustainable, long-term development programs, but also through prompt and effective action in times of crisis.

id.title: PT Vale IGP Pomalaa Gercep Bantu Korban Puting Beliung dan Banjir di Pomalaa
id.subtitle: Kepedulian terhadap masyarakat kembali ditunjukkan oleh PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PTVI) melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa. Perusahaan bergerak cepat menyalurkan bantuan kepada warga terdampak bencana angin puting beliung dan banjir yang terjadi di wilayah Kecamatan Pomalaa, Kabupaten Kolaka.
id.body:
Pomalaa, 5 Mei 2026 , Kepedulian terhadap masyarakat kembali ditunjukkan oleh PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PTVI) melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa. Perusahaan bergerak cepat menyalurkan bantuan kepada warga terdampak bencana angin puting beliung dan banjir yang terjadi di wilayah Kecamatan Pomalaa, Kabupaten Kolaka.

Pada Minggu, 3 Mei 2026, PTVI hadir langsung memberikan bantuan kepada enam kepala keluarga korban angin puting beliung di Desa Huko-Huko. Bantuan yang disalurkan berupa paket sembako senilai Rp1,6 juta per keluarga, terdiri dari beras 50 kilogram, telur, teh, minyak goreng, serta sarung sebanyak lima lembar. Selain itu, perusahaan juga menyiapkan bantuan material bangunan senilai Rp5 juta per rumah yang saat ini sedang dalam proses pengadaan.
Penyaluran bantuan tersebut turut disaksikan oleh Kepala Desa Huko-Huko, Sahabuddin. Ia menyampaikan apresiasi dan terima kasih atas kepedulian serta respons cepat PTVI dalam membantu warganya yang terdampak bencana.

“Kami sangat berterima kasih atas perhatian dan bantuan dari PTVI. Kehadiran mereka sangat berarti bagi warga kami yang sedang mengalami musibah,” ujar Sahabuddin.

Tak hanya itu, respons cepat juga ditunjukkan Perusahaan saat banjir melanda Desa Pesouha pada Senin malam, 4 Mei 2026. Melalui tim Emergency Response, perusahaan langsung menurunkan armada mobil pemadam untuk membantu warga membersihkan lumpur yang menggenangi rumah, pekarangan, hingga gorong-gorong.

Salah seorang warga Desa Pesouha, Iswan, mengapresiasi langkah cepat tersebut. Ia menyebut kehadiran PTVI sangat membantu masyarakat di tengah situasi darurat.

“PTVI sangat cepat membantu warga yang tertimpa musibah. Kami benar-benar merasakan manfaatnya,” ungkap Iswan, yang juga merupakan Ketua Ormas Tamalaki Nibandera.

Sementara itu, Senior Coordinator Stakeholder Relation Pomalaa PTVI, Adam Chalid, menegaskan bahwa langkah cepat ini merupakan bagian dari komitmen perusahaan untuk selalu hadir di tengah masyarakat, terutama dalam situasi darurat.

“Kami di PTVI berkomitmen untuk selalu responsif terhadap kondisi yang dihadapi masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasi. Kehadiran kami bukan hanya dalam program pengembangan, tetapi juga memastikan masyarakat mendapatkan dukungan cepat saat terjadi bencana. Ini adalah bagian dari tanggung jawab sosial dan kepedulian kami,” jelasnya.

Aksi tanggap darurat ini menjadi bukti nyata komitmen PTVI IGP Pomalaa dalam mendukung masyarakat sekitar, tidak hanya melalui program pengembangan jangka panjang, tetapi juga melalui respons cepat saat terjadi bencana.

en.title: PT Vale Indonesia Strengthens Performance and Lays a Solid Foundation for Sustainable Growth in 2025
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk delivered solid operational and financial performance throughout 2025 amid continued pressure in the global nickel market and evolving domestic regulatory dynamics. Through strengthened operational discipline, robust corporate governance, and a firm commitment to sustainability, the Company successfully reinforced its long‑term growth foundation. Read our 2025 Annual Report.
en.body:
Jakarta, April 30, 2026 – PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” or the “Company”) delivered solid operational and financial performance throughout 2025 amid continued pressure in the global nickel market and evolving domestic regulatory dynamics. Through strengthened operational discipline, robust corporate governance, and a firm commitment to sustainability, the Company successfully reinforced its long‑term growth foundation.


 

During 2025, PT Vale recorded nickel in matte production of 72,027 tonnes, an increase compared with the previous year. From a financial perspective, the Company reported revenue of US$990.2 million, representing a 4% year‑on‑year increase, while net profit rose 32% to US$76.1 million compared with 2024. These results were underpinned by disciplined cost control, optimized sales volumes, and revenue diversification through saprolite nickel ore sales from the Bahodopi and Pomalaa blocks. EBITDA for 2025 stood at US$228.2 million.

To support its growth strategy, PT Vale continued to make significant progress across the strategic projects under the Indonesia Growth Project (IGP). The Bahodopi mine entered its operational phase in 2025, opening a new revenue stream and enhancing the Company’s commercial flexibility. Meanwhile, the Pomalaa IGP and Sorowako Limonite (Sorlim) IGP projects recorded construction progress of approximately 50% and 37%, respectively, while the Morowali IGP approached completion of its initial construction phase. All IGP projects are designed to support downstream nickel processing through High Pressure Acid Leach (HPAL) technology, positioning the Company within the nickel supply chain for the energy transition and electric vehicle ecosystem.

In the area of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance, PT Vale continued to strengthen its position as a sustainable mining company. The Company targets a 33% reduction in Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions by 2030, using 2017 as the baseline year. Throughout 2025, PT Vale completed land reclamation covering 158.09 hectares, replanted 72,296 trees, and continued biodiversity conservation programs. These efforts were reflected in an improvement in the Company’s Sustainalytics ESG Risk Rating to 23.7, positioning PT Vale as the mining company with the lowest ESG risk in Indonesia.

From a governance perspective, the Company achieved a score of 99.53 in the 2025 ASEAN Corporate Governance Scorecard (ACGS), demonstrating consistent application of transparency, accountability, and effective risk management principles. The handling of an oil pipeline leak incident in Towuti, South Sulawesi, in 2025 also served as an important lesson in strengthening emergency response systems, information transparency, and collaboration with communities and stakeholders.

Entering 2026, PT Vale is better positioned with a stronger operational foundation, a growing portfolio of growth projects, and a focused diversification strategy aimed at delivering long‑term value for shareholders and all stakeholders.

About PT Vale Indonesia Tbk
PT Vale Indonesia Tbk is one of Indonesia’s leading nickel mining companies, committed to responsible, sustainable mining practices and long‑term value creation. The Company focuses on occupational safety, environmental protection, community development, and strong corporate governance to support the global energy transition.

id.title: PT Vale Indonesia Perkuat Kinerja dan Fondasi Pertumbuhan Berkelanjutan di 2025
id.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk mencatatkan kinerja operasional dan keuangan yang solid sepanjang tahun 2025 di tengah tantangan pasar nikel global yang masih tertekan serta dinamika regulasi nasional. Melalui penguatan disiplin operasional, tata kelola yang solid, dan komitmen terhadap keberlanjutan, Perseroan berhasil memperkokoh fondasi pertumbuhan jangka panjang. Baca Laporan Tahunan 2025 kami.
id.body:
Jakarta, 29 April 2026 – PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” atau “Perseroan”) mencatatkan kinerja operasional dan keuangan yang solid sepanjang tahun 2025 di tengah tantangan pasar nikel global yang masih tertekan serta dinamika regulasi nasional. Melalui penguatan disiplin operasional, tata kelola yang solid, dan komitmen terhadap keberlanjutan, Perseroan berhasil memperkokoh fondasi pertumbuhan jangka panjang.


 

Sepanjang 2025, PT Vale mencatatkan produksi nikel dalam matte sebesar 72.027 ton, meningkat dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya. Dari sisi keuangan, Perseroan membukukan pendapatan sebesar US$990,2 juta, tumbuh 4% secara tahunan, serta laba bersih sebesar US$76,1 juta, meningkat 32% dibandingkan 2024. Capaian ini didukung oleh pengendalian biaya yang disiplin, optimalisasi volume penjualan, serta diversifikasi sumber pendapatan melalui penjualan bijih nikel saprolit dari Blok Bahodopi dan Pomalaa. EBITDA Perseroan pada 2025 tercatat sebesar US$228,2 juta.

Dalam mendukung strategi pertumbuhan, PT Vale terus mencatat kemajuan signifikan pada proyek-proyek strategis Indonesia Growth Project (IGP). Tambang Bahodopi mulai memasuki fase operasional pada 2025, membuka sumber pendapatan baru dan meningkatkan fleksibilitas komersial. Sementara itu, IGP Pomalaa dan IGP Sorowako Limonite (Sorlim) masing-masing mencatatkan progres konstruksi sekitar 50% dan 37%, serta IGP Morowali mendekati penyelesaian fase awal konstruksi. Seluruh proyek IGP dirancang untuk mendukung hilirisasi nikel melalui teknologi High Pressure Acid Leach (HPAL) sebagai bagian dari rantai pasok nikel untuk transisi energi dan kendaraan listrik.

Di bidang lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola (ESG), PT Vale terus memperkuat posisinya sebagai pelaku pertambangan berkelanjutan. Perseroan menargetkan penurunan emisi gas rumah kaca Lingkup 1 dan 2 sebesar 33% pada 2030 dengan baseline 2017. Selama 2025, PT Vale berhasil melakukan reklamasi lahan seluas 158,09 hektare, menanam kembali 72.296 pohon, serta melanjutkan program konservasi keanekaragaman hayati. Upaya tersebut tercermin dari peningkatan Sustainalytics ESG Risk Rating ke skor 23,7, menjadikan PT Vale sebagai perusahaan pertambangan dengan risiko ESG terendah di Indonesia.

Pada aspek tata kelola, Perseroan meraih skor 99,53 dalam ASEAN Corporate Governance Scorecard (ACGS) 2025, mencerminkan konsistensi penerapan prinsip transparansi, akuntabilitas, dan manajemen risiko. Penanganan insiden kebocoran pipa minyak di Towuti, Sulawesi Selatan, pada 2025 juga menjadi pembelajaran penting dalam memperkuat sistem respons darurat, keterbukaan informasi, serta kolaborasi dengan masyarakat dan pemangku kepentingan.

Memasuki 2026, PT Vale berada pada posisi yang lebih siap dengan fondasi operasional yang semakin kuat, portofolio proyek pertumbuhan yang berkembang, serta strategi diversifikasi yang terarah untuk menciptakan nilai jangka panjang bagi pemegang saham dan seluruh pemangku kepentingan.

Tentang PT Vale Indonesia Tbk
PT Vale Indonesia Tbk merupakan salah satu perusahaan pertambangan nikel terkemuka di Indonesia yang berkomitmen menjalankan praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab, berkelanjutan, dan berorientasi pada penciptaan nilai jangka panjang. Perseroan berfokus pada keselamatan kerja, perlindungan lingkungan, pengembangan masyarakat, serta penerapan tata kelola perusahaan yang baik dalam mendukung transisi energi global.

en.title: Nova Lima safer: decharacterization works completed on 80% of upstream dam structures
en.subtitle: Vale advances dam safety program in Nova Lima, completing decharacterization of four out of five upstream structures and reinforcing 24/7 geotechnical monitoring with cutting-edge technology.
en.body:
Vale continuously invests in technologies and processes to ensure the safety of its dams. The structures are monitored 24 hours a day, seven days a week, through the Geotechnical Monitoring Center (CMG), enabling rapid response in the event of any change in safety conditions. In addition, the structures undergo regular inspections carried out by specialists and by the Engineer of Record (EoR), a professional external to Vale who issues a Regular Safety Inspection Report accompanied by a Stability Condition Statement. All of this work follows an international safety standard called GISTM (Global Industry Standard on Tailings Management), which helps ensure safer and more transparent dam management, from construction through the end of their operational life.
 

At the Monitoring Center, the dams are monitored 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, enabling rapid response in the event of any change in safety conditions.

"At the Geotechnical Monitoring Center, we monitor the dams in real time. We use advanced technologies for the continuous collection of structural data, such as orbital radars and Robotic Total Stations, capable of detecting millimeter-scale movements on the ground surface. All of this technology allows us to act immediately if any change is detected," explains Beatriz Mapa Clemente, CMG Coordinator.

                              Dam B3/B4, in Macacos, had its decharacterization works completed in 2024.


Decharacterization of upstream structures

Prioritizing people's safety, risk reduction, and environmental care, Vale has already completed more than half of the decharacterization works under the Upstream Dam Decharacterization Program in Minas Gerais. In Nova Lima, four of the five upstream structures have already had their works completed: Dam 8B and the Auxiliary Dike of Dam 5 (B5), at the Águas Claras Mine (MAC); Fernandinho Dam, at the Vargem Grande Complex; and Dam B3/B4, at the Paraopeba Complex. The Vargem Grande dam is currently undergoing decharacterization works, with an expected completion date of 2027. All documentation and technical evidence of dam decharacterization is submitted for final validation by the relevant regulatory authorities.

All of Vale's upstream dams are inactive and undergoing decharacterization activities, which is both a legal obligation and a top priority for the company.

                                Dam B3/B4, in Macacos, had its decharacterization works completed in 2024.


PAEBM and new siren testing schedule

The Mining Dam Emergency Action Plan (PAEBM) is a document prepared by Vale in partnership with the Nova Lima Civil Defense, which defines procedures for emergency situations with a focus on reducing risks to the community. It also provides for emergency siren tests that will now follow a unified schedule across the entire municipality, including the Macacos district, taking place in odd-numbered months at 10:00 a.m. on the following dates: July 8, September 2, and November 11, 2026.

More information: www.vale.com/paebm

en.title: Navigating Challenges, Delivering Impact: PT Vale’s ESG Journey Strengthens in 2025
en.subtitle: 2025 marked a pivotal year for PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“the Company”) as it navigated the complexities of the mining industry while reinforcing sustainability as the foundation of its long-term business strategy. Amid rising global expectations for responsible mining practices, the Company successfully transformed challenges into measurable progress by embedding Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles not as a standalone agenda, but as a core driver of long-term value creation.
en.body:
Jakarta, 30 April 2026 – 2025 marked a pivotal year for PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“the Company”) as it navigated the complexities of the mining industry while reinforcing sustainability as the foundation of its long-term business strategy. Amid rising global expectations for responsible mining practices, the Company successfully transformed challenges into measurable progress by embedding Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles not as a standalone agenda, but as a core driver of long-term value creation.

This commitment is clearly reflected in the Company’s 2025 Sustainability Report and 2025 Annual Report, which have been officially submitted to the Indonesian Financial Services Authority (OJK). Far more than mere performance reporting, these publications underscore PT Vale’s ongoing transformation toward more resilient, efficient, and sustainable operations.


 

Throughout 2025, PT Vale increased its environmental investment by 54.3% to US$43.79 million, reflecting an accelerated push toward decarbonization and operational efficiency. These efforts delivered tangible results, including improved energy performance marked by a reduction in energy intensity, further strengthening the Company’s pathway toward low-carbon operations.

The Company’s environmental commitment was demonstrated through its landscape-based rehabilitation initiatives. In 2025, PT Vale rehabilitated 156.67 hectares of post-mining land in Sorowako and extended its positive impact beyond operational areas by restoring 2,988 hectares of watershed areas across five provinces. This approach highlights a strategic focus that goes beyond mine-site restoration to strengthen broader ecosystem resilience—affirming that environmental stewardship is an integral part of PT Vale’s long-term value creation.

On the social front, PT Vale advanced its inclusive growth agenda through community development investments totaling US$4.73 million, an increase of 18.3% from the previous year. These programs focused on education, local economic empowerment, and basic infrastructure development. The Company also maintained a strong commitment to local inclusion, with 83.3% of its workforce recruited from surrounding communities and female representation across the organization rising to 12.1%.

Governance performance also continued to strengthen. PT Vale’s ESG Risk Rating from Sustainalytics improved to 23.7, reflecting a 19.4% reduction in risk exposure and positioning the Company among globally competitive mining players in ESG performance. This achievement is further reinforced by an ASEAN Corporate Governance Scorecard (ACGS) score of 99.53, which reflects best-in-class transparency and accountability practices at the regional level.

President Director and CEO of PT Vale Indonesia, Bernardus Irmanto, said: “2025 was a defining year for us—not only in confronting challenges, but also in strengthening sustainability as a key business driver. At PT Vale, ESG is embedded in every decision we make, shaping how we operate, create value, and contribute to Indonesia’s future. We firmly believe that long-term success can only be achieved when growth and sustainability go hand in hand.”

Looking ahead, PT Vale will continue to deepen ESG integration across its strategic growth projects in Sorowako, Pomalaa, and Morowali. These initiatives are expected to further enhance the Company’s contribution to Indonesia’s downstreaming agenda while supporting the global energy transition.

With an increasingly solid foundation, PT Vale remains committed to delivering responsible mining practices and creating sustainable long-term value for Indonesia and the world.

id.title: Menavigasi Tantangan, Menghadirkan Dampak: Perjalanan ESG PT Vale Menguat pada 2025
id.subtitle: Tahun 2025 menjadi babak penting bagi PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“Perseroan”) dalam menghadapi kompleksitas industri sekaligus memperkuat keberlanjutan sebagai fondasi strategi bisnis jangka panjang. Di tengah meningkatnya ekspektasi global terhadap praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab, Perseroan berhasil mengubah tantangan menjadi kemajuan terukur dengan menempatkan aspek Lingkungan, Sosial, dan Tata Kelola (ESG) bukan sebagai agenda terpisah, melainkan sebagai pendorong utama penciptaan nilai jangka panjang.
id.body:
Jakarta, 30 April 2026 – Tahun 2025 menjadi babak penting bagi PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“Perseroan”) dalam menghadapi kompleksitas industri sekaligus memperkuat keberlanjutan sebagai fondasi strategi bisnis jangka panjang. Di tengah meningkatnya ekspektasi global terhadap praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab, Perseroan berhasil mengubah tantangan menjadi kemajuan terukur dengan menempatkan aspek Lingkungan, Sosial, dan Tata Kelola (ESG) bukan sebagai agenda terpisah, melainkan sebagai pendorong utama penciptaan nilai jangka panjang.

Komitmen ini tercermin dalam Laporan Keberlanjutan 2025 dan Laporan Tahunan 2025 Perseroan yang telah disampaikan secara resmi melalui Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK). Lebih dari sekadar pelaporan kinerja, kedua publikasi ini menegaskan transformasi berkelanjutan Perseroan menuju operasi yang lebih tangguh, efisien, dan berkelanjutan.


Sepanjang 2025, PT Vale meningkatkan investasi lingkungan sebesar 54,3% menjadi US$43,79 juta, mencerminkan percepatan agenda dekarbonisasi dan inisiatif efisiensi operasional. Upaya ini menghasilkan capaian nyata, termasuk peningkatan kinerja energi yang ditandai dengan penurunan intensitas energi, sehingga memperkuat jalur transisi Perseroan menuju operasi rendah karbon.

Komitmen lingkungan Perseroan diwujudkan melalui upaya rehabilitasi berbasis lanskap. Pada 2025, PT Vale merehabilitasi 156,67 hektare lahan pascatambang di Sorowako, serta memperluas dampaknya melampaui wilayah operasional melalui program pemulihan daerah aliran sungai seluas 2.988 hektare di lima provinsi. Upaya ini mencerminkan pendekatan strategis yang tidak hanya berfokus pada pemulihan area tambang, tetapi juga memperkuat ketahanan ekosistem secara lebih luas—menegaskan bahwa pengelolaan lingkungan merupakan bagian integral dari penciptaan nilai jangka panjang Perseroan.

Di bidang sosial, PT Vale memperkuat agenda pertumbuhan inklusif melalui investasi pengembangan masyarakat sebesar US$4,73 juta, meningkat 18,3% dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya. Program-program ini berfokus pada pendidikan, pemberdayaan ekonomi lokal, serta pembangunan infrastruktur dasar. Perseroan juga mempertahankan komitmen kuat terhadap inklusi lokal, dengan 83,3% tenaga kerja berasal dari masyarakat setempat, serta peningkatan representasi perempuan menjadi 12,1% di seluruh organisasi.

Kinerja tata kelola juga terus menunjukkan penguatan. Peringkat Risiko ESG Perseroan dari Sustainalytics membaik menjadi 23,7, mencerminkan penurunan eksposur risiko sebesar 19,4% dan menempatkan PT Vale di antara perusahaan pertambangan dengan kinerja ESG yang kompetitif secara global. Pencapaian ini semakin diperkuat dengan skor ASEAN Corporate Governance Scorecard (ACGS) sebesar 99,53, yang mencerminkan praktik transparansi dan akuntabilitas terbaik di tingkat regional.

Presiden Direktur dan CEO PT Vale Indonesia, Bernardus Irmanto, menyampaikan: “Tahun 2025 merupakan tahun yang menentukan bagi kami, tidak hanya dalam menghadapi tantangan, tetapi juga dalam memperkuat peran keberlanjutan sebagai penggerak bisnis. Di PT Vale, ESG tertanam dalam setiap keputusan yang kami ambil, membentuk cara kami beroperasi, menciptakan nilai, dan berkontribusi bagi masa depan Indonesia. Kami meyakini bahwa keberhasilan jangka panjang hanya dapat dicapai ketika pertumbuhan dan keberlanjutan berjalan beriringan.”

Ke depan, PT Vale akan terus memperdalam integrasi ESG dalam berbagai proyek pertumbuhan strategis di Sorowako, Pomalaa, dan Morowali. Inisiatif ini diharapkan semakin memperkuat kontribusi Perseroan terhadap agenda hilirisasi Indonesia sekaligus mendukung transisi energi global.

Dengan fondasi yang semakin kokoh, PT Vale tetap berkomitmen untuk menghadirkan praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab serta menciptakan nilai berkelanjutan jangka panjang bagi Indonesia dan dunia.

en.title: New siren testing schedule in Nova Lima defined by Civil Defense and Vale
en.subtitle: Civil Defense and Vale announce unified 2026 siren testing schedule in Nova Lima, Minas Gerais, with bi-monthly drills near mining dams.
en.body:
The Civil Defense of Nova Lima, in partnership with Vale, has announced a new unified schedule for safety siren tests in the municipality of Nova Lima. The measure is part of the preventive actions of the Emergency Action Plan for Mining Dams (PAEBM) and aims to strengthen community preparedness in case of potential emergencies.

📅 2026 Testing Schedule

The tests will be carried out every two months, always in odd-numbered months, at 10 a.m. Check the confirmed dates:

•    May 6 (Wednesday) 
•    July 8 (Wednesday) 
•    September 2 (Wednesday) 
•    November 11 (Wednesday) 

🔊 How the tests work
During the tests, a specific sound will be emitted, different from the signal used in real emergency situations. This distinction allows residents to recognize that it is only a drill, preventing panic or confusion.

📞 Contact channels
In case of questions or for more information, residents can contact:
•    Civil Defense of Nova Lima: +55 (31) 3180-5879 / +55 (31) 98699-1190 
•    Alô Vale: 0800-285-7000 
More information about the PAEBM is available on the official website: www.vale.com/paebm

🛑 Dam safety
According to Vale, there has been no change in the safety conditions of the structures. The dams continue to be monitored 24 hours a day and regularly inspected to ensure stability and the safety of surrounding communities.

en.title: Strengthening Its Sustainable Finance Strategy, PT Vale Secures US$750 Million ESG-Linked Syndicated Loan Facility
en.subtitle: Amid growing global demand for critical minerals to support the energy transition, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” or the “Company”) has reaffirmed its strategic commitment to integrating sustainability into its financing strategy through the successful securing of a US$750 million Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL) facility, with an additional US$250 million greenshoe option.
en.body:
Jakarta, 23 April 2026 — Amid growing global demand for critical minerals to support the energy transition, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” or the “Company”) has reaffirmed its strategic commitment to integrating sustainability into its financing strategy through the successful securing of a US$750 million Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL) facility, with an additional US$250 million greenshoe option.

This syndicated loan facility marks PT Vale’s inaugural entry into the syndicated loan market and represents a significant milestone in strengthening the Company’s financial resilience, supporting the development of strategic projects, and advancing responsible mining practices in line with evolving global market expectations. The facility was supported by a syndicate of 14 international banks and was 1.7 times oversubscribed, reflecting strong market confidence in PT Vale’s business fundamentals and sustainability-driven strategy.

As global investment in electrification and renewable energy accelerates, demand for nickel—an essential component in electric vehicle (EV) batteries and energy storage systems—continues to rise. According to projections by the International Energy Agency, global battery storage capacity is expected to increase fourteenfold to meet 2030 climate targets, while EV battery demand is projected to grow sevenfold over the same period.

In this context, PT Vale is strategically positioned as a relatively low-carbon nickel producer, supported by its integrated operations powered by three hydropower plants. The Company is also undertaking enhancements to the capacity and reliability of its hydropower infrastructure to progressively support greater electrification across its operations.


 

The SLL facility has been structured in accordance with the Company’s Sustainability-Linked Financing Framework, aligned with international best practices in sustainable finance. The facility incorporates two key performance indicators (KPIs): a measurable reduction in carbon emissions intensity and an increase in renewable energy consumption.

Both KPIs have received a “strong” rating from an independent Second Party Opinion provider, reflecting their alignment with the Paris Agreement’s 1.5°C pathway, as referenced in independent assessments, as well as their contribution to Indonesia’s Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) targets. The assessment also confirms that the targets represent a meaningful improvement beyond business-as-usual performance.

This sustainability-linked syndicated loan represents a significant milestone for PT Vale and marks its formal entry into the syndicated loan market. The transaction aligns with the Company’s robust growth trajectory, underpinned by disciplined and strategically managed project expansion across Indonesia. President Director and Chief Executive Officer of PT Vale, Bernardus Irmanto, stated: “This facility marks an important step in our journey to align our financing strategy with our decarbonisation agenda and long-term growth ambitions. We remain committed to delivering high-quality nickel with a lower carbon footprint, while supporting Indonesia’s downstreaming agenda and contributing meaningfully to the global energy transition.”

In terms of proceeds utilisation, the facility will support the development of the Company’s strategic projects. In 2026, approximately 50% of the funds will be allocated to the IGP Pomalaa project, around 30% to the IGP Morowali project, and approximately 20% to the IGP Sorowako Limonite project. In 2027, the facility will continue to support the advancement of these projects, as well as the Company’s participation rights in joint venture developments.

As part of its commitment to creating shared value, PT Vale will also channel financial benefits arising from sustainability-linked margin adjustments into community development programmes. This approach ensures that the benefits of achieving ESG targets extend beyond operational performance, contributing directly to improved community welfare in the Company’s areas of operation.

This approach is further supported by the Company’s banking partners, who recognise the importance of integrating sustainability into financing structures. Harapman Kasan, Wholesale Banking Director, UOB Indonesia, stated: “As Southeast Asia’s nickel sector continues to evolve, the role of well-structured transition financing becomes increasingly critical. This transaction reflects our commitment to aligning financing structures with measurable sustainability objectives, while supporting Indonesia’s broader industrial and energy transition priorities.”

Mike Zhang, Global Head of Metals & Mining, Institutional Banking at DBS Bank, added that the metals and mining sector plays a pivotal role in enabling the energy transition and must demonstrate credible and measurable progress in sustainability.

Meanwhile, Ken Matsuo, President Director of PT Bank Mizuho Indonesia, commented:
“The energy sector is a cornerstone of Indonesia’s economy, and we are pleased to support PT Vale’s inaugural syndicated loan. Despite market volatility, the strong participation and oversubscription underscore confidence in PT Vale’s business model. We see ESG integration in financing structures such as this as a critical enabler of a sustainable energy transition.”

Through this achievement, PT Vale further strengthens its position as a mining company that not only prioritises business growth, but also upholds strong commitments to environmental sustainability, social responsibility, and sound governance (ESG), in line with its vision of supporting a cleaner and more sustainable energy future.

id.title: Perkuat Strategi Keuangan Berkelanjutan, PT Vale Raih Fasilitas Pinjaman Sindikasi Berbasis ESG Senilai US$750 Juta
id.subtitle: Di tengah meningkatnya kebutuhan global terhadap mineral kritis untuk mendukung transisi energi, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) menegaskan langkah strategisnya dalam mengintegrasikan keberlanjutan ke dalam strategi pembiayaan melalui perolehan fasilitas Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL) senilai US$750 juta, dengan opsi greenshoe tambahan sebesar US$250 juta. Penandatanganan kesepakatan pembiayaan dilakukan di Jakarta, 23 April 2026.
id.body:
Jakarta, 23 April 2026 — Di tengah meningkatnya kebutuhan global terhadap mineral kritis untuk mendukung transisi energi, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) menegaskan langkah strategisnya dalam mengintegrasikan keberlanjutan ke dalam strategi pembiayaan melalui perolehan fasilitas Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL) senilai US$750 juta, dengan opsi greenshoe tambahan sebesar US$250 juta. Penandatanganan kesepakatan pembiayaan dilakukan di Jakarta, 23 April 2026.

Fasilitas pinjaman sindikasi ini merupakan yang pertama bagi PT Vale sekaligus menjadi tonggak penting dalam memperkuat ketahanan finansial perusahaan, mendukung pengembangan proyek strategis, serta memastikan praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab sejalan dengan tuntutan pasar global. Fasilitas ini didukung oleh sindikasi 14 bank internasional dan mengalami kelebihan permintaan (oversubscribed) hingga 1,7 kali, mencerminkan tingkat kepercayaan yang tinggi terhadap fundamental bisnis dan arah strategis keberlanjutan PT Vale.

Seiring dengan percepatan elektrifikasi dan pengembangan energi terbarukan secara global, permintaan terhadap nikel sebagai komponen utama baterai kendaraan listrik (EV) dan penyimpanan energi terus meningkat. Berdasarkan proyeksi International Energy Agency, kapasitas penyimpanan baterai global diperkirakan perlu meningkat hingga 14 kali lipat, sementara permintaan baterai EV diproyeksikan meningkat 7 kali lipat hingga tahun 2030.

Dalam konteks tersebut, PT Vale berada pada posisi strategis sebagai produsen nikel dengan intensitas karbon yang relatif lebih rendah, didukung oleh penggunaan energi terbarukan dari tiga pembangkit listrik tenaga air (PLTA) yang terintegrasi dalam operasionalnya. Perusahaan juga tengah meningkatkan kapasitas dan keandalan infrastruktur PLTA untuk mendukung proses elektrifikasi operasional secara bertahap.
 


 

Fasilitas SLL ini disusun mengacu pada Sustainability-Linked Financing Framework, yang selaras dengan praktik internasional dalam pembiayaan berbasis keberlanjutan. Indikator kinerja utama (Key Performance Indicators/KPI) yang digunakan mencakup penurunan intensitas emisi karbon dan peningkatan penggunaan energi terbarukan.

Kedua KPI tersebut telah mendapatkan penilaian “strong” dari Second Party Opinion independen, yang menilai keselarasan dengan target global untuk membatasi kenaikan suhu sesuai Paris Agreement 1.5°C pathway, sebagaimana dirujuk dalam kajian independen, serta kontribusinya terhadap target Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) Indonesia. Penilaian ini juga memastikan adanya peningkatan kinerja yang signifikan dibandingkan skenario business-as-usual.

Pinjaman sindikasi berbasis keberlanjutan ini merupakan tonggak penting bagi PT Vale, sekaligus menandai langkah perdana Perseroan dalam memasuki pasar pinjaman sindikasi. Langkah ini sejalan dengan trajektori pertumbuhan Perseroan yang semakin kuat, didorong oleh ekspansi proyek-proyek strategis di Indonesia yang dijalankan secara disiplin, terukur, dan berlandaskan prinsip keberlanjutan. Presiden Direktur dan CEO PT Vale, Bernardus Irmanto, menyampaikan bahwa fasilitas ini mencerminkan komitmen perusahaan dalam mengintegrasikan aspek keberlanjutan ke dalam pengambilan keputusan strategis. “Fasilitas ini menandai langkah penting dalam perjalanan kami untuk menyelaraskan strategi pembiayaan dengan agenda dekarbonisasi dan pertumbuhan jangka panjang perusahaan. Kami berkomitmen untuk terus menghadirkan nikel berkualitas tinggi dengan jejak karbon yang lebih rendah, sekaligus mendukung pengembangan industri hilirisasi nasional dan transisi energi global,” ujarnya.

Dari sisi pemanfaatan dana, fasilitas ini akan digunakan untuk mendukung pengembangan proyek strategis perusahaan. Pada tahun 2026, sekitar 50% dana akan dialokasikan untuk pengembangan proyek IGP Pomalaa, sekitar 30% untuk proyek IGP Morowali, dan sekitar 20% untuk pengembangan IGP Sorowako Limonite. Sementara pada tahun 2027, pendanaan akan difokuskan pada kelanjutan proyek-proyek tersebut serta pemenuhan hak partisipasi (participating right) dalam proyek joint venture.

Sebagai bagian dari komitmen terhadap penciptaan nilai bersama, PT Vale juga akan menyalurkan manfaat finansial yang diperoleh dari penyesuaian margin berbasis kinerja keberlanjutan ke dalam program pengembangan masyarakat. Pendekatan ini memastikan bahwa keberhasilan pencapaian target ESG tidak hanya berdampak pada operasional perusahaan, tetapi juga memberikan kontribusi nyata bagi peningkatan kesejahteraan masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasional.

Pendekatan ini turut didukung oleh para mitra perbankan yang melihat pentingnya integrasi keberlanjutan dalam struktur pembiayaan. Direktur Wholesale Banking UOB Indonesia, Harapman Kasan, menyampaikan bahwa pembiayaan berbasis keberlanjutan menjadi semakin relevan dalam mendukung transformasi sektor industri. “Transaksi ini mencerminkan pendekatan kami dalam mendukung nasabah melalui struktur pembiayaan yang selaras dengan target keberlanjutan yang terukur, sekaligus memperkuat peran Indonesia dalam agenda transisi energi global,” ujarnya.

Mike Zhang, Global Head Metals & Mining, Institutional Banking DBS, menambahkan bahwa sektor pertambangan memiliki peran penting dalam memastikan transisi energi berjalan secara bertanggung jawab dan berkelanjutan.

Sementara itu, Ken Matsuo, Presiden Direktur PT Bank Mizuho Indonesia, menyampaikan: “Energi merupakan tulang punggung perekonomian Indonesia, dan kami bangga dapat mendukung fasilitas pinjaman sindikasi perdana PT Vale. Di tengah volatilitas pasar, tingginya minat dari para bank peserta serta oversubscription menunjukkan kuatnya kepercayaan terhadap model bisnis PT Vale. Kami melihat integrasi ESG dalam struktur pembiayaan seperti ini sebagai langkah penting dalam mendukung transisi energi secara berkelanjutan.”

Melalui pencapaian ini, PT Vale semakin memperkuat posisinya sebagai pelaku industri pertambangan yang tidak hanya berfokus pada pertumbuhan bisnis, tetapi juga pada keberlanjutan lingkungan, tanggung jawab sosial, dan tata kelola yang baik (ESG), sejalan dengan visi untuk mendukung masa depan energi yang lebih bersih dan berkelanjutan.

en.title: Brumadinho Tourism Program wins international award at WTM Latin America
en.subtitle: Two Vale-backed initiatives win the 6th WTM Latin America Responsible Tourism Award, strengthening sustainable tourism and community leadership in Brumadinho, Minas Gerais
en.body:
Two initiatives from the program, supported by Vale, win the 6th WTM Latin America Responsible Tourism Award, consolidating the strategy of economic diversification and local leadership in the region.
                                                                                                                                                                    
Two strategic projects for promoting sustainable tourism in Brumadinho, developed within the city's Tourism Program — a Vale initiative in partnership with Rede Terra — have won the 6th WTM Latin America Responsible Tourism Award, one of the most prestigious recognitions in the sector. The projects were the only Brazilian entries selected in these categories for the final stage of the award.

Dina Braga, a leader from Quilombo de Rodrigues, dances at the center wearing colorful traditional attire during a cultural performance of the Brumadinho Quilombo Circuit. In the background, group members with instruments and visitors watch the celebration surrounded by vegetation.


The project "Brumadinho Sustainable Tourism Network – Innovation and Sustainability Journey" won the silver medal in the category "Best networking initiatives to promote responsible tourism in destinations." The "Quilombo Circuit," led by the Associação Céu de Montanhas, received the bronze medal in the category "Best initiatives for indigenous tourism and/or Traditional Communities".

"Brumadinho's recognition at an international award like WTM Latin America represents the municipality's visibility on the global stage, highlighting its tourism, cultural and sustainable potential. These initiatives strengthen the role of local communities by generating opportunities, valuing traditional knowledge and encouraging practices that respect the environment, contributing to fairer and more sustainable development," says Dina Braga, one of the leaders of Quilombo de Rodrigues.

Community foundation

The Sustainable Tourism Network already connects more than 45 local businesses through an innovative methodology — the "Teia do Turismo Sustentável" (Sustainable Tourism Web) — which translates ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) concepts into practical actions. The first phase of the project, involving 15 accommodation businesses, already shows results such as a projected reduction of 5.4 tonnes of CO2 emissions per year and the strengthening of female leadership, which runs 82% of the network's businesses.

The Quilombo Circuit is part of the Catálogo Céu de Montanhas, a collection of 38 tourist experiences in Brumadinho, and is one of the initiatives of the Brumadinho Tourism Program. The Circuit brings together the communities of Marinhos, Sapé and Ribeirão, promoting income generation and the appreciation of the Afro-Brazilian historical and cultural heritage of the region through experiential routes that connect visitors to ancestry, gastronomy and local knowledge.

"An award of this significance validates our vision that tourism can generate a concrete and sustainable legacy for Brumadinho, placing communities and local entrepreneurs as the leading players", says Daniele Teixeira, Sustainability Analyst at Vale.

The WTM Latin America award ceremony took place on Wednesday evening (15/04) in São Paulo.

Recognition
The Sustainable Tourism Web methodology has recently been shared at key industry events, including the State Meeting of Tourism Managers of Paraná, Festuris Gramado — at the invitation of the Brazilian Association of Tour Operators (Braztoa) — and the Sebrae-ES convention.

en.title: Reinforcing Green Commitment in Morowali Operations, PT Vale Marks Earth Day 2026 with Tree Planting and Energy Conservation Campaigns
en.subtitle: PT Vale reaffirmed its environmental commitment by conducting tree‑planting activities and coastal clean‑up actions at the Jetty Port Bahomotefe, Morowali to commemorate teh Earth Day 2026. The initiative involved employees and partner contractors, reflecting a spirit of collaboration in environmental stewardship while reinforcing a culture of sustainability across the Company’s operational areas.
en.body:
Morowali, 22 April 2026 — Amid growing global challenges related to climate change and environmental degradation, the observance of Earth Day serves as an important reminder that safeguarding the planet requires concrete action from all stakeholders, including the industrial sector.

In response, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale”), part of MIND ID, through its Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali, reaffirmed its environmental commitment by conducting tree‑planting activities and coastal clean‑up actions at the Jetty Port Bahomotefe, Morowali.
The initiative involved employees and partner contractors, reflecting a spirit of collaboration in environmental stewardship while reinforcing a culture of sustainability across the Company’s operational areas.

Protecting Coastal Ecosystems and Biodiversity
As part of the initiative, hundreds of trees were planted, including mangroves, kayu angin, tropical almond (ketapang), and coconut trees—species with high ecological value and well‑suited to coastal environments. Beyond strengthening coastlines and preventing abrasion, the planting programme supports biodiversity conservation and enhances environmental quality in the surrounding operational areas.

Mangroves, in particular, play a critical role as natural coastal barriers and as effective carbon sinks, contributing directly to climate change mitigation efforts.

The programme also included beach and port‑area clean‑up activities, during which waste with the potential to pollute marine ecosystems was collected and sorted as part of responsible environmental management practices.

Promoting Responsible Resource Use
Beyond on‑site environmental actions, PT Vale’s sustainability commitment is further demonstrated through internal water and energy conservation campaigns, consistently promoted among employees and contractors. These initiatives encourage simple yet impactful behavioural changes, such as:

  • responsible water use,
  • improved electricity efficiency in work areas, and
  • reducing unnecessary energy consumption in daily operational activities.

These efforts form part of the Company’s systematic approach to improving resource efficiency while reducing its environmental footprint.


 

Integrating Sustainability into Long‑Term Strategy
Wafir, Head of Bahodopi Operations at PT Vale, emphasized that these activities are embedded within the Company’s long‑term strategy to integrate sustainability principles across all business processes.

“Earth Day is a meaningful moment for us to reaffirm that environmental sustainability is not merely a commitment, but must be delivered through concrete and consistent action. Tree planting, coastal clean‑ups, and water and energy conservation campaigns reflect our efforts to balance operational activities with environmental protection,” he stated.

He further highlighted the strategic importance of active participation from employees and contractors in building collective awareness.

“Sustainability cannot be achieved in isolation. Through the active engagement of all stakeholders, we aim to ensure that environmental responsibility becomes an integral part of our everyday work culture,” he added.

Aligned with ESG Principles
These initiatives are aligned with the Company’s implementation of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles, which form a core foundation of PT Vale Indonesia’s corporate strategy. The Company continues to implement programmes aimed at minimizing environmental impacts, improving resource efficiency, and creating shared value for communities surrounding its operational areas.

The tree‑planting and coastal clean‑up activities at the IGP Morowali Jetty Port are expected to deliver long‑term benefits, including healthier coastal ecosystems and a cleaner, safer working environment. More broadly, the initiative serves as a reminder that protecting the planet begins with consistent, practical actions.

A Commitment Beyond Earth Day
Through the momentum of Earth Day 2026, PT Vale Indonesia reaffirms its commitment to continuously advancing sustainability programmes, strengthening collaboration with stakeholders, and delivering responsible mining practices that are aligned with nature and generate positive impact for future generations.

id.title: Perkuat Komitmen Hijau di Area Operasi Morowali, PT Vale Tanam Pohon dan Gaungkan Hemat Energi di Hari Bumi 2026
id.subtitle: PT Vale melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali mempertegas komitmennya dengan menggelar kegiatan penanaman pohon dan aksi bersih pantai di kawasan Jetty Port Bahomotefe, Morowali. Kegiatan ini melibatkan karyawan serta kontraktor mitra kerja, mencerminkan semangat kolaborasi dalam menjaga lingkungan sekaligus memperkuat budaya keberlanjutan di lingkungan operasional perusahaan.
id.body:
Morowali, 22 April 2026 — Di tengah meningkatnya tantangan perubahan iklim dan degradasi lingkungan, peringatan Hari Bumi Sedunia menjadi pengingat penting bahwa upaya menjaga kelestarian bumi membutuhkan aksi nyata dari seluruh pihak, termasuk sektor industri. Menjawab hal tersebut, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) bagian dari MIND ID melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali mempertegas komitmennya dengan menggelar kegiatan penanaman pohon dan aksi bersih pantai di kawasan Jetty Port Bahomotefe, Morowali.

Kegiatan ini melibatkan karyawan serta kontraktor mitra kerja, mencerminkan semangat kolaborasi dalam menjaga lingkungan sekaligus memperkuat budaya keberlanjutan di lingkungan operasional perusahaan.

Dalam aksi tersebut, ratusan pohon ditanam, terdiri dari jenis mangrove, kayu angin, ketapang, dan kelapa yang memiliki nilai ekologis tinggi dan sesuai dengan karakteristik wilayah pesisir. Penanaman ini tidak hanya bertujuan memperkuat garis pantai dan mencegah abrasi, tetapi juga mendukung keanekaragaman hayati serta meningkatkan kualitas lingkungan di sekitar area operasional. Mangrove secara khusus berperan sebagai pelindung alami pesisir sekaligus penyerap karbon yang efektif dalam mendukung mitigasi perubahan iklim.

Selain itu, kegiatan ini juga dirangkaikan dengan aksi pembersihan sampah di area pantai dan sekitar Jetty Port. Sampah yang berpotensi mencemari laut dikumpulkan dan dipilah sebagai bagian dari upaya pengelolaan lingkungan yang bertanggung jawab.

Lebih dari sekadar kegiatan lapangan, komitmen keberlanjutan PT Vale Indonesia juga diwujudkan melalui kampanye internal hemat air dan energi yang secara konsisten digalakkan kepada seluruh karyawan dan kontraktor. Melalui kampanye ini, perusahaan mendorong perubahan perilaku sederhana namun berdampak besar, seperti penggunaan air secara bijak, efisiensi listrik di area kerja, serta pengurangan pemborosan energi dalam aktivitas operasional sehari-hari. Inisiatif ini menjadi bagian dari upaya sistematis perusahaan dalam meningkatkan efisiensi sumber daya sekaligus menekan jejak lingkungan.


 

Head of Bahodopi Operation PT Vale, Wafir, menegaskan bahwa rangkaian kegiatan ini merupakan bagian dari strategi jangka panjang perusahaan dalam mengintegrasikan prinsip keberlanjutan ke dalam seluruh proses bisnis.

“Hari Bumi menjadi momentum penting bagi kami untuk menegaskan bahwa keberlanjutan lingkungan bukan sekadar komitmen, tetapi harus diwujudkan melalui aksi nyata dan konsisten. Penanaman pohon, aksi bersih pantai, hingga kampanye hemat air dan energi adalah bagian dari upaya kami dalam menyeimbangkan kegiatan operasional dengan perlindungan lingkungan,” ujarnya.

Lebih lanjut disampaikan bahwa keterlibatan aktif karyawan dan mitra kerja memiliki peran strategis dalam membangun kesadaran kolektif.

“Keberhasilan upaya keberlanjutan tidak dapat dicapai secara parsial. Melalui partisipasi aktif seluruh elemen, kami ingin memastikan bahwa nilai kepedulian terhadap lingkungan menjadi bagian dari budaya kerja sehari-hari,” tambahnya.

Inisiatif ini sejalan dengan penerapan prinsip Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) yang menjadi landasan utama strategi perusahaan. PT Vale Indonesia terus menjalankan berbagai program untuk meminimalkan dampak lingkungan, meningkatkan efisiensi sumber daya, serta menciptakan nilai tambah bagi masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasional.

Aksi penanaman pohon dan bersih pantai di area Jetty Port IGP Morowali diharapkan memberikan manfaat jangka panjang, mulai dari peningkatan kualitas ekosistem pesisir hingga terciptanya lingkungan kerja yang lebih bersih dan sehat. Lebih dari itu, kegiatan ini menjadi pengingat bahwa menjaga bumi dimulai dari langkah sederhana yang dilakukan secara konsisten.

Melalui momentum Hari Bumi Sedunia 2026, PT Vale Indonesia menegaskan komitmennya untuk terus mengembangkan program keberlanjutan secara berkelanjutan, memperkuat kolaborasi dengan para pemangku kepentingan, serta menghadirkan praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab, selaras dengan alam, dan memberikan dampak positif bagi generasi masa depan.

en.title: Programa Partilhar conecta fornecedores e instituições sociais em Brumadinho e região
en.subtitle: Iniciativa da Vale estimula investimentos sociais e fortalece o desenvolvimento sustentável em Brumadinho e na Bacia do Paraopeba
en.body:
A Vale está lançando, em Brumadinho, Curvelo, Florestal, Caetanópolis e São José da Varginha - munícipios da Bacia do Rio Paraopeba - o Programa Partilhar, que tem como foco o fortalecimento da contratação de mão de obra local, o fomento ao comércio regional e a ampliação dos investimentos sociais por meio da cadeia de fornecedores da empresa.  

Para marcar o lançamento do programa nesses territórios foi realizada, no início do mês, uma edição do Conexão Partilhar, iniciativa que tem como objetivo incentivar a aproximação entre empresas e projetos sociais.

Nesta primeira edição realizada em Brumadinho, participaram de cerca de 20 empresas que puderam conhecer projetos de 12 instituições já cadastradas na plataforma do programa – Praça Digital. Foram 105 participantes no encontro, o maior público já registrado pela iniciativa.  

“É com muito entusiasmo que iniciamos o Programa Partilhar em Brumadinho e na Bacia do Paraopeba. É um programa com grande potencial de compartilhamento de valor nos territórios de atuação da Vale, desenvolvido em parceria com seus fornecedores, fortalecendo relações, promovendo o desenvolvimento local e gerando impactos positivos e sustentáveis”, afirma Cristina Freire, Gestora de Territórios do Corredor Sul da Vale.  

Impacto positivo  

Criado em 2020 pela área de Suprimentos da Vale, o Programa Partilhar reúne mais de 500 fornecedores, e busca ampliar o impacto positivo da cadeia de suprimentos nos territórios onde a empresa atua.  

Em cinco anos, o programa proporcionou investimentos de R$ 110 milhões em 4.600 projetos sociais, que beneficiaram mais de 500 mil pessoas nas áreas de educação, cultura e esporte. Mais de 15 mil pessoas participaram de capacitações em cursos técnicos e profissionais.  

“O mercado reconhece o engajamento dos fornecedores em ações estruturantes, que contribuem para a construção de um legado sustentável”, destaca Marilza Cruz, líder técnica do Programa Partilhar.  

A expectativa é ampliar os investimentos sociais, fortalecer o papel dos fornecedores como agentes de transformação e impulsionar o desenvolvimento sustentável, com uma nova edição do Conexão Partilhar prevista para os próximos meses.

en.title: VALE DEEPENS MALAYSIA PRESENCE WITH THE APPOINTMENT OF FIRST LOCAL CEO
en.subtitle: Vale has appointed Edwin Gerard as the Chief Executive Officer of its Malaysian subsidiary
en.body:
Vale, a global leader in mining, has appointed Edwin Gerard as the Chief Executive Officer of its Malaysian subsidiary, Vale Malaysia Minerals Sdn. Bhd. (“Vale in Malaysia”). Edwin brings more than 25 years of international experience in large-scale port operations, logistics and infrastructure management, having held senior leadership roles across Oman, Nigeria, Egypt, Turkey and Malaysia. His most recent posting was as the Chief Operating Officer of Johor Port Berhad. 

As the first Malaysian appointed to this role, Edwin’s appointment reflects Vale’s continued commitment to developing and empowering the local talent ecosystem in countries where it operates. Vale’s Malaysia operations are supported by a workforce of over 95% Malaysian, spanning the Teluk Rubiah Maritime Terminal in Perak, which represents the largest single foreign direct investment in the state, and its Asia Pacific corporate office in Kuala Lumpur. 

Edwin will oversee one of Vale’s most strategic hubs in Asia, which distributes around 20 million tonnes of iron ore annually, while advancing the company’s focus on safe, reliable and sustainable operations. 

“Malaysia continues to play an important role in Vale’s Asia Pacific operations and we remain firmly committed to strengthening our long-term presence and contribution in the country. In this role, I aim to continue building on the strong foundation established over the years by deepening partnerships with local stakeholders, enhancing collaboration across the ecosystem and ensuring the consistent delivery of safe, reliable and sustainable operations that create lasting value.” 

He succeeds Leonardo Paiva, who played a key role in strengthening Vale’s commitment to a sustainable presence in Malaysia. During his leadership, Vale embarked on a range of community-centred social investment partnerships with Perak’s institutions, such as urban rejuvenation projects in Manjung, which supported the revitalisation of Beruas and Manjung Lama, as well as the establishment of the Teluk Rubiah Scholarship Programme to develop high-potential local talent. 

Since the commencement of its operations in Teluk Rubiah in 2014, Vale has invested around MYR80 million on social investments in areas such as education, women empowerment and environmental conservation. “We will continue to build upon the solid relationships that we have built thus far with local stakeholders to deliver sustainable value for our business, people and the society, especially in Perak, where we have a highly strategic operational presence,” Edwin concluded.
