en.title: Consistently Advancing Workplace HIV/AIDS Prevention, PT Vale Earns Provincial OHS Award in South Sulawesi
en.subtitle: On February 18, 2026, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) reaffirmed its strong commitment to occupational health and safety (OHS) by receiving the Provincial OHS Award for Workplace HIV/AIDS Prevention and Management in South Sulawesi.
en.body:
On February 18, 2026, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) reaffirmed its strong commitment to occupational health and safety (OHS) by receiving the Provincial OHS Award for Workplace HIV/AIDS Prevention and Management in South Sulawesi. The award was presented at the South Sulawesi Governor’s Office in Makassar by Andi Darmawan Bintang, Assistant II for Economics and Development, and received on behalf of PT Vale by Busman Dahlan Shirat, Manager of External Relations Regional & SDP Growth.

The recognition was part of the 2026 National OHS Month commemoration at the provincial level, emphasizing cross-sector collaboration to strengthen workplace safety culture. PT Vale has been actively engaged in various safety campaigns, including the “Anti Mager” (Anti-Sedentary Movement) initiative held in February 2026 to promote a healthier and more safety-conscious community.

Previously, on August 23, 2024, PT Vale received the Gold Award for HIV/AIDS Prevention and Management (P2HIV/AIDS) from the Indonesian Ministry of Manpower for its Sorowako Block and Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) in Pomalaa.


 

According to Dr. Christina Norma Susilowati, Medical Advisor and Chair of PT Vale’s HIV Working Group, the P2HIV program is an integral part of the company’s Occupational Health framework. “We strengthen this program through education, screening, and improved access to occupational health services. These efforts align with the provincial government’s concerns regarding the rising trend of HIV/AIDS cases in South Sulawesi,” Dr. Christina explained.

As of September 2025, East Luwu Regency—one of PTVI’s operational areas—reported 196 HIV/AIDS cases, up from 171 in 2024. At the provincial level, South Sulawesi recorded 1,214 cases between January and August 2025, predominantly among males from various risk groups, including MSM, pregnant women, TB patients, and the general population.

In support of Indonesia’s “AIDS-Free 2030” vision, local authorities have introduced the Three Zeros commitment: Zero new infections, Zero AIDS-related deaths, and Zero stigma and discrimination for people living with HIV/AIDS.

PT Vale’s latest award reflects more than regulatory compliance—it underscores the company’s responsibility to ensure a safe and protected work environment, including safeguarding workers from communicable diseases such as HIV/AIDS. This commitment is expected to further strengthen a professional, holistic, and sustainable OHS culture across South Sulawesi.

id.title: Konsisten Promosikan P2HIV/AIDS di Tempat Kerja, PT Vale Raih Penghargaan K3 Tingkat Provinsi Sulsel
id.subtitle: Pada 18 Februari 2026, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) kembali meneguhkan komitmennya dalam penguatan keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja (K3) dengan menerima Penghargaan K3 kategori Pencegahan dan Penanggulangan HIV/AIDS di Tempat Kerja Tingkat Provinsi Sulawesi Selatan.
id.body:
Pada 18 Februari 2026, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) kembali meneguhkan komitmennya dalam penguatan keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja (K3) dengan menerima Penghargaan K3 kategori Pencegahan dan Penanggulangan HIV/AIDS di Tempat Kerja Tingkat Provinsi Sulawesi Selatan.

Penghargaan diserahkan di Kantor Gubernur Sulawesi Selatan, Makassar, oleh Asisten II Bidang Perekonomian dan Pembangunan Sulsel, Andi Darmawan Bintang kepada Busman Dahlan Shirat, Manager Eksternal Relations Regional & SDP Growth PT Vale.

Penghargaan ini diberikan dalam rangka Peringatan Bulan K3 Nasional Tahun 2026 Tingkat Provinsi Sulawesi Selatan, yang tahun ini kembali menonjolkan komitmen lintas sektor untuk memperkuat budaya keselamatan kerja. PT Vale sendiri telah aktif terlibat dalam berbagai kampanye keselamatan, termasuk kegiatan “Anti Mager” yang digelar pada Februari 2026 sebagai upaya penguatan budaya safety masyarakat luas.

Tahun-tahun sebelumnya, pada 23 Agustus 2024, PT Vale menerima Penghargaan P2HIV/AIDS Kategori Gold dari Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan Republik Indonesia untuk Blok Sorowako dan Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa.
 


 

Menurut dr. Christina Norma Susilowati, Medical Advisor sekaligus Ketua Pokja HIV PT Vale, program P2HIV (Pencegahan & Penanggulangan HIV/AIDS) merupakan bagian integral dari program Occupational Health PT Vale. "Kami meperkuat program ini melalui edukasi, skrining, serta peningkatan layanan kesehatan kerja. Upaya ini selaras dengan perhatian pemerintah provinsi terkait tren peningkatan kasus HIV/AIDS di Sulawesi Selatan," kata dr. Christina.

Menyitir data hingga September 2025, diketahui bahwa kasus HIV/AIDS di Kabupaten Luwu Timur, salah satu wilayah operasional PT Vale, mencapai 196 kasus HIV/AIDS, naik dari 171 kasus pada tahun 2024. Sedang pada tingkat provinsi, Sulawesi Selatan mencatat 1.214 kasus HIV/AIDS sepanjang Januari–Agustus 2025. Kasus ini didominasi laki-laki dari berbagai kelompok risiko, termasuk LSL, ibu hamil, pasien TB, dan populasi umum.

Menuju Indonesia Bebas AIDS 2030, salah satu langkah yang diambil pemerintah daerah  adalah pencanangan tiga zero untuk Orang dengan HIV/AIDS (ODHA), yakni: Zero infeksi baru, Zero kematian terkait AIDS, serta Zero stigma dan diskriminasi.

Penghargaan yang diterima PT Vale tidak hanya mencerminkan kepatuhan terhadap regulasi, tetapi juga menunjukkan tanggung jawab perusahaan untuk memastikan setiap pekerja dapat bekerja dengan aman dan terlindungi, termasuk dari risiko penyakit menular seperti HIV/AIDS. Komitmen ini diharapkan terus memperkuat budaya keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja yang profesional, holistik, dan berkelanjutan di wilayah Sulawesi Selatan.

en.title: BK3NP 2026 Sorowako Officially Concludes: PTVI Reaffirms Commitment to Safety, Health, and the Environment
en.subtitle: Safety is more than a set of workplace rules—it is every individual’s hope to return home safely. This message was emphasized by Abu Ashar, Chief Operations & Infrastructure Officer of PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), during his remarks at the closing ceremony of the 2026 National Mining Occupational Safety and Health Month (BK3NP) held at Iniaku Field, Sorowako, East Luwu, on Saturday, February 14, 2026.
en.body:
Safety is more than a set of workplace rules—it is every individual’s hope to return home safely. This message was emphasized by Abu Ashar, Chief Operations & Infrastructure Officer of PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), during his remarks at the closing ceremony of the 2026 National Mining Occupational Safety and Health Month (BK3NP) held at Iniaku Field, Sorowako, East Luwu, on Saturday, February 14, 2026.

“Arrive healthy, work with enthusiasm, and return home safely,” Abu stated.

He underscored that BK3NP is not merely an annual observance but a reminder for everyone to protect themselves, others, and the environment. A similar sentiment was conveyed by Febrin Sitorus, Head of HSOR Environment & Sustainability Operations, who highlighted the importance of multi-stakeholder collaboration in building a strong safety culture.

“This year’s BK3NP was not only organized by PTVI but also involved the wider East Luwu community, including business partners and the Vale Indonesia Family Association,” Febrin added.

The theme, “Building a Professional, Reliable, and Collaborative National OHS Management Ecosystem,” reflects this collaborative spirit.

From January 12 to February 14, 2026, the program featured a series of activities. Unlike previous years that emphasized sports competitions, this year’s events focused on safety, health, and environmental education in schools; volleyball matches; a safety dojo challenge; open-water activities; leadership reflection; thematic inspections; a fun walk; and nutrition and mental health campaigns.


 

K3L Education in Schools
This year’s Safety, Occupational Health, and Environment (K3L) education targeted students across PTVI’s community development areas, including schools in Wasuponda, Towuti, Sorowako, and Malili. Topics covered included safe driving, environmental protection, substance abuse prevention and anti-bullying, vocational education pathways, and even introductory aviation science.

Sports and Safety Competitions
A lively volleyball tournament was part of the celebration, along with the Safety Dojo Challenge, an interactive simulation facility designed to mimic workplace scenarios, hazard controls, and emergency response. Participants completed simulations such as conveyor belt repairs, electrical panel maintenance, scaffolding material handling, and lamp replacement. Teams were assessed on knowledge, skills, behavior, teamwork, and the effectiveness of their safety messaging.

Open Water Exhibition
Forty‑eight participants—including employees, contractors, and family members—joined an open‑water swimming exhibition across Lake Matano (Nuha–Sorowako), symbolizing unity and the promotion of physical wellness. The event received support from local government, law enforcement, and the Natural Resources Conservation Agency.

“Let’s keep Sorowako clean and healthy—as a mining town and a tourism destination—because Sorowako is all of us,” said Hendry U. Iskandar Ekazandri, Manager Risk & Prevention.

Leadership Reflection and Thematic Inspection
Leaders conducted reflections on incidents from the past three months to extract lessons learned. Thematic inspections focused on the company’s high‑risk activities and involved both PTVI leaders and contractors throughout the OHS Month.

Health Campaigns
Mental health and nutrition were also spotlighted. Psychologist Rahmat Permadi, M.Psi. emphasized, “Mental health cannot be separated from physical well‑being. When one aspect suffers, all are affected.” Nutrition expert Indra Jaya SST AIFO provided practical guidance on balanced diets and healthy eating patterns.

Linked with National Waste Awareness Day
The BK3NP closing ceremony coincided with National Waste Awareness Day (HPSN) on February 21, reinforcing that environmental cleanliness is essential to OHS. Participants joined a Fun Walk while collecting and sorting waste across four areas: VDM, Old Sorowako, Sorowako Airport, and Krakatau Road. Within an hour, they collected two tons of waste.

“This volume is a reminder of the importance of environmental awareness as a foundation of safety and health,” said Febrin.
Participants expressed enthusiasm. Wahyuni Pratiwi from PTVI’s Human Capital Department noted that this year’s event was especially meaningful: “Thank you for teaching the community proper waste sorting for a better future.”

Collected waste was weighed and assessed, and recognition was given to participants for their environmental contributions.
While BK3NP lasted only a month, the message continues.

“We hope today’s activities become part of everyday life, supporting environmental sustainability. This reflects PTVI’s CARES values, especially Compassion and Sustainability,” Abu concluded.

id.title: BK3NP 2026 Sorowako Resmi Ditutup: PTVI Tegaskan Komitmen terhadap Keselamatan, Kesehatan, dan Lingkungan
id.subtitle: Keselamatan bukan hanya tentang aturan di tempat kerja, tetapi juga harapan setiap orang untuk pulang dengan selamat. Pesan inilah yang kembali ditekankan oleh Chief Operations & Infrastructure Officer PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PTVI), Abu Ashar saat memberikan sambutan setelah Upacara Penutupan Bulan Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja Nasional Pertambangan (BK3NP) 2026 di Lapangan Iniaku, Sorowako, Luwu Timur (Lutim), Sabtu (14/2/2026).
id.body:
Keselamatan bukan hanya tentang aturan di tempat kerja, tetapi juga harapan setiap orang untuk pulang dengan selamat. Pesan inilah yang kembali ditekankan oleh Chief Operations & Infrastructure Officer PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PTVI), Abu Ashar saat memberikan sambutan setelah Upacara Penutupan Bulan Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja Nasional Pertambangan (BK3NP) 2026 di Lapangan Iniaku, Sorowako, Luwu Timur (Lutim), Sabtu (14/2/2026).

“Datang sehat, kerja semangat dan pulang selamat,” jelas Abu.

Ia menegaskan bahwa pelaksanaan BK3NP bukan sebatas perayaan tahunan, melainkan inspirasi bagi seluruh individu untuk menjaga keselamatan diri, orang lain dan lingkungan. Hal senada disampaikan Head of HSOR Environment & Sutainability Operations, Febrin Sitorus, yang menekankan pentingnya kolaborasi lintas pihak dalam mewujudkan budaya K3.

“BK3NP tahun ini, tidak hanya diselenggarakan oleh PTVI, tapi juga melibatkan seluruh unsur di Lutim, mitra Perusahaan dan Ibu-ibu Ikatan Keluarga Vale Indonesia,” lanjut Febrin.

Tema BK3NP “Membangun Ekosistem Pengelolaan K3 Nasional yang Profesional, Andal, dan Kolaboratif”, menggambarkan fokus kolaboratif tersebut.

Selama sebulan, sejak 12 Januari 2026 hingga 14 Februari 2026, serangkaian kegiatan digelar. Berbeda dari tahun sebelumnya yang banyak diisi perlombaan olahraga, tahun ini kegiatan berfokus pada edukasi K3L di sekolah, pertandingan bola voli, safety dojo challenge, open water exhibition, leadership reflection, thematic inspection, fun walk, serta kampanye kesehatan mengenai gizi dan kesehatan mental.
 


 

Edukasi K3L

Bukan pertama kalinya, edukasi tentang Keselamatan, Kesehatan Kerja dan Lingkungan (K3L) kerap dilakukan oleh Perusahaan. Edukasi K3L tahun ini, menyasar para siswa di area pemberdayaan PTVI, di antaranya SMAN 5 Luwu Timur di Wasuponda, SMA Yapman & SMK Budi Utomo, SMAN 13 Luwu Timur di Mahalona Kecamatan Towuti, SMA YPS Sorowako, dan SMAN 12 Luwu Timur di Kecamatan Malili. Perusahaan memberikan pemahaman kepada para siswa tentang safe driving, lingkungan hidup, napza & bullying, UT school, hingga ilmu tentang aviation (penerbangan).  

Safety Dojo Challenge

Dojo Merupakan Fasilitas interaktif untuk mensimulasikan pekerjaan, kontrol bahaya dan risiko di tempat kerja serta Evakuasi Keadaan Darurat. Dalam tahun ini, safety dojo challenge kembali digelar dengan tetap pada tujuannya yaitu simulasi untuk menghadapi keadaan darurat, memahami  penempatan dan makna rambu-rambu keselamatan, dan mengasah kemampuan identifikasi risiko dan respon cepat.

Para peserta harus melakukan simulasi dari beberapa skenario, yaitu perbaikan conveyer belt, perbaikan panel listrik, pemindahan material scaffolding, dan penggantian lampu.

Open Water Exhibition

Sebanyak 48 peserta dari karyawan, kontraktor, dan keluarga karyawan, berpartisipasi dalam open water exhibition. Mereka berenang sepanjang Danau Matano (Nuha – Sorowako), menandakan semangat kebersamaan untuk berolahraga demi mewujudkan tubuh yang sehat dan bugar.

Kegiatan ini berjalan lancar berkat dukungan dari berbagai pihak, termasuk pemerintah dan kepolisian Lutim, serta Balai Konservasi Sumber Daya Alam.

“Mari kita menjaga dan melestarikan Sorowako sebagai kota tambang dan wisata yang sehat dan bersih, karena Sorowako adalah kita,” jelas Manager Risk & Prevention, Hendry Iskandar Ekazandri.

Leadership Reflection dan Thematic Inspection

Leadership reflection dan thematic inspection sebagai bagian penguatan budaya keselamatan kerja. Leadership reflection merupakan refleksi para leader L1 terkait kecelakaan yang terjadi dalam tiga bulan terakhir sebagai evaluasi dan pembelajaran bersama, sementara thematic inspection adalah kegiatan inspeksi terhadap aktivitas kritikal, aktivitas yang memiliki risiko tinggi di PTVI yang dilaksanakan oleh leader PTVI bersama kontraktor selama periode Bulan K3.

Health Campaign

Kampanye kesehatan mengenai gizi dan kesehatan mental juga tidak kalah penting dalam mendukung keselamatan kerja. Hal ini disampaikan oleh salah satu pemateri Health Campaign bertajuk Pikiran Aman, Badan Sehat, Kerja Selamat, Rahmat Permadi MPsi seorang Psikolog. Ia menyatakan: “Kesehatan mental tidak terlepas dari kesehatan tubuh. Jika salah satu dari tiga aspek terganggu, maka seluruhnya akan ikut terpengaruh.” Selain membahas kesehatan mental, seorang ahli gizi Indra Jaya SST AIFO juga turut mengedukasi para peserta tentang cara menerapkan gizi seimbang dan pola makan sehat.  

Rangkaian kegiatan BK3NP berlangsung sukses dan mendapat apresiasi dari Bupati Luwu Timur, Irwan Bachri Syam, yang dalam kesempatan tersebut diwakili Asisten Pemerintahan dan Kesejahteraan Rakyat, Aini Endis Anrika S STP MM. Ia mengajak seluruh elemen masyarakat untuk terus mendukung arah kebijakan K3 sebagai upaya melindungi pekerja, serta membuka jalan bagi daerah menjadi maju, sejahtera dan berdaya saing

“BK3NP menjadi momentum memperkuat komitmen bersama. Bukan hanya kewajiban formal yang harus dilakukan, K3 adalah pilar utama dalam menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang produktif, meningkatkan kualitas hidup, dan memperkuat daya saing,” kata Irwan Bachri yang dibacakan oleh Asisten Pemerintahan dan Kesejahteraan Rakyat.  

Dirangkaian dengan HPSN: Dua Ton Sampah Terkumpul dari Fun Walk

Penutupan BK3NP dirangkaikan pula dengan peringatan Hari Peduli Sampah Nasional (HPSN) yang jatuh setiap 21 Februari. Peringatan ini menjadi pengingat bahwa pengelolaan sampah dan kebersihan lingkungan tidak terpisahkan dari aspek K3.

“Kita tidak hanya fokus pada penutupan BK3NP, tetapi juga  HPSN. Keselamatan dan kesehatan itu sangat penting, tetapi menjaga lingkungan juga hal yang harus kita lakukan dengan melibatkan semua orang untuk membersihkan areanya.” Jelas Febrin.

Usai upacara penutupan, peserta mengikuti Fun Walk sambil memungut dan memilah sampah di empat area: VDM, Sorowako Lama, Bandara Sorowako, dan Jalan Krakatau. Dalam waktu satu jam, terkumpul sekitar dua ton sampah.  

“Jumlah sampah ini menjadi pengingat pentingnya meningkatkan kepedulian masyarakat tentang lingkungan yang bersih akan menunjang keselamatan dan kesehatan,” ujar Febrin.

Antusiasme peserta terlihat sepanjang kegiatan. Karyawan Departemen Human Capital PTVI, Wahyuni Pratiwi menuturkan, kegiatan tahun ini berbeda dari sebelumnya, dan ia sangat menikmatinya. “Terima kasih karena sudah mengajarkan masyarakat untuk memilah sampah dengan baik untuk masa depan kita yang lebih baik,” tambah Wahyuni.

Setelah Fun Walk, sampah yang dikumpulkan akan ditimbang dan dinilai. Apresiasi diberikan kepada para peserta atas partisipasinya dalam mendukung aksi peduli lingkungan ini. Adapun daftar pemenang Fun Walk peringatan HPSN adalah sebagai berikut :

Meski hanya berlangsung sebulan, BK3NP yang dirangkaian dengan HPSN ini tentu bukanlah akhir dari upaya keselamatan dan peduli lingkungan.  

“Harapannya, kegiatan hari ini dapat terus dilakukan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari demi keberlanjutan lingkungan kita bersama. Komitmen ini sesuai dengan nilai CARES PTVI, terutama di poin Compassion dan Sustainability,” tutup Abu.

en.title: PT Vale Strengthens Community Education on Dengue Fever and Tuberculosis Prevention in Puulemo Village
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), through the Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, is intensifying its community outreach and environmental programs within its concession area. Most recently, the company organized a public health initiative focused on educating residents about the prevention of Dengue Fever (known locally as DBD) and Tuberculosis (TB).
en.body:
Kolaka, February 15, 2026 — PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), through the Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, is intensifying its community outreach and environmental programs within its concession area. Most recently, the company organized a public health initiative focused on educating residents about the prevention of Dengue Fever (known locally as DBD) and Tuberculosis (TB).

The event took place at the Puulemo Village Hall in Baula Subdistrict, Kolaka Regency, on Saturday, February 14, 2026.

Residents gathered enthusiastically for the session. Beyond receiving information on the dangers and prevention of Dengue and TB, community members also took advantage of free health checkups provided by PT Vale IGP Pomalaa. Long queues formed as villagers waited to have their health conditions assessed.

Baula Subdistrict Head, Syahrial Darmawan, who officially opened the event, expressed appreciation for PT Vale’s consistent support of local health programs. He noted that initiatives like this play an important role in raising awareness about environmental cleanliness—an essential factor in preventing vector-borne diseases such as Dengue.

“PT Vale has conducted similar activities in several villages in Baula. These efforts greatly support our health sector. During the rainy season, the risk of Dengue increases significantly. With ongoing education, the community becomes more motivated to keep their environment clean and avoid disease,” he said.

Mokhammad Syifak, Health Educator for PT Vale IGP Pomalaa, explained that the company’s health promotion efforts are part of an ongoing program conducted across its community development areas. In Puulemo Village, the focus was specifically on Dengue and TB prevention.

 
 

Several Dengue cases have been identified in Puulemo, while TB cases across Kolaka Regency have shown an upward trend, making targeted education essential.

“Through this activity, we hope residents better understand how to prevent and limit Dengue transmission. Likewise for TB—people need to be aware of how it spreads and how to protect themselves. We believe disease control efforts should begin at the village level,” Syifak noted.

Puulemo Village Head, Nursiah, welcomed the initiative, stressing that Dengue and TB are often underestimated despite their serious health risks.

“This education is extremely valuable for our community. Even though some residents are familiar with prevention methods, repeated information helps strengthen awareness. I hope everyone applies today’s lessons at home,” she stated.

Local resident Eli Narsa expressed appreciation for the program, emphasizing the importance of continually updating health knowledge.

“Even though I already practice Dengue prevention at home, I still came. For me, new information always means new insight,” she said.

The event reflects PT Vale IGP Pomalaa’s commitment to improving the quality of life in its surrounding communities. Beyond its industrial operations, the company aims to foster collective awareness about public health as a cornerstone of sustainable local development.

Through continued collaboration between local government, the company, and community members, it is hoped that both Dengue and TB cases in Puulemo Village and throughout Kolaka Regency can be significantly reduced.

id.title: PT Vale Gencarkan Edukasi Pencegahan DBD dan TBC di Desa Puulemo
id.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa semakin gencar melakukan kegiatan bakti sosial dan lingkungan di wilayah konsesinya. Kali ini, PT Vale menggelar program promosi kesehatan melalui edukasi pencegahan Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) dan Tuberkulosis (TBC).
id.body:
Kolaka, 15 Februari 2026-PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa semakin gencar melakukan kegiatan bakti sosial dan lingkungan di wilayah konsesinya. Kali ini, PT Vale menggelar program promosi kesehatan melalui edukasi pencegahan Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) dan Tuberkulosis (TBC).

Kegiatan tersebut dilaksanakan di Balai Desa Puulemo, Kecamatan Baula, Kabupaten Kolaka, Sabtu (14/2/2026).

Warga Desa Puulemo tampak antusias memadati aula desa. Tidak hanya mendapatkan edukasi tentang bahaya dan pencegahan DBD serta TBC, masyarakat juga memanfaatkan layanan pemeriksaan kesehatan gratis yang disediakan PT Vale IGP Pomalaa. Warga terlihat tertib mengantre untuk memeriksa kondisi kesehatannya.

Camat Baula, Syahrial Darmawan, yang membuka kegiatan tersebut, menyampaikan apresiasi atas konsistensi PT Vale dalam mendukung program kesehatan di wilayahnya. Menurutnya, kegiatan seperti ini sangat membantu pemerintah kecamatan, khususnya dalam meningkatkan kesadaran masyarakat terhadap pentingnya menjaga kebersihan lingkungan.

“Kegiatan seperti ini sudah dilaksanakan PT Vale di sejumlah desa di Kecamatan Baula. Ini sangat membantu kami di sektor kesehatan. Apalagi di musim hujan seperti saat ini, risiko DBD meningkat. Melalui edukasi ini, masyarakat semakin termotivasi menjaga kebersihan agar terhindar dari penyakit,” ujarnya.

Health Educator PT Vale IGP Pomalaa, Mokhammad Syifak, menjelaskan bahwa promosi kesehatan (Promkes) merupakan agenda rutin yang dilaksanakan secara berkelanjutan di desa-desa wilayah pemberdayaan perusahaan. Khusus di Desa Puulemo, fokus utama kegiatan adalah pencegahan DBD dan TBC.
 

 
 

Pasalnya, beberapa kasus DBD telah ditemukan di desa tersebut, sementara angka TBC di Kabupaten Kolaka secara umum juga menunjukkan tren peningkatan.

“Harapan kami, melalui kegiatan ini masyarakat memahami cara mencegah dan menekan penyebaran DBD. Begitu juga dengan TBC, masyarakat perlu tahu bagaimana penularannya dan bagaimana cara mencegahnya. Kami ingin upaya pengendalian ini dimulai dari desa,” jelasnya.

Kepala Desa Puulemo, Nursiah, menyambut antusias program edukasi DBD dan TBC yang dilaksanakan PT Vale di desanya. Ia berharap masyarakat dapat memahami secara menyeluruh cara pencegahan kedua penyakit tersebut yang kerap dianggap sepele, padahal berbahaya.

“Edukasi ini sangat bermanfaat bagi warga Puulemo. Meskipun sebagian warga sudah mengetahui cara penanganan dan pencegahan penyakit ini, pengetahuan yang diberikan secara berulang akan membuat masyarakat lebih waspada. Saya berharap warga menyimak dan mempraktikkan edukasi yang diterima hari ini di rumah masing-masing,” katanya.

Salah seorang warga Desa Puulemo, Eli Narsa, mengaku senang dapat mengikuti kegiatan tersebut. Menurutnya, edukasi kesehatan merupakan pengetahuan penting yang perlu dipahami dan dipraktikkan meskipun sudah sering didengar.

“Meskipun saya sudah mempraktikkan cara pencegahan DBD di rumah, saya tetap datang dan antusias mengikuti kegiatan yang digelar PT Vale. Bagi saya, setiap materi baru berarti pengetahuan baru,” jelasnya.

Kegiatan ini menjadi bukti nyata peran aktif PT Vale IGP Pomalaa dalam mendukung peningkatan kualitas hidup masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasional perusahaan. Tidak hanya berfokus pada sektor industri, perusahaan juga berkomitmen membangun kesadaran kolektif akan pentingnya kesehatan sebagai fondasi utama pembangunan desa.

Melalui kolaborasi antara pemerintah kecamatan, perusahaan, dan masyarakat, diharapkan angka DBD dan TBC di Desa Puulemo maupun wilayah Kabupaten Kolaka dapat ditekan secara signifikan.

en.title: Strengthening Waste Banks, PT Vale Reinforces Its Commitment to the Cipinang River Care Program
en.subtitle: Waste banks play a crucial role in the ecosystem of sustainable waste management. In line with this, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), a member of the MIND ID mining industry holding, has reaffirmed its commitment to supporting the enhancement of three waste banks operating in Kramat Jati, East Jakarta. This initiative forms part of the company’s contribution to the Cipinang River Care Program, launched by Indonesia’s Ministry of Environment and Forestry/Environmental Control Agency.
en.body:
Waste banks play a crucial role in the ecosystem of sustainable waste management. In line with this, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), a member of the MIND ID mining industry holding, has reaffirmed its commitment to supporting the enhancement of three waste banks operating in Kramat Jati, East Jakarta. This initiative forms part of the company’s contribution to the Cipinang River Care Program, launched by Indonesia’s Ministry of Environment and Forestry/Environmental Control Agency.

The handover of support was carried out during an event held at the Kramat Jati Community Hall on Saturday, February 14, 2026.

PT Vale’s direct involvement in strengthening waste bank operations serves as an important driver in ensuring optimal waste management—starting from the household level, through neighborhood units (RT), and up to community-level administrations (RW). By improving waste handling at its source, the initiative aims to reduce the amount of waste entering the Cipinang River, thereby helping preserve water quality and maintain the cleanliness of the surrounding environment.

Waste banks play an increasingly strategic role in promoting structured waste sorting, collection, and recycling. Beyond environmental benefits, the system also offers economic value to residents through the monetization of recyclable materials.

 
 

PT Vale as Coordinator for Segment 3

Within the Cipinang River Care Program framework, PT Vale has been designated as the coordinator for Segment 3, covering the Halim Perdana Kusuma, Makassar, Kebon Pala, Kramat Jati, and Kampung Dukuh areas in East Jakarta. In this role, PT Vale actively collaborates with the Ministry of Environment and Forestry, local government agencies, and community members to ensure that program implementation remains consistent, impactful, and sustainable.

According to Asriani Amiruddin, Regulatory Affairs Specialist and Coordinator for Segment 3, the strengthening of waste banks is a key component in the effort to safeguard river cleanliness.

“Protecting our rivers must begin with effective waste management at the community level. By empowering waste banks, we want to encourage behavioral change while building a system capable of preventing waste from entering the river,” Asriani explained.

This initiative also reflects PT Vale’s broader commitment to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles—particularly in advancing circular economy practices, pollution control, and sustainable development across Indonesia.

id.title: Perkuat Bank Sampah, PT Vale Tegaskan Komitmen Dalam Program Peduli Kali Cipinang
id.subtitle: Bank sampah berperan penting dalam rantai pengelolaan lingkungan secara berkelanjutan. Sejalan dengan itu, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari MIND ID, menunjukkan komitmennya untuk mendukung penguatan operasional tiga bank sampah di Kelurahan Kramat Jati, Jakarta. Upaya ini adalah wujud dukungan perusahaan terhadap Program Peduli Kali Cipinang yang diinisiasi oleh Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup/Badan Pengendalian Lingkungan Hidup.
id.body:
Bank sampah berperan penting dalam rantai pengelolaan lingkungan secara berkelanjutan. Sejalan dengan itu, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari MIND ID, menunjukkan komitmennya untuk mendukung penguatan operasional tiga bank sampah di Kelurahan Kramat Jati, Jakarta. Upaya ini adalah wujud dukungan perusahaan terhadap Program Peduli Kali Cipinang yang diinisiasi oleh Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup/Badan Pengendalian Lingkungan Hidup.

Penyerahan dukungan dilakukan pada kegiatan yang berlangsung di Balai Gede Kelurahan Kramat Jati pada Sabtu, 14 Februari 2026.

Keterlibatan konkret PT Vale dalam program penguatan bank sampah tersebut mendukung upaya kolektif daam memastikan pengelolaan sampah berlangsung optimal sejak dari tingkat rumah tangga, RT, hingga RW. Pengelolaan dari sumber diharapkan mampu mengurangi potensi sampah masuk ke aliran Sungai Cipinang, sehingga kualitas lingkungan dan kebersihan sungai dapat terus terjaga.

Bank sampah memiliki peran penting dalam mendorong pemilahan, pengumpulan, serta pengelolaan sampah secara lebih terstruktur. Selain mendukung aspek lingkungan, sistem ini juga memberikan nilai ekonomi bagi masyarakat melalui pemanfaatan sampah yang dapat didaur ulang.
 

 
 

PT Vale sebagai Koordinator Segmen 3

Dalam Program Peduli Kali Cipinang, PT Vale ditunjuk sebagai koordinator Segmen 3, yang mencakup wilayah Halim Perdana Kusuma, Makassar, Kebon Pala, Kramat Jati, dan Kampung Dukuh di Jakarta Timur. Sebagai koordinator, PT Vale berperan aktif membangun kolaborasi bersama Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup, pemerintah daerah, serta masyarakat setempat untuk memastikan implementasi program berjalan konsisten dan berkelanjutan.

Asriani Amiruddin, Regulatory Affairs Specialist selaku Koordinator Segmen 3, menyampaikan bahwa penguatan bank sampah merupakan elemen penting dalam menjaga kebersihan sungai.

“Upaya menjaga kebersihan sungai harus dimulai dari pengelolaan sampah di tingkat komunitas. Dengan penguatan bank sampah, kami ingin mendorong perubahan perilaku sekaligus membangun sistem yang mampu mencegah sampah masuk ke badan sungai,” ujar Asriani.

Inisiatif ini juga menjadi bagian dari komitmen PT Vale terhadap penerapan prinsip Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG), khususnya dalam mendukung ekonomi sirkular, pengendalian pencemaran, dan pembangunan berkelanjutan di Indonesia.

en.title: Maravilhas III Dam: January Updates
en.subtitle: Maravilhas III Dam in Nova Lima (MG) Maintains Stability and Adequate Conservation Conditions in January 2026
en.body:
The Maravilhas III Dam, located in Nova Lima, Minas Gerais, maintained an adequate state of conservation in January 2026.

To monitor the geotechnical performance of the structure, we rely on the support of an external company, the Engineer of Record (EoR). The Geotechnical Performance Evaluation Report prepared by the EoR for the month of January indicates that, based on data obtained through monitoring and visual inspections, the dam is performing within normal conditions. In addition, the geotechnical instruments are operating within expected parameters according to the hydrological cycle, and the safety factors obtained in the stability analyses continue to meet the minimum requirements established under current legislation.

Construction works for the second phase of the dam embankment were suspended in October and are scheduled to resume in April, after the rainy season. During the rainy months, the structure will have a minimum number of equipment units available to ensure support if needed. In January, we continued activities to improve surface drainage and access roads to maintain the state of conservation, as well as vegetation clearing on the embankment and surrounding areas.

The Maravilhas III Dam maintains a positive Declaration of Condition of Stability (DCS), and the structure remains without any alert or emergency level. The dam continues to be monitored 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by the Geotechnical Monitoring Center (GMC).

en.title: Vale holds public hearing on dam safety in Santa Bárbara (MG)
en.subtitle: Meeting in the Florália community presented information on the structures at the Água Limpa and Capanema mines, monitoring systems, and emergency actions set out in the PAEBM.
en.body:
On February 12, Vale S.A. held a public hearing in the Florália community, in Santa Bárbara (MG), to present information on dam safety and the licensing processes for structures located at the Água Limpa and Capanema mines.

The meeting took place in person at the building associated with the community church, starting at 3:15 p.m. and ending at 4:45 p.m., and was attended by company representatives, members of the Municipal Coordination for Protection and Civil Defense (COMPDEC), and local residents.

The initiative complies with Municipal Law No. 1,900/2019, GMG Resolution No. 83 of the State Civil Defense Coordination (CEDEC), and Resolution No. 220 of the National Mining Agency (ANM).

en.title: North Laranjeiras Dam in Barão de Cocais Exits Emergency Level
en.subtitle: Structure at Brucutu Mine receives positive Stability Condition Declaration and meets all Brazilian safety standards
en.body:
The North Laranjeiras Dam, located at the Brucutu Mine in Barão de Cocais, Minas Gerais (MG), had its emergency level status officially ended by Brazil’s National Mining Agency (ANM) on Monday, February 9.

Previously classified as Level 1 emergency, the structure received a positive Stability Condition Declaration (DCE) at the end of last year. The declaration was issued by independent external auditors and certifies the dam’s safety and structural stability.

                                                                 North Laranjeiras Dam, Brucutu Mine. Credit: Brayan Deusdeth – Construtora Aterpa


The termination of the emergency level follows reinforcement works carried out on the dam, which increased its safety factors in compliance with regulatory requirements established under Brazilian legislation.

With ANM’s decision, the North Laranjeiras Dam is now classified under alert level status. Vale continues to implement the necessary regulatory measures to end the alert condition with the Agency.

The North Laranjeiras Dam is the second structure to exit emergency level status this year. In January, the Maravilhas II Dam, located at the Pico Mine in Itabirito (MG), also received a positive Stability Condition Declaration.

Vale continues to strengthen the safety of its operations, prioritizing the protection of people, communities, and the environment.

The company permanently maintains monitoring and control measures for its geotechnical structures, operating 24 hours a day, seven days a week, through its Geotechnical Monitoring Centers.

en.title: Promoting Environmental Literacy Among Youth, PT Vale Educates Students in Morowali on Responsible Waste Management During National Waste Awareness Day
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), a member of the Indonesian Mining Industry Holding (MIND ID), conducted the “Vale Goes to School” program on February 10–11, 2026, to promote Waste management, at SMPN 2 Bahodopi and SMPN 3 Bungku Timur as part of the company’s commitment to sustainable environmental education in Morowali.
en.body:
Morowali, February 11, 2026 – Waste management has become an urgent issue in Morowali as the population grows and industrial activities increase. Early education is therefore crucial, with schools playing a key role in shaping the habits and awareness of the younger generation. To support this effort—and to commemorate National Waste Awareness Day (HPSN)—PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), a member of the Indonesian Mining Industry Holding (MIND ID), conducted the “Vale Goes to School” program on February 10–11, 2026, at SMPN 2 Bahodopi and SMPN 3 Bungku Timur as part of the company’s commitment to sustainable environmental education in Morowali.

During the educational sessions, students learned the fundamentals of the Reduce, Reuse, Recycle (3R) concept, different types of waste, and the long-term impacts of improper waste management. The materials were delivered using visual aids, demonstrations, and interactive discussions to ensure they were accessible and engaging for students.

The program highlighted that waste management goes beyond simply disposing of waste in the right place. It involves sorting, processing, and understanding how individuals can actively reduce the amount of waste they generate. The sessions also addressed the environmental and ecological harm caused by unmanaged waste.

 
 

A Closer Look at Waste Management: An Inspiring Visit to the TPS3R Facility

One of the most memorable activities for the students was a visit to the TPS3R Onepute Jaya facility, a waste-processing center built by PT Vale Indonesia and managed by LPM Valone Jaya. Here, students observed firsthand how the principles of 3R are applied in daily waste management operations.

Students saw the separation of organic, inorganic, and residual waste, and learned how organic waste is transformed into compost used to enrich soil. Meanwhile, recyclable inorganic materials such as plastics, paper, and metals are collected and sold as valuable resources.

A highlight of the visit was a demonstration of maggot cultivation, an innovative method that uses Black Soldier Fly (BSF) larvae to process organic waste. This technique not only accelerates decomposition but also produces maggots that serve as high-value livestock feed.

To reinforce learning, students also took part in a waste-sorting game, a hands-on challenge that required them to correctly categorize waste materials within a set time.

School Appreciation: Environmental Learning That Makes a Real Difference

Misdar, Principal of SMPN 2 Bahodopi, expressed appreciation to PT Vale Indonesia. “This activity is extremely valuable for our students because it provides real-life insight into proper waste management. The children now understand the difference between organic and inorganic waste more clearly. We are grateful for PT Vale’s continued support and collaboration,” he said.

Similarly, Nurfan, Principal of SMPN 3 Bungku Timur, highlighted the importance of the initiative. “Our students gained meaningful experience. Seeing the waste-processing operations firsthand has made them more aware and concerned about environmental issues,” she stated.

Representing PT Vale's management, Environment Engineer Nur Rasyidah Lacinu emphasized that the program aligns with the company’s sustainability strategy, particularly in environmental education, circular economy initiatives, and community empowerment.
“Waste management is a shared responsibility. Through this program, we aim to ensure that young people have the knowledge and awareness needed to play an active role in protecting the environment. National Waste Awareness Day serves as a meaningful moment for us to reinforce direct education to students.”

The company hopes this initiative will inspire further school-level efforts, such as the establishment of waste banks, environmental student clubs, and ongoing waste management programs involving both students and the surrounding community.

PT Vale believes that meaningful change begins in schools as centers of learning and then extends to homes and communities.
With the knowledge and first-hand experience gained through this program, PT Vale hopes students will become agents of change—encouraging their families, peers, and local communities to adopt better waste management habits.

id.title: Dorong Literasi Bagi Generasi Muda, PT Vale Edukasi Siswa di Morowali Kelola Sampah Secara Bijak pada Peringatan HPSN
id.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) yang merupakan anggota holding Industri Pertambangan Indonesia (MIND ID) melaksanakan program “Vale Goes to School” mempromosikan pengelolaan sampah pada 10–11 Februari 2026 di SMPN 2 Bahodopi dan SMPN 3 Bungku Timur sebagai bagian dari komitmen perusahaan pada pendidikan lingkungan yang berkelanjutan di Morowali.
id.body:
Morowali, 11 Februari 2026 - Pengelolaan sampah menjadi isu mendesak di Morowali seiring pertumbuhan penduduk dan meningkatnya aktivitas industri. Edukasi sejak dini pun penting karena sekolah memiliki peran besar dalam membentuk perilaku generasi muda. Untuk mendukung hal tersebut sekaligus memperingati Hari Peduli Sampah Nasional (HPSN), PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) yang merupakan anggota holding Industri Pertambangan Indonesia (MIND ID) melaksanakan program “Vale Goes to School” pada 10–11 Februari 2026 di SMPN 2 Bahodopi dan SMPN 3 Bungku Timur sebagai bagian dari komitmen perusahaan pada pendidikan lingkungan yang berkelanjutan di Morowali.

Dalam sesi edukasi, para siswa diberikan pemahaman dasar mengenai konsep Reduce, Reuse, dan Recycle (3R), jenis-jenis sampah, serta dampak jangka panjang jika sampah tidak dikelola dengan baik. Materi ini disampaikan dengan pendekatan visual, demonstratif, dan percakapan interaktif agar mudah dipahami oleh siswa.

Materi yang dibawakan menekankan pengelolaan sampah bukan hanya sekadar membuang pada tempatnya, tetapi melibatkan proses pemilahan, pengolahan, hingga bagaimana setiap individu dapat berperan dalam mengurangi sampah yang dihasilkan. Serta dampak buruk yang ditimbulkan dari sampah bagi lingkungan dan makhluk hidup.

 
 


Mengenal Pengelolaan Sampah Lebih Dekat: Kunjungan Inspiratif ke TPS3R

Salah satu bagian paling berkesan bagi siswa adalah kunjungan ke TPS3R Onepute Jaya, fasilitas pengolahan sampah yang dibangun oleh PT Vale Indonesia dan dikelola oleh LPM Valone Jaya. Di fasilitas ini, siswa dapat menyaksikan langsung bagaimana konsep 3R diterapkan dalam pengelolaan sampah sehari-hari.

Para siswa diperlihatkan proses pemilahan antara sampah organik, anorganik, dan residu. Mereka juga menyaksikan bagaimana sampah organik diolah menjadi kompos yang digunakan untuk pengayaan tanah. Sementara sampah anorganik yang masih bernilai jual seperti plastik, kertas, dan logam dikumpulkan untuk dijual kembali.

Salah satu bagian yang paling menarik perhatian siswa adalah demonstrasi budidaya maggot, sebuah metode pengolahan sampah organik menggunakan larva Black Soldier Fly (BSF). Metode ini tidak hanya efektif mempercepat penguraian sampah organik, tetapi juga menghasilkan maggot yang dapat dimanfaatkan sebagai pakan ternak dan bernilai ekonomi tinggi.

Untuk memastikan materi tidak hanya dipahami tetapi juga membekas, siswa diberi games pilah sampah, sebuah permainan edukatif yang mengajak siswa mempraktekkan langsung cara pemilahan sampah. Dalam permainan ini, siswa berkompetisi untuk mengelompokkan jenis sampah dalam waktu tertentu.

Apresiasi Sekolah: Pembelajaran Lingkungan yang Memberi Dampak Nyata

Kepala Sekolah SMPN 2 Bahodopi, Misdar, menyampaikan apresiasi kepada PT Vale Indonesia. “Kegiatan ini sangat penting bagi siswa kami, karena memberikan pengalaman nyata tentang bagaimana sampah harus dikelola. Anak-anak jadi lebih memahami apa perbedaan sampah organik dan anorganik. Kami sangat berterima kasih kepada PT Vale atas kepedulian dan kerja sama yang terus terjalin,” ujarnya.

Sementara itu, Kepala Sekolah SMPN 3 Bungku Timur, Nurfan, memberikan komentar serupa terkait pentingnya kegiatan ini. “Anak-anak kami mendapat pengalaman yang berharga. Melihat langsung proses pengolahan sampah membuat mereka lebih peduli,” katanya.

Mewakili Manajemen PT Vale, Nur Rasyidah Lacinu, Environment Engineer, menegaskan bahwa program ini merupakan bagian dari strategi keberlanjutan perusahaan, khususnya dalam bidang pendidikan lingkungan, ekonomi sirkular, dan pemberdayaan komunitas.

“Pengelolaan sampah adalah tanggung jawab bersama. Melalui kegiatan ini, kami ingin memastikan bahwa generasi muda memiliki pengetahuan dan kesadaran untuk mengambil peran dalam menjaga lingkungan. HPSN menjadi momentum penting bagi kami untuk menguatkan edukasi langsung kepada siswa.”

Perusahaan berharap kegiatan ini menjadi pemicu lahirnya inisiatif lanjutan di tingkat sekolah, seperti pembentukan bank sampah, kelompok peduli lingkungan, hingga program rutin pengelolaan sampah yang melibatkan siswa dan masyarakat sekitar.

Perusahaan meyakini bahwa perubahan yang nyata dimulai dari sekolah sebagai pusat pembelajaran, kemudian berlanjut ke rumah dan lingkungan sekitar.

Dengan pengetahuan yang diberikan dan pengalaman langsung yang diperoleh, PT Vale berharap siswa dapat menjadi agen perubahan yang mampu mempengaruhi keluarga, teman sebaya, dan masyarakat dalam membangun kebiasaan pengelolaan sampah yang lebih baik.

en.title: Promoting Information Transparency, PT Vale Highlights Its Sustainability Commitment to Village and Sub-District Officials in the Morowali Empowerment Area
en.subtitle: Transparency is essential for building public trust and strengthening stakeholder relationships. Demonstrating this commitment, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), a member of the Indonesian Mining Industry Holding (MIND ID), opened its operational areas to village and sub-district governments within the Morowali Empowerment Area through a Mining Tour held on Wednesday, February 11, 2026.
en.body:
Morowali, February 11, 2026 – Transparency is essential for building public trust and strengthening stakeholder relationships. Demonstrating this commitment, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), a member of the Indonesian Mining Industry Holding (MIND ID), opened its operational areas to village and sub-district governments within the Morowali Empowerment Area through a Mining Tour held on Wednesday, February 11, 2026.

The initiative served as both an educational effort and an opportunity to deepen stakeholder engagement, ensuring that local leaders receive comprehensive and accurate information about the company’s activities. During the visit, village and sub-district officials were introduced not only to PT Vale’s operational processes, but also to the implementation of safety standards, environmental management practices, and on-site land rehabilitation efforts.

The tour began with an inspection of activities at the jetty, where participants observed how operations are conducted under rigorous safety controls and environmental monitoring to ensure coastal waters remain clear and protected. The group then continued with a tree-planting activity in a reclamation area, symbolizing the company’s long-term commitment to post-mining land restoration.

Arsan, the Sub-District Head of Bungku Timur, expressed appreciation for the company’s openness and commitment. “I would like to thank PT Vale for inviting us. This is an extraordinary initiative because not all companies are this transparent. When we visited the jetty, I saw firsthand how PT Vale prioritizes safety and environmental protection. The seawater is still very clear and well maintained,” he stated.

He also highlighted the effectiveness of sediment pond management. According to him, the company’s systems for handling mining runoff are well designed and capable of producing clear water that can be safely discharged into rivers.

“The sediment ponds are excellent—water flowing to the river is clear. This is proof of PT Vale’s commitment to environmental stewardship. We hope other companies in Morowali can follow this example. Ideally, visits like this could be conducted regularly, every four months or at least once a year,” he added.

 
 

Wafir, Head of Mine Operation Bahodopi, reaffirmed that collaboration and transparency are embedded in the company’s operational principles. “We truly appreciate the presence of village and sub-district leaders. Through initiatives such as the Mining Tour, we want stakeholders to see directly how we conduct operations safely, professionally, and transparently.”

He emphasized that sustainability is a core value of the company’s approach. “Environmental management is fundamental to who we are. Every process is designed to minimize impact and ensure ecosystems remain protected. Our efforts in reclamation, sediment control, and water quality protection represent long-term commitments that we continuously strengthen.”

The Mining Tour serves as a concrete step in building mutual trust between the company and the community. PT Vale believes that sustainability can only be achieved through open, continuous collaboration. Together with stakeholders in Morowali, the company remains committed to protecting the environment, supporting community wellbeing, and helping create a greener future for the next generation.

id.title: Dorong Keterbukaan Informasi, PT Vale Beberkan Komitmen Keberlanjutan di Hadapan Pemerintah Desa dan Kecamatan di Area Pemberdayaan Morowali
id.subtitle: Transparansi adalah kunci membangun kepercayaan publik dan pemangku kepentingan. Upaya ini menjadi langkah besar yang dilakukan PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) yang merupakan anggota holding Industri Pertambangan Indonesia (MIND ID) dengan membuka akses ke Pemerintah Desa dan Kecamatan dari Area Pemberdayaan di Morowali melalui kegiatan Mining Tour, Rabu, 11 Februari 2026.
id.body:
Morowali, 11 Februari 2026 - Transparansi adalah kunci membangun kepercayaan publik dan pemangku kepentingan. Upaya ini menjadi langkah besar yang dilakukan PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) yang merupakan anggota holding Industri Pertambangan Indonesia (MIND ID) dengan membuka akses ke Pemerintah Desa dan Kecamatan dari Area Pemberdayaan di Morowali melalui kegiatan Mining Tour, Rabu, 11 Februari 2026. 

Kegiatan ini sebagai bentuk edukasi sekaligus meningkatkan engagement perusahaan ke stakeholder, agar mereka memiliki informasi yang komprehensif terkait aktivitas yang dilakukan. Untuk itu, pada kesempatan kunjungan aparat desa tidak hanya dikenalkan pada proses operasional perusahaan, tetapi juga diajak melihat penerapan standar keselamatan, pengelolaan lingkungan, serta upaya pemulihan lahan secara langsung di lapangan.

Kegiatan dimulai dengan peninjauan aktivitas pengangkutan di jetty. Mereka menyaksikan bagaimana proses operasional dijalankan dengan kontrol keselamatan yang ketat, termasuk pengelolaan lingkungan yang memastikan kondisi perairan tetap jernih dan terjaga. Setelah itu, rombongan melanjutkan agenda dengan melakukan penanaman pohon di area reklamasi sebagai wujud komitmen berkelanjutan perusahaan dalam pemulihan lahan pascatambang.

Camat Bungku Timur, Arsan, memberikan apresiasi atas keterbukaan dan komitmen perusahaan.
“Saya mengucapkan terima kasih atas undangan PT Vale. Ini kegiatan yang luar biasa karena tidak semua perusahaan terbuka seperti ini. Saat kami mengunjungi wilayah jetty, saya melihat bagaimana PT Vale sangat memperhatikan aspek keselamatan dan lingkungan. Air laut masih jernih dan sangat terjaga,” ujarnya.

Ia juga menyoroti pengelolaan sedimen pond yang dinilainya sangat baik. Menurutnya, tata kelola pertambangan khususnya dalam mengelola air limpasan tambang sangat bagus, bahkan sudah dipersiapkan sistem yang dapat menghasilkan air jernih untuk dibuang ke sungai.

“Sediment pond-nya luar biasa, air yang keluar menuju sungai dalam keadaan jernih. Ini bukti komitmen PT Vale dalam menjaga lingkungan. Kami berharap perusahaan lain di Morowali bisa mengikuti contoh seperti ini. Semoga kunjungan ini idealnya berkesinambungan, empat bulan sekali atau minimal setahun sekali,” tambahnya.

 
 

Head of Mine Operation Bahodopi, Wafir, menegaskan bahwa kolaborasi dan transparansi merupakan bagian dari prinsip operasional perusahaan. “Kehadiran pemerintah desa dan kecamatan sangat kami hargai. Melalui kegiatan seperti Mining Tour, kami ingin memastikan bahwa setiap pemangku kepentingan dapat melihat langsung bagaimana kami menjalankan operasi dengan aman, profesional, dan transparan.”

Ia menambahkan bahwa keberlanjutan adalah nilai inti dari cara perusahaan bekerja.
“Pengelolaan lingkungan adalah bagian utama dari identitas kami. Setiap proses dirancang untuk meminimalkan dampak serta memastikan ekosistem tetap terlindungi. Upaya reklamasi, pengendalian sedimentasi, dan perlindungan kualitas air merupakan komitmen jangka panjang kami yang terus kami tingkatkan.”

Kegiatan Mining Tour ini menjadi langkah nyata dalam membangun hubungan yang saling percaya antara perusahaan dan masyarakat. Perseroan percaya bahwa keberlanjutan hanya dapat tercapai melalui kerja sama yang terbuka dan berkesinambungan. Bersama para pemangku kepentingan di Morowali, PT Vale akan terus berupaya menciptakan lingkungan yang lebih baik, mendukung kesejahteraan masyarakat, dan mewujudkan masa depan yang lebih hijau bagi generasi mendatang.

en.title: Measures taken regarding water overflows in Ouro Preto and Congonhas
en.subtitle: Vale outlines actions in Ouro Preto and Congonhas to reduce turbidity and monitor streams after water overflows.
en.body:
We are continuously working to restore the conditions of the areas affected by the water overflows with sediments recorded on January 25 at the Fábrica mine in Ouro Preto and the Viga mine in Congonhas.

Our focus is to reinforce operational safety and maintain full transparency and clarifications with the authorities and society.

At both mines, we are adopting measures to reduce water turbidity and carrying out daily environmental monitoring of streams. We have also started cleaning and dredging of the watercourses.

Learn more about Vale at www.vale.com
Customer Service Center: 0800 285 7000

en.title: Vale strengthens operational safety and environmental actions at mines in Ouro Preto and Congonhas, Brazil
en.subtitle: Company strengthens operational safety, environmental monitoring, and desilting actions at Fábrica and Viga mines in Minas Gerais, reinforcing transparency and recovery efforts.
en.body:
Vale has been working continuously to restore conditions in the affected areas, reinforce operational safety, and maintain full transparency and open communication with authorities and society.

At the Fábrica Mine, in Ouro Preto, the company has implemented a video monitoring system and real-time level measurement and has begun interventions at Pit 18, focusing on reshaping the area, in addition to cleaning the Freitas II sump. At the Viga Mine, in Congonhas, the company is carrying out desilting of the sumps, inspections of the drainage network, and improvements to access roads.

At both mines, measures are being adopted to reduce water turbidity, and daily environmental monitoring has been conducted in streams, with the results to be shared with the relevant authorities. Vale has initiated the cleaning and desilting of watercourses, regardless of the origin of the sediments.

Vale remains available to the competent authorities.

en.title: Building a Culture of Early Preparedness: PT Vale, Local Disaster Agency, and Partners Expand Disaster Readiness Education for Primary School Students in Morowali
en.subtitle: Morowali Regency in Central Sulawesi is strengthening efforts to raise a generation that is more risk-aware and better prepared to respond to disasters. Through a cross-sector collaboration, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale)—a member of Indonesia’s state-owned mining holding MIND ID—worked with the Morowali Regional Disaster Management Agency (BPBD) and partner company PT Petrosea Tbk to deliver a disaster preparedness outreach programme for primary school students. The programme ran for three days (3–5 February 2026) under the theme “Prepared Together, Safer Together: Disaster-Resilient Schoolchildren.
en.body:
Morowali, 4 February 2026 — Morowali Regency in Central Sulawesi is strengthening efforts to raise a generation that is more risk-aware and better prepared to respond to disasters. Through a cross-sector collaboration, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale)—a member of Indonesia’s state-owned mining holding MIND ID—worked with the Morowali Regional Disaster Management Agency (BPBD) and partner company PT Petrosea Tbk to deliver a disaster preparedness outreach programme for primary school students. 

The programme ran for three days (3–5 February 2026) under the theme “Prepared Together, Safer Together: Disaster-Resilient Schoolchildren.” Sessions were held at primary schools located in PT Vale’s assisted villages within the IGP Morowali area, including SDN Dampala, SDN Siumbatu, SDN Onepute Jaya 1 and 2, and SDN Bahomotefe 1 and 2.

Organisers identified primary school students as a key audience for embedding disaster awareness over the long term—both at school and at home. Throughout the programme, students received age-appropriate instruction on local hazard risks, basic mitigation measures, and what to do safely during emergencies. The content was designed to be interactive and easy to understand, helping children translate lessons into practical actions.

Given Central Sulawesi’s exposure to seismic activity, earthquake preparedness was a central focus. Beyond classroom-style explanations, the sessions included practical drills and simulations so students could experience what appropriate response looks like in real time. This hands-on approach helped students learn safe behaviour at school and at home, including how to recognise signs of an earthquake, follow evacuation procedures, and practise the internationally recognised technique “drop, cover, and hold on.”

 
 

“Children are a vulnerable group, but they also have strong potential to become agents of change,” said Mohammad Ridwan Mangkali, Head of Prevention and Preparedness at BPBD Morowali. “With the right understanding and training, they can not only protect themselves, but also support people around them.” He also welcomed the cross-sector partnership, noting that disaster education from an early age is a long-term investment in building community resilience.

Schools reported immediate benefits from the initiative. Serno, Principal of SDN Siumbatu, said the programme had a positive impact on both students and teachers. “Thank you for organising this activity. The children were very engaged and now have a better understanding of how to respond during a disaster. They also seem more confident,” he said. “We hope this knowledge stays with them and becomes part of their daily habits, and that similar activities can continue in the future.”

The outreach is part of PT Vale’s broader commitment to strengthening safety, resilience, and sustainability in communities around its operational areas. “Safety is a fundamental value we consistently uphold,” said Salwa, Community Development Officer for Bahodopi, speaking on behalf of PT Vale’s management. “Through early disaster education and practical training, we aim to equip children with basic knowledge, mental readiness, and the confidence to act appropriately in emergencies. This collaboration reflects our shared belief that disaster preparedness is a collective responsibility—government, business, and communities working together.”

Through this programme, students are expected not only to understand disaster risks, but also to apply mitigation steps in everyday life. The collaboration between local government, the private sector, and schools represents a practical step towards building a culture of preparedness from an early age—supporting a more resilient Morowali in the years ahead.

id.title: Menanamkan Budaya Siaga Sejak Dini, PT Vale Bersama BPBD dan Mitra Perkuat Edukasi Tanggap Bencana Bagi Siswa Sekolah Dasar di Morowali
id.subtitle: Upaya membangun generasi yang sadar risiko dan tangguh dalam menghadapi bencana terus diperkuat di Kabupaten Morowali, Provinsi Sulawesi Tengah. Melalui kolaborasi lintas sektor, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) yang merupakan anggota holding Industri Pertambangan Indonesia (MIND ID), bersama Badan Penanggulangan Bencana Daerah (BPBD) Kabupaten Morowali dan mitranya PT Petrosea Tbk menggelar Sosialisasi Tanggap Bencana bagi Siswa Sekolah Dasar. Kegiatan ini berlangsung selama tiga hari, mulai 3 hingga 5 Februari 2026, dengan mengusung tema “Siap Siaga, Selamat Bersama: Anak Sekolah Tangguh Bencana.”
id.body:
Morowali, 4 Februari 2026 — Upaya membangun generasi yang sadar risiko dan tangguh dalam menghadapi bencana terus diperkuat di Kabupaten Morowali, Provinsi Sulawesi Tengah. Melalui kolaborasi lintas sektor, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) yang merupakan anggota holding Industri Pertambangan Indonesia (MIND ID), bersama Badan Penanggulangan Bencana Daerah (BPBD) Kabupaten Morowali dan mitranya PT Petrosea Tbk menggelar Sosialisasi Tanggap Bencana bagi Siswa Sekolah Dasar. Kegiatan ini berlangsung selama tiga hari, mulai 3 hingga 5 Februari 2026, dengan mengusung tema “Siap Siaga, Selamat Bersama: Anak Sekolah Tangguh Bencana.”

Sosialisasi dilaksanakan di sekolah-sekolah dasar yang berada di wilayah desa binaan PT Vale IGP Morowali, meliputi SDN Dampala, SDN Siumbatu, SDN 1 dan 2 Onepute Jaya, serta SDN 1 dan 2 Bahomotefe. Para siswa di sekolah-sekolah ini dinilai sebagai kelompok strategis dalam menanamkan budaya sadar bencana secara berkelanjutan, baik di lingkungan sekolah maupun keluarga. 

Dalam sosialisasi, para siswa dibekali pengetahuan dasar mengenai potensi bencana di lingkungan sekitar, langkah mitigasi, serta cara bertindak aman saat terjadi keadaan darurat. Edukasi dirancang secara interaktif dan disesuaikan dengan karakteristik usia sekolah dasar agar mudah dipahami dan diterapkan.

Potensi bencana alam yang menjadi fokus utama selama sosialisasi, yaitu gempa bumi yang memiliki tingkat risiko tinggi di wilayah Sulawesi Tengah. Tidak hanya menyampaikan materi secara konseptual, kegiatan ini juga diperkaya dengan simulasi dan praktik kebencanaan secara langsung, sehingga para siswa memperoleh pengalaman nyata mengenai langkah-langkah penyelamatan diri yang tepat, baik di lingkungan sekolah maupun di rumah.
 

 

 

Dengan metode pembelajaran yang interaktif, komunikatif, dan mudah dipahami, anak-anak diajak mengenali tanda-tanda terjadinya gempa bumi, memahami prosedur evakuasi yang benar, serta mempraktikkan sikap aman seperti drop, cover, and hold on. Pendekatan ini terbukti efektif meningkatkan antusiasme siswa, sekaligus membangun keberanian dan rasa percaya diri mereka dalam menghadapi situasi darurat.

“Anak-anak adalah kelompok yang rentan, namun sekaligus memiliki potensi besar sebagai agen perubahan. Dengan pemahaman dan latihan yang tepat, mereka tidak hanya mampu menyelamatkan diri sendiri, tetapi juga dapat membantu orang-orang di sekitarnya,” kata Kepala Bidang Pencegahan dan Kesiapsiagaan BPBD Kabupaten Morowali, Mohammad Ridwan Mangkali.

Mohammad Ridwan pun mengapresiasi terbangunnya sinergi lintas sektor dalam memperkuat edukasi kebencanaan di daerah. Menurutnya, edukasi kebencanaan sejak usia dini merupakan investasi jangka panjang dalam membangun masyarakat yang tangguh bencana.

“Kami sangat mengapresiasi dukungan PT Vale dan PT Petrosea dalam upaya memperkuat kesiapsiagaan bencana di Kabupaten Morowali,” tambahnya.

Para sekolah merasakan manfaat langsung dari kegiatan sosialisasi ini. Kepala SDN Siumbatu, Serno, menyatakan bahwa dampak positifnya tidak hanya dirasakan oleh para siswa, tetapi juga oleh para tenaga pendidik.
“Kami mengucapkan terima kasih atas pelaksanaan kegiatan ini. Anak-anak terlihat sangat antusias dan kini memiliki pemahaman yang lebih baik tentang bagaimana bersikap saat terjadi bencana. Mereka juga tampak lebih percaya diri. Harapan kami, pengetahuan ini dapat tertanam kuat dan diterapkan dalam keseharian, serta kegiatan serupa dapat terus dilaksanakan secara berkelanjutan,” ujarnya.

Kegiatan sosialisasi ini merupakan bagian dari komitmen PT Vale dalam mendorong keselamatan, ketangguhan, dan keberlanjutan masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasional perusahaan.

“Keselamatan merupakan nilai fundamental yang selalu kami junjung tinggi. Melalui edukasi dan praktik kebencanaan sejak dini, kami ingin membekali anak-anak dengan pengetahuan dasar, kesiapan mental, serta keberanian untuk bertindak tepat saat menghadapi keadaan darurat. Kolaborasi ini mencerminkan komitmen bersama bahwa kesiapsiagaan bencana adalah tanggung jawab kolektif antara pemerintah, dunia usaha, dan masyarakat,” ujar Community Development Officer Bahodopi, Salwa, mewakili Manajemen PT Vale.

Melalui kegiatan sosialisasi tanggap bencana ini, para siswa diharapkan tidak hanya memahami potensi risiko bencana, tetapi juga mampu menerapkan langkah-langkah mitigasi secara tepat dalam kehidupan sehari-hari. Kolaborasi antara pemerintah daerah, dunia usaha, dan institusi pendidikan menjadi langkah konkret dalam menanamkan budaya sadar dan siaga bencana sejak usia dini, sekaligus memperkuat ketangguhan masyarakat Kabupaten Morowali di masa depan.

en.title: Update on water overflows in Congonhas and Ouro Preto
en.subtitle: Vale updates on water overflows in Congonhas and Ouro Preto, with no community impact and no relation to dams.
en.body:
We clarify that the water overflows identified in Congonhas and Ouro Preto on Sunday (25) have been contained. No one was injured, and the population and nearby communities were not affected. Neither situation has any relation to Vale’s dams in the region, which remain unchanged in their stability and safety conditions and are monitored 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

We also inform that there was no transport of mining tailings, only water with sediments (soil). We periodically carry out preventive inspection and maintenance actions on our structures, which are safe. The company reinforces these procedures during the intense rainy season.

The causes of the two overflows are being investigated, and the lessons learned will be immediately incorporated into the company’s rain plans. We remain available to the authorities to provide the necessary clarifications.

Learn more about Vale at www.vale.com
Customer Service Center: 0800 285 7000

en.title: 2026 RKAB Approved, PT Vale Indonesia Reaffirms Operational Certainty and Investment Continuity
en.subtitle: One of Indonesia’s integrated nickel mining operations with a strong and long-standing commitment to sustainability, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” or the “Company”; IDX: INCO), a member of the Indonesian Mining Industry holding company Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID), hereby announces that its 2026 Work Plan and Budget (Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Biaya/RKAB) has received formal approval from the Ministry of Energy and Company’s operational certainty and the continuity of PT Vale’s long-term investments as an integral part of Indonesia’s national nickel ecosystem and the global supply chain.
en.body:
Jakarta, 15 January 2026 — One of Indonesia’s integrated nickel mining operations with a strong and long-standing commitment to sustainability, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” or the “Company”; IDX: INCO), a member of the Indonesian Mining Industry holding company Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID), hereby announces that its 2026 Work Plan and Budget (Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Biaya/RKAB) has received formal approval from the Ministry of Energy and Company’s operational certainty and the continuity of PT Vale’s long-term investments as an integral part of Indonesia’s national nickel ecosystem and the global supply chain.

Following the approval, PT Vale is now focused on progressively restoring all operational and construction activities across Sorowako, Pomalaa, and Bahodopi, with safety as the foremost priority, in full compliance with prevailing licensing requirements. This phased normalization aims to optimize operational performance and minimize the unforeseen impacts resulting from the Company’s earlier temporary suspension of activities.

The approval of the 2026 RKAB reflects the Government’s policy decision to reintroduce an annual RKAB approval mechanism, replacing the previous integrated three-year approval scheme that was aligned with underlying base permits. PT Vale welcomes this regulatory clarity as a critical foundation for maintaining production discipline, sound governance, and the longterm sustainability of Indonesia’s nickel industry. “With a complete and comprehensive permitting framework in place, all of our activities have now resumed in a normal, compliant, and sustainable manner,” said Bernardus Irmanto, President Director and Chief Executive Officer of PT Vale Indonesia Tbk.

With the 2026 RKAB now in effect, the Company will proceed with its approved operational and production plans, while ensuring the continuity of supply for Indonesia’s domestic processing and refining industries. Drawing on more than five decades of operational experience in Indonesia, PT Vale continues to contribute through state revenues from taxes and non-tax revenues (PNBP), job creation and workforce stability, strengthening local supply chains and stakeholder participation, as well as long-term investments in downstream development and the electric vehicle (EV) value chain.

In alignment with the Government’s strategic agenda, the Company is also continuing its investments in low-emission technologies and advanced processing capabilities, including the High Pressure Acid Leach (HPAL) project, to enhance the global competitiveness of Indonesia’s nickel industry.

PT Vale Indonesia once again reaffirms its commitment as a strategic partner of the Government in building a responsible, competitive, and sustainable national nickel industry. By upholding the principles of compliance, transparency, and good governance, the Company remains committed to supporting sustainable natural resource management and strengthening Indonesia’s position within the global supply chain.

id.title: RKAB 2026 Disetujui, PTVI Tegaskan Kepastian Operasional dan Keberlanjutan Investasi
id.subtitle: Salah satu kegiatan pertambangan nikel terintegrasi dan berkomitmen penuh pada keberkelanjutan di Indonesia, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” atau “Perusahaan”; IDX: INCO), anggota holding Industri Pertambangan Indonesia (MIND ID), dengan ini mengumumkan bahwa Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Biaya (RKAB) tahun 2026 telah mendapatkan persetujuan resmi dari Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral (ESDM) pada Kamis, 15 Januari 2026. Persetujuan ini menegaskan kembali kepastian operasional Perusahaan dan kelanjutan investasi jangka panjang PT Vale sebagai bagian dari ekosistem nikel nasional Indonesia dan rantai pasok global.
id.body:
Jakarta, 15 Januari 2026 — Salah satu kegiatan pertambangan nikel terintegrasi dan berkomitmen penuh pada keberkelanjutan di Indonesia, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” atau “Perusahaan”; IDX: INCO), anggota holding Industri Pertambangan Indonesia (MIND ID), dengan ini mengumumkan bahwa Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Biaya (RKAB) tahun 2026 telah mendapatkan persetujuan resmi dari Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral (ESDM) pada Kamis, 15 Januari 2026. Persetujuan ini menegaskan kembali kepastian operasional Perusahaan dan kelanjutan investasi jangka panjang PT Vale sebagai bagian dari ekosistem nikel nasional Indonesia dan rantai pasok global.

Dengan diperolehnya persetujuan ini, saat ini PT Vale fokus untuk mengembalikan seluruh kegiatan operasional dan konstruksi di Sorowako, Pomalaa, dan Bahodopi berlandaskan pada aspek keselamatan sebagai prioritas utama sesuai dengan ketentuan perizinan yang berlaku, sehingga dapat berjalan secara optimal guna mengejar ketertinggalan akibat penghentian sementara yang sebelumnya dilakukan.

Persetujuan RKAB 2026 merupakan implementasi kebijakan Pemerintah yang Kembali menerapkan mekanisme persetujuan RKAB tahunan, menggantikan skema sebelumnya yang berbasis tiga tahunan secara terintegrasi dengan perijinan dasar lainnya. PT Vale menyambut baik kepastian ini sebagai fondasi penting untuk menjaga disiplin produksi, tata kelola yang baik, serta keberlanjutan industri nikel nasional. “Dengan dasar perizinan yang lengkap, seluruh kegiatan kami kini berjalan kembali secara normal, patuh, dan berkelanjutan,” ujar Bernardus Irmanto, Presiden Direktur dan CEO PT Vale Indonesia Tbk.

Dengan berlakunya RKAB 2026, Perusahaan akan melanjutkan rencana operasional dan produksi sesuai dengan persetujuan yang diberikan, serta memastikan kesinambungan pasokan bagi industri pengolahan dan pemurnian nasional. Melalui pengalaman lebih dari lima decade beroperasi di Indonesia, PT Vale terus berkontribusi melalui penerimaan negara dari pajak dan non-pajak (PNBP), penciptaan dan stabilitas lapangan kerja, penguatan rantai pasok dan pelibatan pelaku lokal, serta investasi jangka panjang dalam hilirisasi dan rantai nilai kendaraan listrik (EV).

Sejalan dengan agenda Pemerintah, Perusahaan juga melanjutkan investasi pada teknologi rendah emisi dan pengembangan kapasitas pengolahan lanjutan, termasuk proyek High Pressure Acid Leach (HPAL), untuk meningkatkan daya saing industri nikel Indonesia di pasar global.

Kembali PT Vale Indonesia tegaskan komitmennya sebagai mitra strategis Pemerintah dalam membangun industri nikel nasional yang bertanggung jawab, berdaya saing, dan berkelanjutan. Dengan mengedepankan kepatuhan, transparansi, dan tata kelola yang baik, Perusahaan akan terus mendukung pengelolaan sumber daya alam yang berkelanjutan serta penguatan posisi Indonesia dalam rantai pasok global.

en.title: Maravilhas II Dam, in Itabirito (MG), has emergency level removed
en.subtitle: The removal of the emergency level follows the completion of reinforcement work in October 2025, which improved stability conditions and met the standards required by legislation.
en.body:
The Maravilhas II dam, in Itabirito, had the emergency level removed by the National Mining Agency (ANM), last Friday, January 09. The structure was at level 1 and has now received a positive Stability Condition Statement (DCE), the technical document attesting to the structure’s safety.

The removal of the emergency level follows the completion of reinforcement work in October 2025, which improved stability conditions and met the standards required by legislation.

                               

                                                 Maravilhas II Dam, in Itabirito (MG), had its emergency level removed by the ANM. Source: Vale.
       

Advances in Dam Safety

Maravilhas II is the 23rd Vale-operated structure to exit an emergency level since 2022. In 2025 alone, five structures in Minas Gerais had their emergency levels removed: Grupo, B6 of MAC, Dicão Leste, Doutor, and Vargem Grande. Additionally, two dams had their emergency levels reduced: Xingu, downgraded to Level 1, and Forquilha III, downgraded to Level 2—both of which are also located in Minas Gerais.

“We have fulfilled our commitment to have no dams at the maximum emergency level by 2025 and continue to strengthen people’s safety and environmental protection. Today, all of our tailings structures comply with the Global Industry Standard on Tailings Management (GISTM), which is an international benchmark for best practices. Additionally, we will advance the Upstream Dam Decharacterization Program this year, reaffirming our commitment to ensuring increasingly safe and sustainable structures,” said Rafael Bittar, Vale’s Technical Vice President.

Vale permanently maintains control and monitoring measures for its geotechnical structures 24/7 through its Geotechnical Monitoring Centers.

en.title: Maravilhas III Dam: December Updates
en.subtitle: Positive Stability Declaration and Continuous 24/7 Monitoring Ensure Safety at Maravilhas III Dam
en.body:
Maravilhas III Dam, located in Nova Lima, Minas Gerais, maintained its proper conservation status in December 2025.  
To monitor the geotechnical performance of the structure, we rely on the support of an external company, the Engineer of Record (EdR). The Geotechnical Performance Assessment Report prepared by the EdR for December indicates that, based on data obtained through monitoring and visual inspections, the dam is performing within normal conditions. In addition, the geotechnical instruments are operating within the expected parameters, and the safety factors obtained in the stability analyses continue to meet the minimum requirements established by current legislation.

The works of the second stage of the dam’s embankment were halted in October, with plans to resume in April, after the rainy season. During the rainy months, the structure will maintain a minimum set of equipment to ensure support if needed. In December, adjustments were made to surface drainage and access routes to preserve the conservation status.

Maravilhas III Dam maintains a positive Stability Condition Declaration (DCE), with no alert or emergency level. The dam continues to be monitored 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by the Geotechnical Monitoring Center (CMG).

en.title: National K3 Month 2026 Officially Kicks Off: PT Vale Reinforces Safety as a Top Priority and Shared Responsibility
en.subtitle: Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) is more than a legal requirement—it’s a culture that must be embedded in every aspect of the mining industry. For PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID) group, OHS stands as the cornerstone of its operations. This commitment aligns with the company’s core values, CARES, particularly the principle of Accountability—taking full responsibility to ensure the safety of every individual.
en.body:
Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) is more than a legal requirement—it’s a culture that must be embedded in every aspect of the mining industry. For PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID) group, OHS stands as the cornerstone of its operations.
